_note:
原版官方本地化表（I2 Localization 的 `I2Languages`，来自 Addressables 远端包 `localization_assets_all`）。**只留 en 与 zh-CN 两列**；其余 13 种语言跑 `工具/_i2_decode_probe.py --out ` 取全量。⚠️ zh-CN 列是 **I2 占位符模板**（`[[token]]` / `((X_y,…))` / `
`），不是成品文字 —— 印出来之前要过图标重写那一层。
_source: 原件 = `d:/2/远端缓存_旧profile_1013/导出/localization_temp_9412193字节_未解密.bin`（9,412,193 字节；抢救自旧 Windows 用户缓存的 Unity Addressables 缓存，按哈希命名 ⇒ 按包名搜不到，见 `d:/2/远端缓存_旧profile_1013/README.md`）。解码 = **逐字节重复密钥 XOR**：`temp[i] = ((i 偶 ? 0x17 : 0xCD) * i) ^ temp[i] ^ pw[i % pw.Length]`，密钥 = 硬编码字符串字面量（VA `0x18427C678`，138 字符），出处 = `d:/2/tools/decomp_full/I2.Loc.LanguageSourceAsset__DecryptData.c` + `__.cctor.c`；**不是压缩**（前任试过的 gzip/zlib/deflate/lzma/bz2 方向是错的）。⚠️ 年代限制：与 `allcards` 同一批 —— Unity **2022.3.38f1 / 2025-07-30** 的快照，**不含**快照之后新增的内容（卡池那 266 张没有真值的卡，这里同样可能缺键）。

Cosmetic_Lore/88c832eac9c7c2c41825e7595e: Born in the subterranean cities of Calth, Uriel Ventris went on to earn the command of the Chapter's 4th Company and Fleet, and became one of the Ultramarines' greatest heroes.
乌列尔·文特里斯出生于卡尔思的地下城市，后来获得了战团第四公司和舰队的指挥权，成为极限战士最伟大的英雄之一。
Cosmetic_Lore/41e9a349428414cdb8e4103c29: Little is hidden from Tigurius' sight. Even to the Chapter's Captains he is a figure of mystery, possessed of a knowledge well beyond the Imperium's towering archives.
提古里乌斯的视线几乎无所不及。即使对战团的连长来说，他也是一个充满神秘的人物，拥有远超帝国高耸的档案库的知识。
Cosmetic_Lore/10a1e3f4c77c0491196b655ad4: Ever since the times of the Great Crusade, the Ultramarines have been amongst the most renowned of the Imperium's forces, accruing uncountable battle honours through the millennia.
自大远征时代以来，极限战士一直是帝国军队中最著名的部队之一，经过千年的积累，获得了无数的战斗荣耀。
Cosmetic_Lore/8c4524d276408314bb4af76ff3: The return of Guilliman during one of Mankind's darkest times returned a glimmer of hope to the hearts of humanity, kindling a light that would guide the Imperium into a new era.
在人类最黑暗的时期，基利曼的归来给人类的心中带来了一丝希望，点燃了一盏引导帝国进入新时代的灯。
Cosmetic_Lore/08d0303c43f6ddb4c94011f9f5: The Ultramarines strict adherence to the Codex Astartes is what makes the Chapter amongst the most highly organized forces in the Imperium.
极限战士严格遵守阿斯塔特圣典，这使得战团成为帝国中组织最严密的力量之一。
Cosmetic_Lore/560d8ef3ac9b44eb7b9489e45d: After Guilliman's revision of the Codex Astartes, the rank of Lieutenant was reintroduced. Lieutenants now lead their battle-brothers as they did during the Horus Heresy.
在基利曼修订阿斯塔特圣典后，副官的职务被重新引入。副官现在像荷鲁斯之乱期间一样领导他们的战斗修士。
Cosmetic_Lore/0c75cd9914102480fa04a761e2: Though famed as a general, Marneus Calgar is no stranger to personal valour. The Lord Macragge leads by example, inspiring his warriors from the heart of the enemy's lines.
尽管马涅乌思·卡尔加以将军的身份闻名，但他对个人勇气并不陌生。马库拉格领主以身作则，从敌人的阵线中心激励他的战士。
Cosmetic_Lore/a187c24ab1012a34482f779ada: Calgar is often regarded as Mankind's will to endure and triumph made flesh. Staunch and determined, he will lead the fight from the front until the stars turn cold.
卡尔加常被视为人类坚韧不屈和胜利的意志的化身。他坚定决心，将从前线领导战斗，直到星星变冷。
Cosmetic_Lore/580104488cc5d47939a709c877: Since earning his monicker by disfiguring Krugg the Tyrant in a bout for leadership, Grukk's utterly brutal way of fighting has only worsened, to the terror of his enemies.
自从在一场争夺领导权的战斗中毁了暴君克鲁格的面孔，赢得了他的绰号后，格鲁克的战斗方式变得更加残暴，令他的敌人恐惧。
Cosmetic_Lore/7a504f07fd985ef489440b8d11: To prove their worth before the eyes of their brutal and cunning gods, the mighty Ghazghkull has gathered the largest Waaagh recorded in millennia.
为了在他们残暴而狡猾的神面前证明自己的价值，强大的碎骨者召集了数千年来最大的Waaagh。
Cosmetic_Lore/5bdf38728ec08844083751ea72: Strength and brutality are paramount in Ork kultur, where any argument is bound to cause a fight. Ghazghkull is the greatest ork debater, having never lost a discussion.
力量和残暴在欧克蛮人文化中至关重要，任何争论都可能引发战斗。碎骨者是最伟大的欧克蛮人辩论家，从未输过一场讨论。
Cosmetic_Lore/fda20a075929af3479a9b7c7d2: Ork Warbosess who revere Mork, the more cunning of Ork gods, occasionally think through their battle plans before plunging headlong into battle.
崇拜摩克的欧克蛮人战争首领们，摩克是欧克蛮人神中更狡猾的一个，他们偶尔会在冲进战斗前思考他们的战斗计划。
Cosmetic_Lore/27ba2c22e72b94a4cb4c6859c9: Orks never stop growing. Bigger orks tend to rule over smaller ones, having achieved victory in many battles and survived violent challenges to their position.
欧克蛮人永远不会停止成长。更大的欧克蛮人往往统治着更小的欧克蛮人，他们在许多战斗中取得了胜利，并在对他们地位的暴力挑战中存活下来。
Cosmetic_Lore/09e4d2d95d0b64b38b0a0b3e5c: Orks believe that Ghazghkull receives messages from Gork and Mork themselves, and that with him in command of 'Da Great Waaagh' they will turn the stars green.
欧克蛮人相信碎骨者接收到来自格克和摩克的信息，他们相信在他的指挥下，他们将把星星变成绿色。
Cosmetic_Lore/6396f642a9efe4692963134b47: After Ghazghkull's many fights with Commissar Yarrick on Armageddon, Ghazghkull left the world infested with scattered greenskins and vowing to one day return.
在哈米吉多顿与政委亚瑞克的许多战斗后，碎骨者离开了这个世界，这个世界充满了散落的绿皮兽人，他们发誓有一天会回来。
Cosmetic_Lore/e181cff72c46f4e449d31bbc72: Known as simply 'Da Boss' to his Vulcha Squad, Zagstruk inspires close to fanatical awe among Stormboyz, who queue up to follow his bellowed commands.
札格斯查克在他的飞鹰小队中被简单地称为"老大"，他在风暴小子中激发了近乎狂热的敬畏，他们排队跟随他的吼叫指令。
Cosmetic_Lore/c1cdd75459e13420a85d12def5: It is the simple and resilient nature of Ork society that raises them from a civilisation of mere thuggish beasts to a world-conquering, nigh on unstoppable threat.
正是欧克蛮人社会的简单和坚韧性质，将他们从一种仅仅是粗暴的野兽的文明提升到了一个能够征服世界，几乎无法阻挡的威胁。
Cosmetic_Lore/4f162baff5be74118813c68b17: Mekboyz and Painboyz can get really collaborative. Mekboyz fashion combat walkers known as Deff Dreads, then the Painboyz work with them to wire ‘volunteers’ into the war engines.
机械男孩和疼痛男孩可以非常合作。机械男孩制作出被称为死亡无畏机甲的战斗步行机，然后疼痛男孩与他们一起将"志愿者"接入战争引擎。
Cosmetic_Lore/2a3fe395d36104b49a432e9867: The stars speak of what is to come. Reading them, Orikan has divined the future of the Necrons, and once they are in proper alignment, he will finally embrace his true destiny.
星星讲述了即将来临的事情。通过阅读它们，奥利坎预测了太空死灵的未来，一旦它们处于正确的排列，他将最终接受他的真正命运。
Cosmetic_Lore/7aa743e46193140b99ce2d208c: The words and actions of Chronomancers bear vast weight, as knowledge of the future flows through them. The future is fickle, but the stars will guide the Necrons to a new golden age.
时间巫师的言行具有巨大的重量，因为未来的知识通过他们流动。未来是变幻莫测的，但星星将引导太空死灵进入一个新的黄金时代。
Cosmetic_Lore/a226d246e95c7e74cbdd440328: Uncountable legions and war machines at their command, ready to devastate the enemy in the blink of an eye. Thus shall Necron Overlords reclaim the Galaxy.
无数的军团和战争机器在他们的指挥下，准备在一眨眼之间摧毁敌人。这样，太空死灵霸主将重新夺回银河系。
Cosmetic_Lore/2ad8b2ffef2909843a4b668a8b: Entombed for millions of years, the Necrons slumbered through the aeons. Now stirring back to life across the galaxy, their unstoppable Legions are rising.
埋葬了数百万年，太空死灵通过世纪的沉睡。现在在银河系各地回归生活，他们无法阻挡的军团正在崛起。
Cosmetic_Lore/11c7825d760a549b1a77afa2cf: Aeons ago, a great war against the Aeldari forced the Necrons into a period of slumber. Now it comes to an end, and so shall the ancient ruling dynasties be restored.
数千年前，一场对抗艾达灵族的大战迫使太空死灵进入了一段沉睡期。现在它结束了，古老的统治王朝将被恢复。
Cosmetic_Lore/fadc9fbad6cdd43d7920b228ce: Imotekh's aims to restore the Necron Empire to its former glory. Only when the dynasties are united as one will Necron dominance over inferior beings begin anew.
伊莫特克的目标是恢复太空死灵帝国的昔日辉煌。只有当王朝统一为一体时，太空死灵对劣等生物的统治才会重新开始。
Cosmetic_Lore/bd7bf781863747047af6841e33: After taking the thron from a nobility focused on their own petty squabbles, Imotekh shaped the destiny of his awakening dynasty, ensuring their dominance over the lesser races.
在从一个专注于自己小打小闹的贵族手中夺取王位后，伊莫特克塑造了他觉醒的王朝的命运，确保他们对低等种族的统治。
Cosmetic_Lore/3c4712a19b925b947b287eb099: The title of nemesor is a weighty one. Even after the strain of revivification, Zahndrekh still stands as one of the greatest Sautekh strategists, and a champion of its dynastic code.
复仇之王的头衔是一个沉重的。即使在复活的压力之后，扎恩德雷克仍然是索泰克最伟大的战略家之一，也是其王朝法典的捍卫者。
Cosmetic_Lore/Eldritch Technology: Through their advanced knowledge of science and technology, Necron Crypteks manipulate many of the universe's primordial forces to produce seemingly sorcerous effects.
通过他们对科学和技术的深入了解，太空死灵的墓穴技师操纵了宇宙的许多原始力量，产生了看似魔法的效果。
Cosmetic_Lore/f1e3c37fb1014f34eaca5297ea: The arrival of the Worldclaimer heralds certain doom to any foe. It is he who proclaims the death of worlds, and he who drives his spear through citizen and warrior alike.
世界宣告者的到来预示着任何敌人的必然灭亡。他宣告世界的死亡，他用长矛穿透公民和战士。
Cosmetic_Lore/Cardback_BL_Warlord_Sylar: True to his Word Bearers origins, Sylar's gift with words goes beyond mortal imagination. With his incantations, Hexscorn channels daemonic powers to those under his command.
忠于他的怀言者起源，希拉的言辞之才超越了凡人的想象。他的咒语，Hexscorn将恶魔的力量传递给他的指挥官。
Cosmetic_Lore/01544685e30e1404f848876965: The Black Legion was formed from the hosts of many warbands and warlords. All would swear allegiance to Abaddon, who leads them with absolute dominion.
黑色军团由许多战队和战将的主力组成。所有人都向阿巴顿宣誓忠诚，他以绝对的御天使领导他们。
Cosmetic_Lore/a6130240daaaf4af7b079763c5: The Eye of Terror became the sanctuary of the traitor Legions after the Horus Heresy, and a place for the Black Legion to gather its forces in preparation for a Black Crusade.
恐惧之眼在荷鲁斯之乱后成为叛乱军团的避难所，也是黑色军团为黑色远征准备力量的地方。
Cosmetic_Lore/e7a267fcb13b143d9be730d46f: From shame and shadow recast, in black and gold reborn. In Abaddon, the forces of Chaos saw a new Warmaster to lead them to claim the final victory they were denied so long ago.
从羞耻和阴影中重塑，在黑金中重生。在阿巴顿，混沌力量看到了一个新的战帅，带领他们赢得他们很久以前被剥夺的最后胜利。
Cosmetic_Lore/4a88f6f9845084243a85b4788d: The latest of Abaddon's Black Crusades ended with the destruction of Cadia and the opening of the Great Rift, a massive tear in reality that broke the Imperium in two.
阿巴顿的最新一次黑色远征以卡迪亚的毁灭和大裂隙的开启结束，这是一个巨大的现实撕裂，将帝国一分为二。
Cosmetic_Lore/39698f87c4307406a91a75f0f2: After the 13th Black Crusade, Abaddon became the master of the sundered half of Humanity's realm that was, he said, far more territory than Horus ever conquered and held.
在第13次黑色远征后，阿巴顿成为了人类领域被撕裂的一半的主人，他说，这比荷鲁斯曾经征服和控制的领土要多得多。
Cosmetic_Lore/ad33a531c4fd148e692d468023: There was a time in which the Eye of Horus represented the Emperor's eternal vigilance. Those days are long gone, and this is now a symbol of dread and despair.
曾经有一段时间，荷鲁斯之眼代表了帝皇的永恒警戒。那些日子已经过去，现在这是一个恐惧和绝望的象征。
Cosmetic_Lore/6d19c9a50023b466bb0b7b886e: Since the end of the Horus Heresy, Abaddon has gathered the scattered forces of Chaos under his banner. He is determined to claim vengeance against the False Emperor.
自荷鲁斯之乱结束以来，阿巴顿已经将混沌的散落力量集结在他的旗帜下。他决心对假帝皇进行复仇。
Cosmetic_Lore/ce5dee4adcae44ac0af2a4cd81: Anvirr's prescient abilities brought him to Vigilus, where he struck an unlikely alliance with Marneus Calgar to fend off a Chaos armada that threatened the future of the Aeldari.
安维尔的预知能力带他来到警戒星，他与马涅乌思·卡尔加结成了不太可能的联盟，以抵挡威胁艾达灵族未来的混沌舰队。
Cosmetic_Lore/4e16de39171fd694abc203deb6: Protector of the Craftworld, Ghaelyn has risen her spear against shadow and flame time and again, commanding Saim-Hann's forces in defence of Aeldari sanctuaries and Maiden Worlds.
方舟世界的保护者，盖琳一次又一次地举起她的长矛对抗阴影和火焰，指挥萨姆-罕的力量保卫艾达灵族的圣地和处女世界。
Cosmetic_Lore/00346e3d75a0542caad6ce7c2e: Each member of a Saim-Hann Wild Host longs to be the first into the fight, the one to claim first blood's glory. Nothing will stand between them and their quarry.
萨姆-罕野性骑士团的每个成员都渴望成为第一个参战的人，成为第一个获得初杀荣誉的人。没有什么能阻挡他们和他们的猎物之间。
Cosmetic_Lore/28f4d27a61ec48141a605c4f31: The stars are aligned, and the crimson moon tells the hour of blood and clashing blades has come. It is time for the Wild Host to rise and ride, time for the serpent to bite.
星星已经排列，深红的月亮告诉我们血和冲突的时刻已经到来。是时候让野性骑士团崛起，让蛇咬人了。
Cosmetic_Lore/03b783eb17b720049a6599a8ee: All Aeldari can manipulate psychic energies to a degree. Much of their wargear is crafted is empathically linked to the user, who can activate it with a mere thought.
所有艾达灵族都能在一定程度上操纵精神能量。他们的大部分战争装备都是与使用者有共感链接的，使用者只需一个念头就能激活它。
Cosmetic_Lore/1998a43474b9b4f1db66385ef5: Saim-Hann symbology is reminiscent of the Cosmic Serpent, the creature believed to exist in both the material and the psychic universes at the same time in Aeldari Myth.
萨姆-罕的象征符号让人想起宇宙灵蛇，这是艾达灵族神话中被认为同时存在于物质和精神宇宙的生物。
Cosmetic_Lore/a7a99d9d0a83f4ea38fd4e04f7: Nearly all Saim-Hann belong to a Wild Rider clan, who ride in jetbike squads comprised of blood relatives, sporting banners with their clan runes as they cut down enemy lines.
几乎所有的萨姆-罕都属于野性骑士氏族，他们骑着喷气摩托组成由血亲组成的小队，挥舞着带有他们氏族符文的旗帜，削减敌人的阵线。
Cosmetic_Lore/bdb5efa339d7648f99f536f488: It is a painful irony that, in the Aeldari's endless quest for survival, the very civilians the warhosts fight to protect are all too often forced to take up arms themselves.
艾达灵族为了生存的无尽追求中，痛苦的讽刺在于，那些战队努力保护的平民往往被迫自己拿起武器。
Cosmetic_Lore/8ce283b1ce71b934ba26a13b7e: With shocking agility and precision, the warhosts of Eliac Zephyrblade rain down like the spears of Khaine against the heart of those who dare harm the Craftworld.
以惊人的敏捷和精准，伊莱亚克·泽菲尔刃的战队如凯恩的矛一般对敢于伤害方舟世界的人心脏猛烈砸下。
Cosmetic_Lore/d85730406ecb7ae4aa5a2dc6a0: Psychic prowess made form, the Neurothrope acts not only as a synapse node, but as a pulsing psychic nexus, channeling eldritch forces to leech the life of its foes.
神经虫不仅作为突触节点，还作为脉动的心灵中心，将奇异的力量引导出来，吸取敌人的生命。
Cosmetic_Lore/Tervigon_cardback: Tervigons make sure that the onslaught never ends, awakening the dormant Termagants they carry in their abdomen, and tearing enemies apart with their claws.
母虫确保攻击永不停歇，唤醒它们腹部中携带的休眠枪虫，并用它们的爪子撕裂敌人。
Cosmetic_Lore/d496acee924da9b43a4b8465c3: The hardened chitin that frames the forms of the tyranids has proven unnaturally durable. Few can stop the swarm once it is determined to devour a planet.
泰伦虫族的坚硬外壳证明了其超自然的耐久性。一旦虫群决定吞噬一个星球，几乎无人能阻止。
Cosmetic_Lore/93c67074ca82af6479e076c0dc: Hive Fleet Leviathan has spread its tendrils through the Galaxy, ready to consume all in its path. All who encounter them fear that there is no stopping the Great Devourer.
利维坦虫巢舰队已经将其触须伸向了整个银河系，准备吞噬其路径上的一切。所有遇到它们的人都害怕无法阻止这个大吞噬者。
Cosmetic_Lore/8c4827eede62a294792b7f12e3: Settling like a vast and terrible pall across countless worlds, the Shadow in the Warp is a nightmarish phenomenon that heralds the coming of the Tyranid hive fleets.
亚空间阴影如同无尽世界上的巨大恐怖遮盖，这种噩梦般的现象预示着泰伦虫族虫巢舰队的到来。
Cosmetic_Lore/5e5a3707850a1424d8c3e37c1e: The Hive Mind is the gestalt collective consciousness of its species, an unfathomable intelligence created by the psychic presence of billions of Tyranids all connected to each other.
虫巢意志是其物种的集体意识，由数十亿泰伦虫族相互连接的心灵存在创造的无法理解的智慧。
Cosmetic_Lore/2f8b45278417f46e3839fd3df2: The Swarmlord's characteristic weapons can slice through adamantium and protective fields as if they were nothing. They lash out with such speed that few even get a chance to strike.
虫群领主的特征武器可以像切蛋糕一样切开金属钛和保护场，它们以如此快的速度挥舞，很少有人有机会反击。
Cosmetic_Lore/7e8f91335572d4d9f9e3aed036: A uniquely powerful galactic threat, the Swarmlord is the most powerful synapse creature ever known, undying and as old as the Tyranid species itself.
作为独特的强大银河威胁，虫群领主是已知最强大的突触节点生物，不朽且与泰伦虫族本身一样古老。
Cosmetic_Lore/e68b5a9369bd046f2b52990c0d: The first warning most worlds have of the Tyranids’ approach is the Shadow in the Warp. This psychic signal rolls ahead of the hive fleets like a smothering metaphysical fog bank.
大多数世界对泰伦虫族的接近的第一次警告就是亚空间阴影。这种心灵信号像一团压抑的超物质雾气一样在虫巢舰队前滚动。
Cosmetic_Lore/7217157ec22334963a7f6319f2: A Tyranid attack is a harrowing spectacle to behold. Vast swarms of ravenous monsters flow across the land, slaughtering all in their path.
泰伦虫族的攻击是一场令人惊骇的景象。大量的狂饿怪物在陆地上流动，屠杀他们路径上的所有生物。
Cosmetic_Lore/0159dae8f0883445d91630ab3d: From the darkness between the stars they flow, a tide of living nightmares. Their shadow is the funeral shroud of civilisations. Their hunger is the death of worlds.
他们从星星之间的黑暗中流淌出来，像活着的噩梦一样的潮汐。他们的阴影是文明的丧葬之衣。他们的饥饿是世界的死亡。
Cosmetic_Lore/93a7273d14f2d344f90326aec1: The T’au Sept is the blazing beacon for the light of the Greater Good and their greatest seat of culture and wisdom, as well as a byword for military excellence.
钛家门是上上善道之光的炽热信标，是他们最大的文化和智慧之座，也是军事优秀的代名词。
Cosmetic_Lore/7dc7ec31bbde93c46b1d3ca176: The XV8 Crisis provided the prototype chassis for several more advanced battlesuits, including the XV86 Coldstar with its trans-atmospheric flight capabilities.
XV8危机为包括具有跨大气层飞行能力的XV86冷星在内的几种更先进的战斗服提供了原型底盘。
Cosmetic_Lore/73a8d8e499d738842b23fd1424: Adherents of the T'au'va gladly expend incredible efforts, endure shocking hardships and lay down their lives without a second thought for the furtherance of the Greater Good.
钛帝国的信徒愿意付出巨大的努力，忍受惊人的困难，甚至毫不犹豫地献出生命，以推进上上善道。
Cosmetic_Lore/720fe6502305226459ad969a30: The T'au believe the message of the Greater Good must be brought to all, so they keep growing their empire’s borders and establishing new colonised systems called septs.
钛帝国认为上上善道的信息必须传达给所有人，所以他们不断扩大帝国的边界，建立新的殖民系统，称为门派。
Cosmetic_Lore/2270b106eb7a6452482f2d3b3c: Developed in secret upon J'ka'vo Station and each piloted by a handpicked Shas'vre, Ghostkeel Battlesuits embarked upon numerous covert operations before their official unveiling
在J'ka'vo站秘密开发，并由精选的Shas'vre驾驶，鬼船战斗服在正式公开前执行了许多秘密行动。
Cosmetic_Lore/f3dcb065881bf4261b052056c5: The Kroot are warlike and bloodthirsty warriors. Although their primitive aggression is viewed with distaste by the T’au, such inherent savagery makes them effective shock troops.
克鲁特人是好战且嗜血的战士。尽管他们的原始侵略性被塔乌人视为不齿，但这种内在的野蛮使他们成为有效的冲锋军队。
Cosmetic_Lore/615d06d10507c47a084e8622b3: The Ethereal Caste stand apart from their people. They rule the T’au as a wise and patient adult might guide spirited, wayward youths to realise their truest potential.
以太氏族与他们的人民保持距离。他们像明智而耐心的成年人引导活力四溢、任性的青年，帮助他们实现自己的最大潜力。
Cosmetic_Lore/f1fdacf1c12e9470c80d9a3984: Shadowsun has rendered the advanced XV22 Stalker Battlesuit iconic, becoming so adroit at operating it that it is to her now like an armoured second skin.
影阳使先进的XV22潜行者战斗服成为了标志性的装备，她操作它的技巧如此娴熟，以至于现在对她来说，它就像是一副装甲的第二层皮肤。
Cosmetic_Lore/025b325b599140545881b35521: The Galaxy is merciless. If one seeks to survive its dangers, one must be prepared to overcome countless challenges. Will you withstand the whims of fate?
银河系是无情的。如果一个人想要在其危险中生存，就必须准备好克服无数的挑战。你能否抵挡命运的变幻莫测？
Cosmetic_Lore/7a271100b5470fc499aecec0fe: Every advancement in warfare requires a proper field test, and those willing to aid in pushing the boundaries of what is possible will rise in the Omnissiah's grace.
每一次战争的进步都需要一个适当的实地测试，那些愿意帮助推动可能性边界的人将在欧姆尼塞亚的恩典中崛起。
Cosmetic_Lore/a0807721214944548b08c70715: History is ruled by cause and effect. The ripples sent by events from eras long gone can still be felt all through the Galaxy. Will your deeds also echo through eternity?
历史由因果主宰。来自很久以前的事件所产生的涟漪，仍然可以在整个银河系中感觉到。你的行为是否也会在永恒中回响？
Cosmetic_Lore/b30a1171734b4f94dad7b25b0a: Some traitors have given themselves entirely to the service of the Dark Gods, and they are so lost to damnation that they barely resemble the warriors they once were.
有些叛徒已完全投身于黑暗诸神的服务，他们如此深陷诅咒，几乎无法辨认出他们曾经的战士身份。
Cosmetic_Lore/157ce8648a96841d58c11db83f: The Dark Apostle’s prayers fill his followers’ hearts with hatred as they lash out with fanatical strength to tear down their foes in the Dark Gods’ names.
黑暗使徒的祷告充满了他的追随者们的心，他们以狂热的力量发泄出的仇恨，以黑暗诸神的名义撕裂他们的敌人。
Cosmetic_Lore/8a999641784294846a1994ae16: The Warp exists as a source of both limitless power and eternal damnation. Such power has ever tempted the unwary, the desperate and the ambitious into its bottomless depths.
亚空间存在为无尽的力量和永恒的诅咒的源泉。这样的力量总是诱惑着那些不谨慎的，绝望的和有野心的人进入其无底的深渊。
Cosmetic_Lore/f575d0adc7643044ebf30a1ee0: The most tainted conjurations can be achieved with daemonic energy. Sorcerers may have been psykers from birth; others may be warriors granted such power by a daemonic patron.
最邪恶的召唤可以通过恶魔能量实现。巫师可能从诞生开始就是灵能者；也可能是由恶魔赞助者赋予这种力量的战士。
Cosmetic_Lore/20b8d9bd938ca416e9be525def: The Sisters of the Order of Our Martyred Lady are the deliverers of the God-Emperor’s holy justice, the dreaded instruments of his will to whom no sacrifice is too great.
殉教圣女修会的修女们是神皇圣洁正义的拯救者，是他的意志的可怕工具，对他们来说，没有什么牺牲是过大的。
Cosmetic_Lore/62d30ba80bf9740ffa8ac1f638: For the Adepta Sororitas the act of fighting in defence of their faith, against the foul heretics that would tear it down, is itself deemed a hallowed honour.
对于修女会来说，为了保卫他们的信仰而战斗，对抗那些想要摧毁它的邪恶异端，本身就被视为一种神圣的荣誉。
Cosmetic_Lore/5345067aa66d246d19a1b9a807: The Adepta Sororitas are a crusading military force that crushes the enemies of the Imperial Creed wherever they fester, illuminating the Emperor’s realm as a beacon of faith.
修女会是一支十字军军队，粉碎帝国信仰的敌人，无论他们在哪里滋生，都会照亮帝皇的领域，成为信仰的灯塔。
Cosmetic_Lore/6223abdbc44354f5a9781faba2: It is said that the blood of martyrs is the seed of the Imperium. Where it falls, repugnance and vengeance blossom, and the furious reprisals of the faithful thrive.
据说，殉道者的血是帝国的种子。在它落下的地方，厌恶和复仇星盛开，信徒们的狂怒反击蓬勃发展。
Cosmetic_Lore/afa4c23d5227f4ef0b28555326: In the sepulchre of battle, they are the God-Emperor’s holiest warriors. In the reliquary of war, where saints are made and faith burns brightest, they are His will made manifest.
在战斗的墓穴中，他们是神皇最神圣的战士。在战争的圣物库中，圣人诞生，信仰最明亮，他们是他的意志的体现。
Cosmetic_Lore/720b3f712a9ab4c868dedafa3f: Shapers instinctively recognise desirable or detrimental biological traits in defeated foes, guiding their kindred's evolution and adaptation to future challenges.
克鲁特人拥有一种变形生物学，使他们能够从他们吞噬的肉体中吸收遗传特征。塑形者对这种能力有一种本能的理解，以及如何最好地利用它。
Cosmetic_Lore/c8511ef03cb3643f2ae063114b: Necrons replaced their fleshly weakness with enduring forms of living metal aeons ago. However, the biotransference also devoid most Necrons of their free will.
太空死灵在亿万年前就用生命金属的坚韧形态替换了他们肉体的弱点。然而，生物质转移也剥夺了大部分太空死灵的自由意志。
Cosmetic_Lore/ff53e1ae017a94f6c97500128c: The Emperor protects the faithful from the corruption that lurks in the darkness. It is under His light that the Sororitas are driven onwards with indomitable will.
帝皇保护信徒免受潜伏在黑暗中的腐败。在他的光辉下，修女们以坚不可摧的意志向前推进。
Cosmetic_Lore/3a86cc6953a134976ac150dcd2: Declared by the reigning ecclesiarch of the Adeptus Ministorum, Wars of Faith are often called to seek the conquest of new territory or purge Heretics to the Imperial Creed.
由国教教会现任教皇宣布，信仰之战通常是为了寻求新领土的征服或清除帝国信仰的异端。
Cosmetic_Lore/8a0eca8154ca942c7857247242: The tenets of the Orders joyously proclaim the blood of martyrs is the life force of the Imperium, making the sacrifice of their fallen Sisters shine brightest in the darkest hour.
教团的教条欢快地宣告，殉道者的鲜血是帝国的生命力，使他们堕落的姐妹在最黑暗的时刻最为耀眼。
Cosmetic_Lore/aa39227f9a6ac4f4faf32396f8: After the defeat of the Old Ones, when the C’tan were at their weakest following that titanic conflict, the Necrons took their revenge, shattering and imprisoning the duplicitous star gods.
在古圣被击败后，在那场巨大战斗中，C'tan最虚弱的时候，太空死灵进行了复仇，粉碎并囚禁了狡诈的星神。
Cosmetic_Lore/8839fdffe7d884231b012b6c9c: Chaplains are fiery, strict and quickly roused to anger by the hated enemy. For all their grim demeanour, Chaplains care deeply for the spiritual well-being of their brothers.
牧师们性格火爆、严厉，面对仇敌时容易愤怒。尽管他们外表严肃，牧师们却非常关心战友们的精神健康。
Cosmetic_Lore/2e1f53753d20e40c88fe3fd3e3: Battle Companies are frequently split into two demi-companies each under the direct command of a Lieutenant, an extremely able tactician and highly skilled warrior.
战斗连队经常被分成两个半连队，每个半连队由一名副官直接指挥，他是一位极其出色的战术家和高超的战士。
Cosmetic_Lore/ab8893df4dcd94f15aebba75d1: Bolt weapons have been synonymous with the Space Marines since before even the Great Crusade. Countless foes have been laid low by their explosive rounds, known as bolts.
自大远征之前，爆矢武器就与星际战士密不可分。无数敌人被其爆炸弹药击倒，这些弹药被称为爆矢。
Cosmetic_Lore/31c29daf78ea94650ae17060d4: To the 4th Company falls the duty of defending wider Ultramar from the predations of the countless heretics, aliens and monstrosities who would see it torn down in flames.
第四连队肩负着保卫整个奥特拉玛的职责，抵御无数异端、外星人和怪物的掠夺，他们企图将其焚毁殆尽。
Cosmetic_Lore/ff7a28d20c2144d498b0cec80a: Proud allies of the T'au Empire, the Kroot's rustic equipment and savage countenance perfectly depict their fearsome skill in combat.
作为钛帝国的骄傲盟友，克鲁特人粗犷的装备和野蛮的外表完美地展现了他们在战斗中的可怕技能。
Cosmetic_Lore/a9e3cc532f23540b382d22b2b5: "Give praise to the Star Children! Give praise to the Master Below! Give praise for deliverance, and freedom, and ascension!"
赞美星辰之子！赞美下界之主！赞美解放，赞美自由，赞美升华！
Cosmetic_Lore/88ceeb0da80644dedb4da5c310: Genestealer Cults are dominated by a Patriarch via the synaptic link known as Broodmind. As the Cult grows, its Broodmind becomes a psychic beacon for the Tyranid hive.
基因窃取者教团由通过称为群体心灵的突触链接统治。随着教团的壮大，其群体心灵成为泰伦虫族巢都的心灵灯塔。
Cosmetic_Lore/77d930a9c218245628b141b082: In shadow they lurk, insidious, patient. Day by day they spread their curse. They syphon strength and dig their tendrils ever deeper, until by their word blood and horror unfolds.
他们在阴影中潜伏，狡猾而耐心。日复一日，他们传播诅咒。吸取力量，深入根须，直至血与惧妖在他们的命令下展开。
Cosmetic_Lore/2a636673290f84c30abc167d67: Each gene-sect spontaneously spawns remarkable individuals with focused skills whose presence smoothens the road to ascension, each moulded by the world and culture it parasitises.
每个基因窃取者教团自发产生具有专长的杰出个体，他们的存在使升华之路更加顺畅，每个个体都被其寄生的世界和文化所塑造。
Cosmetic_Lore/03297b907d9ad4e2d92c666c1b: Since the first infection, successive generations will be born within the cult. Offspring born to the fourth generation are Purestrain Genestealers that will start the cycle anew.
自首次感染以来，后续几代将在教团内出生。第四代出生的后代是纯种基因窃取者，他们将重新开始循环。
Cosmetic_Lore/1a034a1aa10f74019a0c0b0936: Through cunning and fortune, Genestealer Cults send their questing tendrils writhing into even the highest ranks of the military forces that should be standing guard against it.
通过狡诈和幸运，基因窃取者教团将其探索的触须伸入本应防范它们的最高军事力量中。
Cosmetic_Lore/d6d3c3ed3b50f4d47be60b1676: As the uprising bursts out, the Patriarch leaves its throne amidst its bubbling genesis pools and emerges from the shadows. The monstrous, parasitic demigod leads the final assault.
随着起义爆发，虫群族长离开了它那沸腾的起源之池中的王座，从阴影中现身。这位怪物般的寄生半神领导了最后的攻击。
Cosmetic_Lore/e4bcfea580c6f4e0c964a9e002: Offspring born to the fourth generation are Purestrain Genestealers. Their parents perceive their nightmare progeny as blessed cherubs, and would die for them in a heartbeat.
第四代出生的后代是纯种基因窃取者。他们的父母将这些噩梦般的后代视为受祝福的智天使，并愿意为他们瞬间献身。
Cosmetic_Lore/36713faf5303e4b84bee1b9382: The people of the craftworlds adhere to a set of strictures known as the Path, or the Ai’elethra, mastering their whims through the rigid emotional discipline of the Path.
方舟世界的人民遵循一套被称为之道或Ai’elethra的严格规定，通过之道的严格情感纪律掌握他们的心愿。
Cosmetic_Lore/d035f8bda909a7c48805e63f14: Meks are driven to constantly tinker and experiment with new ideas. They will gladly do kustom jobs for other Orks in return for payment in teef or looted scrap.
技师们总是被驱使着不断修补和试验新点子。他们乐意为其他欧克蛮人做定制工作，以换取牙齿或掠夺来的废料作为报酬。
Cosmetic_Lore/8e4b4efbe6e8a415cba9b13bb1: A skilled warrior on the battlefield, Titus' duty often sets him against impossible odds, with only his fury, resolve, and honed fighting abilities seeing him through.
作为战场上的熟练战士，Titus的职责常常让他面对不可能的困难，只有他的愤怒，决心和磨练的战斗能力才能让他挺过来。
Cosmetic_Lore/77912dd31c92945faaeb0a2802: Due to their failure to protect the dynastic codes by the end of the War in Heaven, Triarch Praeotrians were charged to watch over the slumbering tomb worlds during the Great Sleep.
由于在天堂之战结束时未能保护王朝法典，三圣 Praeotrians 被指派在大休眠期间监视沉睡的墓穴世界。
Cosmetic_Lore/6a6ff0d48d93d44d2859721234: Ramatekh exudes a soul-sapping presence. The promise of life’s end is so explicit in its chilling gaze that few can muster the strength of will to evade it.
Ramatekh散发出吸魂的气息。生命终结的承诺在其冰冷的凝视中如此明确，以至于很少有人能够鼓起意志来避开它。
Cosmetic_Lore/4863c233255824be0865f3a2f3: Crypteks amass whole armies of artificial constructs and soulless soldiery to achieve their goal. Blindly loyal followers, these automata are guided by their masters’ ancient genius.
墓穴技师集结整个人工构造物和无魂士兵的军队来实现他们的目标。这些自动机是由他们主人的旗手天才引导的，忠诚无比。
Cosmetic_Lore/36b5d4b20d19b4b95bf1645e36: Regiments and their worlds of origin glorify the noble victories, last stands and epic crusades of their warriors by embroiding them in glorious, awe inspiring tapestries.
各团及其起源世界通过绣制光荣、令人敬畏的挂毯，赞美他们的战士们的贵族胜利、最后的阵地和史诗般的十字军东征。
Cosmetic_Lore/94cae131318c741d191eacd4a9: The Imperium is faced with many horrors. The soldiers of the Astra Militarum are the Hammer of the Emperor, and by their deeds shall the enemies of Mankind be destroyed.
帝国面临着许多惧妖。星界军的士兵是帝皇之锤，他们的行为将摧毁人类的敌人。
Cosmetic_Lore/8f363b5dce42e486b8cdbee6d8: Obliterating the enemies of the Imperium with explosive shells, armoured regiments are a punishingly effective and sometimes excessive response to invasion and insurrection.
用爆炸性的炮弹消灭帝国的敌人，装甲团是对入侵和起义的有效且有时过度的回应。
Cosmetic_Lore/6edc0c2f2e1c64dfe92a272bab: They are the grist upon which the Imperium’s war machine turns. They are the anvil upon which victories are forged. They are the shield behind which Humanity shall endure.
他们是帝国战争机器的磨粉。他们是锻造胜利的铁砧。他们是人类将要忍受的盾牌。
Cosmetic_Lore/c0b627430bc2441cba8a08e0df: During The Forging, as systems were brought into the Imperial fold, the Shock Troops of Cadia imparted their discipline and military doctrine to the leaders of newly colonised worlds.
在锻造时期，当各个星系被纳入帝国的版图时，卡迪亚的震撼军队将他们的纪律和军事教条传授给新殖民世界的领导者。
Cosmetic_Lore/2bdbc34b00b4a4fa981e2ac646: With rifle, cannon and Human grit they throw back nightmarish horrors. They are the soldiers of the Astra Militarum, and in their unrecorded deaths is unsullied duty made manifest.
他们用步枪、大炮和人类的勇气抵挡着噩梦般的惧妖。他们是星界军的士兵，他们无名的死亡是职责的纯洁体现。
Cosmetic_Lore/955b921880373466895f6ba0cd: The Galaxy is merciless, yet the fearless few rise to claim their place in it. Given to those who commanded their decks to victory during the Early Access stage of Warpforge
银河系是无情的，但无畏的少数人却在其中占据了一席之地。这是给予那些在Warpforge早期访问阶段指挥他们的卡组取得胜利的人。
Cosmetic_Lore/8df6039b8366b4df29b2bda5ac: Cadians have faith in Humanity's strength, yet they rely not solely on prayers for salvation. In their darkest hour, they face evil not pleading, but firing their weapon to the bitter end.
卡迪亚人对人类的力量有着坚定的信念，然而他们并不完全依赖祈祷来寻求救赎。在他们最黑暗的时刻，他们并不是乞求，而是坚持到底，用他们的武器对抗邪恶。
Cosmetic_Lore/bb05e0699311043619fb32c2c2: Most Asuryani eventually join the war voluntarily. Known as Warrior Aspects, each branch of the Path has its own unique fighting style and reflects a unique facet of the god Khaine.
大多数的阿苏瑞安尼最终会自愿加入战争。被称为战士面相的他们，每个之道的分支都有其独特的战斗风格，并反映出凯恩神的独特面貌。
Cosmetic_Lore/122dfb3eeed2f4fadb7e1a9f45: Howling Banshees announce their arrival with a blood-chilling scream amplified by their Banshee masks, inflicting severe damage to the central nervous systems of their foes.
狂嚎女妖通过他们的女妖面具放大了血腥的尖叫声，宣告他们的到来，对敌人的中枢神经系统造成严重伤害。
Cosmetic_Lore/214575caf49da4d58aa0cca724: When Asurmen raised the original Aspect Warriors he became the first of the Asurya. First to learn under his tutelage was Jain Zar, an Aeldari swordmaiden famed for her speed and ferocity.
当阿苏门创立原始的支派武士时，他成为了第一位阿苏亚。首位在他的指导下学习的是詹·扎尔，一个因其速度和凶残而闻名的艾达灵族剑女。
Cosmetic_Lore/6dd028e7321f74d2b91c0f4e95: The Human race bears deep scars upon their collective psyche from the Age of Strife. Mankind survived its ravages fragmented and desperate, emerging as a species much changed.
人类种族在纷争纪元中对他们的集体心理留下了深海般的伤疤。人类在其破坏之后生存下来，分裂且绝望，作为一个发生了巨变的物种浮现出来。
Cosmetic_Lore/d8b0712ffa6ac4816b368df535: Wreathed in holy light and possessed of divine serenity, the Sisters of the Sacred Rose are the calm at the centre of a violent storm.
笼罩在神圣之光中，拥有神圣的宁静，神圣玫瑰修女就是暴风雨中心的宁静。
Cosmetic_Lore/91c8ec5ae270540baa70539a6c: Sisters of the Sacred Rose reflect the serene demeanor of their Matriarch, Arabella, renowned for her calm nature even in the face of horror.
神圣玫瑰修女会的修女们体现了她们的修女长阿拉贝拉的安详风度，即使面对惧妖，她的冷静自然也享有盛名。
Cosmetic_Lore/3e64d968f780247e7af36b11d5: The Orders of the Adepta Sororitas are divided amongst the Convent Sanctorum, based on Ophelia VII, and the Convent Prioris, which was built within the Ecclesiarchal Palace upon Holy Terra.
修女会的各个教团分布在至圣修道院，该修道院位于欧菲利亚VII，以及在神圣泰拉的国教宫内建造的Prioris修道院。
Cosmetic_Lore/Bastion of Defiance: The Adepta Sororitas execute anyone who expresses doubt in the security of the Imperium. The Sisters of the Sacred Rose have fought the enemies of the faith with resoluteness of spirit.
修女会处决任何对帝国安全表示怀疑的人。神圣玫瑰修女会的修女们以坚定的精神与信仰的敌人战斗。
Cosmetic_Lore/Thorn of the White Rose: A revered relic sword once held by Saint Arabella herself, Aveline Aboyé now wields the Thorn of the White Rose with resolve against the foes she was sworn to vanquish.
一把由圣女阿拉贝拉亲自持有的尊敬的遗物剑，现在阿维琳·阿博耶誓言用白玫瑰的刺对她发誓要消灭的敌人坚决使用。
Cosmetic_Lore/5444eb5a887894df98174dc11c: The Adeptus Astartes are heavily augmented post-humans; products of years of arduous training, agonising surgery and psycho-indoctrination which not all inductees will survive.
阿斯塔特修会是经过重度增强的后人类；他们是多年艰苦训练、痛苦手术和心理灌输的产物，不是所有的新兵都能活下来。
Cosmetic_Lore/3a52a1dbb87d9444ca791dc1c7: The towering storm shields of the Bladeguard are the work of many generations of serfs, and the force field generators they contain protect the bearer’s soul as much as their flesh.
剑卫的高大风暴盾是许多世代农奴的作品，他们包含的力场发生器保护着持有者的灵魂，就像保护他们的肉体一样。
Cosmetic_Lore/92cc97b002556e94383fd6fc91: Among the bloody fates of a Chaos champion is internment in the sarcophagus of a Helbrute, a looming engine of carnage with the firepower of a tank and the bloodlust of a daemon.
混沌冠军的血腥命运之一是被困在地狱兽的棺柩中，这是一个满载杀戮的巨大引擎，拥有坦克的火力和恶魔的嗜血。
Cosmetic_Lore/14eb655dd2c264a7b867d3eab9: On every tier of their Chapter’s organisation the Dark Angels have a baffling array of ancient rites and traditions led by the Dark Angels Chaplains, such as the Feast of Malediction.
在他们战团的每个级别上，黑暗天使都有一系列令人困惑的古老仪式和传统，由黑暗天使的牧师领导，如诅咒之宴。
Cosmetic_Lore/c2b81705207264292b4282fde3: Rededicated to serving the Imperium after eluding its heavy scrutiny, the Dark Angels enacted a plan to ensure the Legion survived. No one could doubt their resolve or commitment.
在成功躲过帝国的严格审查后，黑暗天使发起了一项计划，以确保军团的生存。没有人能怀疑他们的决心或承诺。
Cosmetic_Lore/4bb6052bda1e347169b96028bc: Believing their traitorous brothers perished in Caliban’s destruction, Dark Angels Librarians later discovered the psychic signatures of the Fallen, revealing they still lived.
黑暗天使智库原以为他们的叛逆兄弟在卡利班的毁灭中死去，后来发现了堕天使的精神签名，揭示他们仍然活着。
Cosmetic_Lore/d23ac5f803b6e42e79c530aa58: After the destruction of Caliban, the Dark Angels thought themselves to be wholly guilty, and that should anyone learn of what had occurred, the First Legion would be declared Excommunicate Traitoris.
在卡利班被毁后，黑暗天使认为自己完全有罪，如果有人了解到发生的事情，第一军团将被宣布为异端审判。
Cosmetic_Lore/382a1e9de704a43ebb338c1497: Since the times of the Great Crusade, the sons of Caliban have been at the forefront of some of the galaxy’s most significant wars, and have bled their foes in numerous war zones.
自大远征时代以来，卡利班的子民一直在银河系的一些最重要的战争中处于前沿，他们在众多战区中让敌人流血。
Cosmetic_Lore/66af0182f781f45d2bbce1d0b8: The Dark Angels’ deepest history is shrouded in mystery, not merely due to being thousands of years in the past, but also by Dark Angels’ Masters and Veterans deliberately obscuring it.
黑暗天使的深层历史被神秘所笼罩，不仅仅是因为它在几千年前，而且还因为黑暗天使的主人和老兵故意模糊了它。
Cosmetic_Lore/ac8bf09615211453c9a95d6ad9: The proud warriors of the Dark Angels stubbornly refuse to accept defeat. Descendants of the First Legion, they stand foremost amongst the Space Marine Chapters.
黑暗天使的骄傲战士们坚决拒绝接受失败。作为第一军团的后裔，他们在星际战士战团中处于最前沿。
Cosmetic_Lore/fdab864c577a741a79184cff25: The Dark Angels outfit their entire 1st Company – the Deathwing – with Terminator armour, lightning-wreathed power weapons and towering relic shields.
黑暗天使将他们的整个第一公司 - 死翼 - 配备了终结者装甲，闪电环绕的能量武器和高耸的遗物盾牌。
Cosmetic_Lore/2df44fb813d7949e1b62bf8e6b: The Dark Angels were the First Legion. No other Space Marine brotherhood has served the Emperor for as long as they have. Staunch defenders of Mankind, they are merciless in the attack and stubborn in the defence.
黑暗天使是第一个军团。没有其他的星际战士兄弟会像他们一样长时间地为帝皇服务。他们是人类的坚定防御者，在攻击中无情，在防御中顽强。
Cosmetic_Lore/e478cbe92a66d2a4e82d6e371e: Foremost in the Jackal's efforts is the Jackal Alphus. They possess the constitution to travel for days, planning and executing the perfect shot to eliminate key targets.
豺狼的努力中，豺狼猎首最为突出。他们有足够的体质能够连续行走数日，策划并执行完美的一击，消灭关键目标。
Cosmetic_Lore/d42693522703fbd4e86ffec0e1: Whether hewing riches from hellish pits or toiling in forges, the faithful have become experts in handling the outsized industrial tools they now wield as weapons.
无论是在地狱深渊中开采财富，还是在锻造厂中辛勤劳作，信徒们已经成为了操纵他们现在作为武器的超大型工业工具的专家。
Cosmetic_Lore/581bbc789cd2841dcb47af807f: The Patriarch's telepathic urging implants the true goal in its broodkin: breach enemy lines and amass vital military intelligence. Then, the cult wreaks havoc with contrived wreckage.
族长的心灵催促将真正的目标植入其巢族：突破敌人的防线并收集重要的军事情报。然后，教派用精心设计的破坏引发浩劫。
Cosmetic_Lore/bd0a1ce41e072f84196212c05c: Shock assault troops without peer, Tempestus Scions are elite soldiers used to enact missions that the regular Imperial Guard cannot accomplish alone.
无与伦比的冲锋军队，忠嗣暴风兵是精英士兵，用于执行常规帝国卫队无法独立完成的布道所。
Cosmetic_Lore/0b417a7101a7ec2468bde77345: From youth, Tempestus Scions are indoctrinated on loyalty and the swift execution of their duties. They possess the tenacity to undertake the toughest missions and get the job done.
从年轻时起，忠嗣暴风兵就被灌输忠诚和迅速执行职责的教义。他们具有承担最艰难布道所并完成任务的坚韧。
Cosmetic_Lore/102b9cf81de79a04fb0eb85425: Aquilons are trained to drop right into the thick of fighting. Their extensive conditioning allows them to stay focused even during the most ferocious insertions.
阿奎隆被训练成直接投入战斗的中心。他们的广泛训练使他们即使在最猛烈的插入中也能保持专注。
Cosmetic_Lore/3496c2b3092a697418c2e5b6ce: Some Orks are driven to leave their tribes and explore the wilds. Isolated Ork enclaves often devolve to a more primitive state and taken to squig-breeding, becoming Beast Snaggas.
一些欧克蛮人被驱使离开他们的部落，探索荒野。孤立的欧克蛮人飞地经常退化到更原始的状态，并开始养跳跳，成为豢兽师。
Cosmetic_Lore/c04b5a9bbfefbc64e9f24a236a: The untameable squig; the Badbeast of Skrapmud– Big Chompa became Mozrog’s steed with a reputation for being the meanest and most savage creature ever to crawl from the drops.
难以驯服的跳跳；斯克拉普泥的恶兽——大嘴成为莫兹罗格的坐骑，以最凶残、最野蛮的生物的名声从滴落中爬出来。
Cosmetic_Lore/8bfe6000c1695cc499513c9b5b: Swallowed whole, half-digested, yet still krumpin', Mozrog Skragbad doesn't just hunt beasts. With an impressive tally of trophies, he is always driven to seek bigger quarry.
整个吞下，半消化，但仍在猛击，莫兹罗格·斯夸格巴德不仅狩猎野兽。他有一堆令人印象深刻的战利品，总是驱使他寻找更大的猎物。
Cosmetic_Lore/593a2f0238d3db84697734bc07: Beast Snaggas breed countless varieties of squigs: squigs for riding; squigs for eating; squigs from which to squeeze oil; squigs to send with hastily scrawled message glyphs...
豢兽师养了无数种跳跳：骑行的跳跳；吃的跳跳；可以挤出油的跳跳；带着草率涂鸦的信息符文的跳跳...
Cosmetic_Lore/9c2d633987ed5b346bd9ae09ec: Dangerous and unstable, Wurrboys are treated like oracles. Rarely lucid, they rant about visions of prey and lose themselves in the senses of their warband’s squigs.
危险且不稳定，战争小子被当作神谕对待。他们很少清醒，他们咆哮着对猎物的幻觉，并在他们的战队的跳跳的感觉中失去自我。
Cosmetic_Lore/325fc8c467671664eab5b5e789: After ten millennia, the fractured Emperor's Children still prey upon the galaxy in vibrant warbands of imperious skill, extravagant firepower, and ruinous desires.
经过一万年，破碎的帝皇之子们仍以充满活力的战队在银河系中猎食，他们拥有傲慢的技巧、令人颤栗的火力和毁灭性的欲望。
Cosmetic_Lore/e04e12af3e5c44e43ae207fdf2: Warfare is a blood-drenched art. Each battle is a fresh canvas upon which the superiority of Fulgrim's scions is depicted in gore, viscera and the agonised screams of the enemy.
战争是一种浴血的艺术。每一场战斗都是一块新的画布，福格瑞姆的子嗣们在其中以血肉、内脏和敌人的痛苦尖叫描绘出他们的优越性。
Cosmetic_Lore/ec62d809069212c4da18d66eb8: The Emperor's Children's ingrained desire for sensation in all its forms sees them move rapidly across the battlefield to satiate their never-ending hunger for fresh experience.
帝皇之子们对各种形式感觉的根深蒂固的渴望使他们在战场上迅速移动，以满足他们对新体验的无尽渴望。
Cosmetic_Lore/d04c7f75ae146f348a268b6188: When the Emperor's Children go to war, it is to the excruciating shriek of an array of outlandish sonic weaponry that splinters reality and rasps at the nerves of all who hear it.
当帝皇之子们去战斗时，他们会发出一种奇特的音波武器的剧烈尖叫，这种武器会分裂现实，让所有听到的人都感到神经紧张。
Cosmetic_Lore/787e1f4231db5624596d30b65d: Excess and obsession are the domains of Slaanesh. Unfulfilled desires and compulsive dreams are the cracks through which Slaanesh whispers' slip, luring mortals into their worship.
过度和迷恋是色孽的领域。未满足的欲望和强迫性的梦想是色孽的耳语滑过的裂缝，引诱凡人加入他们的崇拜。
Cosmetic_Lore/10aa4a5f577a64c48a8d829d9f: Born of Fulgrim’s gene-seed, the III Legion sought perfection in war. Hardened by a lifetime of ceaseless conflict, their pursuit of excellence slid into excess and damnation.
福格瑞姆的基因种子孕育出了第三军团，他们在战争中寻求完美。经过无尽冲突的磨砺，他们对卓越的追求滑向了过度和诅咒。
Cosmetic_Lore/d47d44300708e144b823257cf6: The Emperor's Children pursue exotic essences to feed their obsessions. Found in flesh, mind, and soul, they harvest torment to distill exquisite substances.
帝皇的孩子们追求异国精华以满足他们的痴迷。他们在肉体、心灵和灵魂中寻找，收割折磨以提炼出精致的物质。
Cosmetic_Lore/d0fbb5e4d784c5447b2be11697: Seeking to commit ever more depraved atrocities to fulfill their monstrous desires, a warband's warriors may flay the skin from their victims with sharp blades or scintillating empyric sorcery.
寻求犯下更多堕落的暴行以满足他们的怪物般的欲望，战队的战士可能会用锐利的刀刃或闪耀的帝国魔法剥去他们受害者的皮肤。
Cosmetic_Lore/f747d3ee0d1947f468ca95fd18: Whether bending a daemon to their will or dominating an enemy champion, Lord Exultants revel in displaying their superiority and expose their foe's unforgivable flaws.
无论是弯曲恶魔以服从他们的意志，还是统治敌人的冠军，尊贵的领主都喜欢展示他们的优越性，并暴露出敌人的不可饶恕的缺陷。
Cosmetic_Lore/2943adeaca3b34b1d8369f0d8e: Lhykhis embodies Khaine's willingness to risk all to defeat the foe. She is amongst the most active Phoenix Lords, travelling far and wide in defence of the Asuryani.
利基斯体现了凯恩冒险一切以击败敌人的决心。她是最活跃的凤凰领主之一，为保护阿苏里亚尼而远行。
Cosmetic_Lore/5948a203c21d94e6690d67f67e: Warp Spiders brave the Warp to defend the living, just as the tiny warp creatures to which they owe their name materialise near the Infinite Circuit to protect the dead.
次元蜘蛛勇敢地穿越亚空间来保护生者，就像他们的名字来源于的微小亚空间生物在无尽电路附近物化来保护死者一样。
Cosmetic_Lore/112ff27688d4a432c8222fcff9: The souls that pilot Asuryani wraith constructs experience reality as a dream, where their thoughts, feelings, and those of other Aeldari are as tangible as steel.
驾驶阿苏里亚尼幽冥构造体的灵魂将现实视为梦境，在那里他们的思想、感情以及其他艾达灵族的感觉都像钢铁一样实在。
Cosmetic_Lore/c699844f5ce03db488bfaa998d: The proud warriors of the Dark Angels stubbornly refuse to accept defeat. Descendants of the First Legion, they stand foremost amongst the Space Marine Chapters.
黑暗天使的骄傲战士们坚决拒绝接受失败。作为第一军团的后裔，他们在星际战士战团中处于最前沿。
Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat0: The hour of blood and clashing blades has come.
血与刀剑交击的时刻已经来临。
Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat1: I am tested time and time again and yet I prevail.

Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat10: Each one of your vile deeds begets a dire consequence.
你们每一次恶行都会带来严重的后果。
Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat11: There is always a way. I always find it.
总有一条路。我总能找到。
Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat12: Never engage in a battle if you have not seen the outcome
如果你没有看到结果，就不要参与战斗。
Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat13: I know what it is to lose everything, and I shall not falter.
我知道失去一切是什么感觉，我不会动摇。
Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat14: You walk a path that leads to your own ruin.
你走的路将导致你自己的毁灭。
Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat4: Come warriors, our salvation lies not here.

Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat6: Your doom is close, I have foreseen it.

Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat8: Although stained red, I must walk this path.

Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat9: I could not be broken before, and I will not be broken now.

Chat_Messages/ASH1-Chat0-UM48: Your kind still has many crimes to answer for.

Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat1: Travelling the webway brings many surprises.
穿越网道总会带来许多惊喜。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat4: The Skeins of Fate are treacherous this day.
命运的纠结今日狡猾无比。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat5: Ready to face the might of the Saim-Hann.
准备面对萨姆-罕的威力。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat6: Silent and unseen, I will bring your life to its end.
沉默且看不见的，我将使你的生命走向终结。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat7: You have presented an unforseen challenge.

Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat8: I will not let this sanctuary be corrupted.

Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat9: My life has been spent preparing for this.

Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat11: You will never catch up with me.
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat10: You are interlopers, and you will be repelled.

Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat12: A swift assault is the best approach.
迅速的攻击是最好的方法。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat13: The Farseers guide my hand this day.
先知们在今天引导我的手。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat14: When the Craftworlds unite, we will prevail.
当方舟世界联合时，我们将会胜利。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-vsElan: Your short-lived kind are a scourge on this galaxy.
你们这种短命的种族是这个银河系的天灾。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-vsGrimmar: I am retribution for your acts against the Craftworld, mon'keigh.
我是对你们对方舟世界的行为的报复，蒙奇。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat0-BL35: You will never know peace, abomination.
你这个怪物，永远不会知道和平。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-vsTBC2: You face the Aeldari Aspects and will not endure.
你面对的是艾达灵族的方面，你无法忍受。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-vsTBC3: When the time comes, you will falter.
Chat_Messages/ASH3-vsTBC4: If you seek to anger me, you have failed.
如果你试图激怒我，你已经失败了。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat0-TL34: These soulless abominations will devour all.
这些无魂的怪物会吞噬一切。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-vsUrsula: These were never your worlds, mon'keigh.
这些世界从来不是你的，蒙奇。
Chat_Messages/ASH3-Chat0-SAU35: If you seek to anger me, you have failed.
如果你试图激怒我，你已经失败了。
Chat_Messages/ASH4: So comes the hour of bloodshed.
Chat_Messages/ASH5: 方舟世界永远不会投降。
Chat_Messages/ASH8: Light dims, yet our hope is ever kindled.
光线暗淡，但我们的希望永远燃烧。
Chat_Messages/ASH10: Surround them! Strangle them like the Serpent!
包围他们！像蛇一样勒死他们！
Chat_Messages/ASH12: When the wind cries, retribution has arrived.
当风哭泣，报复已经到来。
Chat_Messages/ASH14: I have returned, so the Craftworld may never fall.
我已经回来，所以方舟世界永远不会倒下。
Chat_Messages/ASH16: I am the bloodied blade of Khaine.
Chat_Messages/ASH17: Spirits heed my words, and rise.
灵魂听我的话，然后崛起。
Chat_Messages/ASH19: The skeins of fate tell of nothing but death.
命运的线索只预示着死亡。
Chat_Messages/ASH20: No more pain, no more death.
Chat_Messages/ASH23: 你走的是被诅咒的道路。
Chat_Messages/ASH25: Follow the wind, bring forth Khaine's fire!
顺风而行，带来凯恩的火焰！
Chat_Messages/ASH26: May the Sting of Grief commence!
Chat_Messages/ASH27: Let our enemies feel the rushing wind of death.
让我们的敌人感受到死亡的疾风。
Chat_Messages/ASH28: Rise warden, the Craftworld needs you once more.
起来，守卫者，方舟世界再次需要你。
Chat_Messages/ASH30: We are the spear of Khaine!
Chat_Messages/ASH33: When my vengeance comes, it will be swift.
当我的复仇星来临，它将是迅速的。
Chat_Messages/ASH35: Enough blood has flowed. The fight must end.
已经流了足够的血。战斗必须结束。
Chat_Messages/BL5: 你的头颅已经是我的了。
Chat_Messages/BL15: Your head will be my trophy.

Chat_Messages/BL16: I will see your blood flow!

Chat_Messages/BL23: I have foreseen the Warmaster's victory,

Chat_Messages/BL25: Dark Gods, bestow your gift upon me!

Chat_Messages/BL33: Come spirits of the machines, I will remake you.

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat0: From the Eye of Terror, we shall bring no mercy.

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat1: It is by my hand that the Imperium will become ashes.

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat10: Savour your pathetic hope while you have any left.

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat11: I wield my father’s weapon – he shall never be reborn.

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat12: I am the Arch-fiend, the Despoiler of Worlds.
我是大恶魔，世界的破坏者。
Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat13: My Black Legion will reclaim what is ours!
我的黑色军团将夺回属于我们的一切！
Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat14: We will destroy the servants of the False Emperor.

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat4: I learn from my losses, so that next time I will prevail.

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat5: Fight me if you must, but you will soon taste defeat.
如果你必须与我战斗，你很快就会尝到失败的滋味。

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat7: You proved to be stronger than I anticipated.
Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat8: We were made to conquer the galaxy.
我们生来就是为了征服银河。
Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat9: From shame and shadow recast; in black and gold reborn.
从耻辱和阴影中重塑；在黑色和金色中重生。
Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat0-GOF29: Your worthless kind is nothing more than a distraction.
你们这些无价值的种族不过是个干扰罢了。

Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat0-GOF75: Savour your pathetic hope while you have any left.
尽情享受你那可怜的希望吧，只要你还有的话。

Chat_Messages/SAU66-Chat13: The grasp of oblivion will always find you.
遗忘的掌握总会找到你。
Chat_Messages/SAU66-Chat14: All who defy me will be expunged by my hand!
所有反抗我的人都将被我手中的力量消灭！
Chat_Messages/SAU66-Chat0-Sautekh: The scent of betrayal fuels my unending hatred.
背叛的气息激发了我无尽的仇恨。
Chat_Messages/SAU66-Chat0-SAU35: Peace? The galaxy shall drown in carnage before your empty dreams are realized.
和平？银河系将在你的空洞梦想实现之前淹没在屠杀中。
Chat_Messages/SAU66-Chat0-TAU2: I serve no ideal but the inevitability of death.
我只服从死亡的必然性，而不是任何理想。
Chat_Messages/SAU66-Chat0-GOF29: Come forth, brute, and meet your ruin.
来吧，蛮兽，迎接你的毁灭。
Chat_Messages/SAU66-Chat0-ASH1: Your ancient race shall wither like others before it.
你的旗手种族将像之前的其他种族一样枯萎。
Chat_Messages/SAU66-Chat0-SAU37: Your visions cannot save you from my wrath.
你的预见无法使你免于我的愤怒。
Chat_Messages/SAU70: 正在定-定-定位目标进行全面毁灭。
Chat_Messages/SAU72: By my will! Render them down to atoms!
凭我之意！将他们粉碎成原子！
Chat_Messages/AM8: Just a flesh-wound, I'll have you back on your feet.
只是皮外伤，我会让你重新站起来。
Chat_Messages/AM9: 热射步枪已准备就绪 杀伤射击已授权。
Chat_Messages/AM11: For Cadia, we hold the line here!
为了卡迪亚，我们在这里守住阵线！
Chat_Messages/AM16: Scout patrol to command. I have eyes on the enemy.
侦查巡逻向指挥官报告 我已看到敌人。
Chat_Messages/AM17: Do your duty, or die by my hand.
履行你的职责，或者死在我手中。
Chat_Messages/AM18: Let's make the cannons sing. Fire!
让我们的大炮唱起来。开火！
Chat_Messages/AM21: 欧姆尼塞亚的工作是神圣的。
Chat_Messages/AM23: Target sighted. Let there be fire!
目标已锁定 让火焰燃烧！
Chat_Messages/AM25: 没有什么能阻止我们的进军。
Chat_Messages/AM27: Behind me sir, Nork's got dis!
长官，站我后面，Nork来搞定这个！
Chat_Messages/AM29: Blast them out of the skies!
把他们从天空中炸出来！
Chat_Messages/AM31: Stand fast, not one step back!
Chat_Messages/AM32: The battlefield trembles under our treads.
战场在我们的脚步下颤抖。
Chat_Messages/AM33: The earth shakes to the sound of our guns.
大地在我们的炮声下震动。
Chat_Messages/AM35: A single shell is all it takes.
Chat_Messages/AM37: We are the Emperor's fire and fury!
我们是帝皇的火焰和愤怒！
Chat_Messages/AM59: 我看到了超越视线的东西。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat0: Arise, warriors of the Imperium! For the Emperor!
起来，帝国的战士们！为了帝皇！
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat1: Onward! Fight so the dawn may rise anew!
向前！为了新的黎明而战！
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat2: Decisiveness is a weapon. Let us act swiftly.
果断就是一种武器。让我们迅速行动。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat4: Fall back! Dawn shall rise brightest after the darkest night.
后退！黎明将在最黑暗的夜晚后最亮。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat5: Ours is the moment! March forward!
我们的时刻到了！向前进！
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat6: Tremble before the might of the Astra Militarum!
在星界军的威力面前颤抖吧！
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat7: Hm, even the Collegiate Astrolex failed to foresee this.
嗯，即使是天文学院也未能预见到这一点。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat8: Forward, Konstantin! Let nothing slow us down!
向前，康斯坦丁！不让任何事情拖我们后腿！
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat9: We are the hammer of the Emperor.
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat10: Honor and courage light our way.
荣誉和勇气照亮我们的道路。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat13: The toll is steep, yet every sacrifice paves the path to victory.
代价沉重，但每一次牺牲都为胜利铺平了道路。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat14: Today, we etch our names in the stars.
今天，我们将我们的名字刻在星星上。
Chat_Messages/BL34-Chat0-AM1: It is by my hand that the Imperium will become ashes.
正是我手中的力量将帝国化为灰烬。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat0-SAU35: Your lifeless tyranny shall be shattered by the Emperor's light!
你那无生命的暴政将被帝皇的光明粉碎！
Chat_Messages/SAU35-Chat0-AM1: Under my reign, the kingdoms of old shall live again.
在我统治下，旧时的王国将再次复苏。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat0-GOF28: Your brutish hordes will fall to the discipline of the Astra Militarum!
你那野蛮的部落将败在星界军的纪律之下！
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat0-TL34: Xenos abomination, your kind shall never defile Holy Terra.
异形的怪物，你们这种生物永远不会玷污神圣泰拉。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat0-TL35: Monstrosity! I shall send you back to the void from whence you came.
怪物！我将把你送回你来的虚空。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat0-GSC1: Fiend, your insidious rebellion shall be purged today!
恶魔，你的阴险叛乱今天将被清除！
Chat_Messages/GSC1-Chat0-AM1: Denying the Star Children's mercy breeds but disaster.
拒绝星辰之子的怜悯只会带来灾难。
Chat_Messages/AM1-Chat0-BL36: We stand steadfast against the darkness.
我们坚定不移地对抗黑暗。
Chat_Messages/BL36-Chat0-AM1: You are just a plaything of the Gods.
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat0: We march forward, for the Imperium!
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat1: If you flee, you will die.
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat2: This is no time for indecision.
现在不是犹豫不决的时候。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat3: 这样的行动是不允许的。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat4: An orderly retreat has been authorised.
已经授权进行有序的撤退。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat5: Another battlefield, another victory to claim.
又一个战场，又一个胜利等待我们去夺取。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat6: I will strike you down as an example for all!
我会击败你，作为对所有人的警示！
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat7: You fight well – better than I expected.
你战斗得很好 - 比我预期的要好。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat8: I will never back down from the likes of you.
我永远不会向你这样的人退缩。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat9: I do my duty without hesitation.
我毫不犹豫地履行我的职责。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat10: We will be victorious this day!
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat11: Retreat is not an option. We fight until the last man.
退路不是选项。我们战斗到最后一个人。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat12: Victory through courage or through fear, whatever is needed.
通过勇气或恐惧取得胜利，无论需要什么。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat13: You cannot defeat the might of Astra Militarum.
你无法击败星界军的威力。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat14: Discipline is the lifeblood of the Guard. Without it, we are nothing.
纪律是警卫的生命线。没有它，我们就什么都不是。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat0-GOF28: Yarrick was an inspiration to us all.
亚瑞克对我们所有人都是一种鼓舞。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat0-AM2: My place is to ensure the discipline of your troops.
我的职责是确保你的军队纪律严明。
Chat_Messages/AM3-Chat0-Minka: Do not make me shoot you for cowardice.
不要让我因为你的懦弱而射击你。
Chat_Messages/BL35-Chat0-AM3: You are wasted in the service of the False Emperor.
你在假帝皇的服务中浪费了自己。
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat0: With fury in our hearts, we will never falter!
怀着愤怒的心，我们永不动摇！
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat1: 只要我们站立，卡迪亚就存在！
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat5: I have seen you and judged you – face my wrath!
我已经看透你并判断你 - 面对我的愤怒！
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat6: The Hammer of the Emperor shall be your doom!
帝皇之锤将是你的末日！
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat7: Tactics win battles but faith wins wars.
战术赢得战斗，但信仰赢得战争。
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat8: I will carry on my father’s legacy.
我将继续我父亲的遗志。
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat9: We will defend the Imperium to our dying breath.
我们将用最后一口气来捍卫帝国。
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat10: Cadia is no more, but we still stand!
卡迪亚已不再，但我们仍然站立！
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat11: The Astra Militarum will never break.
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat12: Let me teach you a lesson about strategy.
让我教你一些关于战略的课程。
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat13: Only a coward hides at the back of the lines.
只有懦夫才会躲在战线的后方。
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat14: Face forward and never look back!
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat0-Abaddon: You may be the Arch-Fiend, but I am Retribution!
你可能是恶魔，但我是惩罚！
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat0-Ultramarines: You should be focusing on the real enemy!
你应该专注于真正的敌人！
Chat_Messages/AM2-Chat0-Leviathan: Don’t allow these beasts a foothold.
Chat_Messages/ASH65: Strike like the spear of Khaine!
Chat_Messages/ASH67: 我们以致命的精准攻击。
Chat_Messages/ASH68: A silent death descends upon our foes.
寂静死亡降临我们的敌人。
Chat_Messages/ASH69: The wail of Khaine will be your doom!
凯恩的哀嚎将是你的末日！
Chat_Messages/ASH70: From the skies, death rains upon you!
从天空中，死亡如雨般降临你！
Chat_Messages/ASH75: When battle calls, we must all don the mask.
当战斗召唤，我们都必须戴上面具。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat0: You face the Storm of Silence.
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat1: Hear my warcry and know that it means death!
听我的战吼，知道它意味着死亡！
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat4: The winds are unfavourable, but the storm will gather again.
风向不利，但风暴将再次聚集。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat5: My blades are ready for you.
我的刀剑已经准备好对你。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat6: I bring only death and leave only corpses.
我只带来死亡，只留下尸体。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat7: It is rare that I meet a worthy foe.
我很少遇到值得一战的敌人。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat9: I have faced death many times, and still I stand to deliver it.
我已经多次面对死亡，但我仍然站立，为其送行。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat10: I deliver no mercy other than the peace of death.
我只给予死亡的平静，没有任何怜悯。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat11: I will defend what is ours.
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat12: Your fate was sealed the moment you crossed my path.
你的命运在你穿越我的道路的那一刻就已经封印。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat13: I am a Phoenix Lord, I pass wherever my Path takes me
我是凤凰领主，我走我之道。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat14: You will soon be nothing but a stain on my blades.
你很快就会成为我刀剑上的一道痕迹。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat0-BL35: Might? You are but a whisper, soon to be silenced.
力量？你只是一阵微风，即将被寂灭。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat0-SAU35: Let me show you the true essence of the storm.
让我向你展示风暴的真实本质。
Chat_Messages/ASH74-Chat0-Leviathan: These creatures pose a threat to all life in the galaxy.
这些生物对银河系中的所有生命构成威胁。
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat1: God-Emperor, grant us your holy wrath!
神皇，赐予我们你的神圣愤怒！
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat4: The God-Emperor is with us. Until the very end.
神皇与我们同在。直到最后一刻。
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat5: I have come to deliver you the God-Emperor’s judgement!
我来向你传达神皇的审判！
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat6: I will cast you into the pyre where you belong!
我会把你投入你应在的火葬堆！
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat7: A moment’s lapse in concentration. Nothing more.
片刻的注意力不集中，仅此而已。
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat8: Let this be a just punishment for your sins.
让这成为你罪行的公正惩罚。
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat9: No mercy! No quarter, for they shall give us none!
无情！不留余地，因为他们也不会留给我们！
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat10: Only the faithless despair, only the righteous shall endure.
只有无信仰者会绝望，只有正义者才能坚持。
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat12: 准备你的灵魂接受审判！
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat13: Saint Arabella watch over us this battle!
圣女阿拉贝拉在这场战斗中保佑我们！
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat14: There will be no forgiveness for you.
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat0-SOR3: Under His fire, the wicked will be judged.
在他的火焰下，邪恶者将被审判。
Chat_Messages/SOR65-Chat0-BL36: I will take you down, Sorcerer!
Chat_Messages/SOR67: No armor will save you from our holy wrath.
没有任何护甲能抵挡我们的神圣愤怒。
Chat_Messages/SOR68: Let the Emperor's judgment sear their flesh!
让帝皇的审判烧灼他们的肉体！
Chat_Messages/SOR69: Our blades will rain from the skies.
我们的剑将从天空中降下。
Chat_Messages/SOR71: All that you are and all you have done revolts me.
你的一切和你所做的一切都让我感到反感。
Chat_Messages/UM77: I will make them suffer now.
Chat_Messages/UM78: 坚守阵地，奥特拉玛的儿子们！
Chat_Messages/UM79: We bring the fires of retribution. Burn them down!
我们带来了惩罚之火。烧掉他们！
Chat_Messages/UM80: Your defiance will end under Ultramar's steel.
你的反抗将在奥特拉玛的钢铁下结束。
Chat_Messages/UM81: None will escape under my watch.
在我看守下，无人能逃脱。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat0: At once, Dark Angels! Redden your blades!
立即行动，黑暗天使！让你的刀剑染红！
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat1: Eye and weapon to the enemy!
将眼睛和武器对准敌人！
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat9: Speak your last words before the blade falls.
在刀落下之前说出你的遗言。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat2: Ours is the moment! Do not let up!
这是我们的时刻！不要放松！
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat4: Target priority assessment. Others await our retribution.
目标优先评估。其他人等待我们的报复。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat5: Draw your blade, you might yet find absolution in battle.
拔出你的剑，你可能在战斗中找到赎罪。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat6: I do not take your life lightly, but in service to my duty.
我不轻易取你的生命，但在执行我的职责。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat7: Your temerity only makes you court with disaster.
你的鲁莽只会让你与灾难为伍。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat8: Fight, sons of The Lion! Fight!
战斗，狮子的儿子们！战斗！
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat11: Stay sharp! I will tolerate no laxity.
保持警惕！我不会容忍任何懈怠。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat12: To the abyss with your lies!
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat13: 无人能阻挡我们的审判。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat14: We have come. We are death.
我们已经来了。我们是死亡。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat0-DA2: This is your last chance to stop this foolery, brother.
这是你最后一次停止这种愚蠢行为的机会，兄弟。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat0-Abaddon: You will meet your abhorrent father's fate.
你会遭遇你那可恶的父亲的命运。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat0-Imotekh / Haarke: For all you speak about fear, I see no courage in you.
尽管你说的都是恐惧，我在你身上看不到勇气。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat0-WE: Where you see strength, I see madness. It will not aid you.
你看到的是力量，我看到的是疯狂。这对你没有帮助。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat0-Tau / Aeldari: I will not suffer your existence one moment longer.
我不会再容忍你存在一刻。
Chat_Messages/DA1-Chat0-DA3 (Asmodai): Has mistrust taken over your wits, old friend?
不信任是否已经控制了你的智慧，老朋友？
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat0: For the Lion! For the Emperor!
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat1: Onward to the objective. Kill everything we encounter.
向目标前进。杀掉我们遇到的一切。
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat5: Finally. A foe that might test me.
终于。一个可能考验我的敌人。
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat6: Come, meet your end by the bite of my steel!
来吧，让我的钢铁咬破你的生命！
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat7: It is not often I misjudge a foe's prowess.
我很少误判敌人的实力。
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat8: Hold the line! Let fury be the steel in your spine!
守住阵线！让愤怒成为你脊梁的钢铁！
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat10: Where we stand, none shall pass.
我们站立的地方，无人能过。
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat11: Fervour must be tempered with wisdom.
热情必须与智慧相辅相成。
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat12: You falter beneath the strain of battle.
你在战斗的压力下动摇。
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat13: With me, brothers! For the Lion!
跟我来，兄弟们！为了狮子！
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat14: It is too dangerous to let you live.
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat0-DA3: You will not leave this planet until the fight is done, Asmodai.
阿斯莫德，你不会离开这个星球，直到战斗结束。
Chat_Messages/DA2-Chat0-DA1: Not until I know the whole truth.
除非我知道全部的真相。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat0: Nothing can compare to the judgement of the Emperor.
没有什么能比得上帝皇的审判。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat1: There is little to discuss, so long as the Fallen remain at large.
只要堕天使还在逍遥法外，我们就没有什么好谈的。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat3: This compromises the Sanctity of the Hunt.
这威胁到了狩猎的圣洁。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat4: Fall back! This information must reach Lord Azrael.
后退！这个信息必须传达给阿兹瑞尔领主。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat5: 我们的道路现在交叉了。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat6: The past will be cleansed with the blood of traitors.
过去将以叛徒的血来洗净。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat8: Repent, and I will make your death swift.
忏悔，我会让你的死亡迅速。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat9: I have judged, and found you wanting.
我已经审判，发现你不足。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat10: With fury, brothers! Ours is the rightous outrage!
怒火中烧，兄弟们！我们有正义的愤怒！
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat11: Repent, for your life is at its end.
忏悔，因为你的生命即将结束。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat12: The Chapter is the only thing that matters.
战团是唯一重要的事情。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat13: Let me excise that which weighs down your soul.
让我割除那些压抑你灵魂的东西。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat14: There is no salvation without suffering.
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat0-DA2: There is no greater priority than the Hunt, Master of the Deathwing.
没有比狩猎更重要的事情，死翼的主人。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat0-tbc1: We are bringers of death! We are Dark Angels!
我们是死亡的使者！我们是黑暗天使！
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat0-tbc2: Empty words, muttered by an empty soul.
空洞的话语，空洞的灵魂。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat0-Orks / Tyranids: Purge this filth swiftly! Our hunt calls us elsewhere.
迅速清除这些污秽！我们的狩猎在别处召唤我们。
Chat_Messages/DA3-Chat0-DA1 (Azrael): You are not asking the right questions.
Chat_Messages/DA4: For the Lion and the Emperor!
Chat_Messages/DA5: The Lion's sons endure. I will see to it.
狮子的儿子们会坚持下去。我会确保这一点。
Chat_Messages/DA6: None shall escape the wrath of Caliban!
没有人能逃脱卡利班的愤怒！
Chat_Messages/DA7: The hunt begins. No one escapes the Ravenwing!
狩猎开始了。没有人能逃脱鸦翼！
Chat_Messages/DA8: Your pleas for mercy will go unheard.
你们的求饶将无人理会。
Chat_Messages/DA11: The Lion watches us all. Fight with honor!
狮子在注视着我们所有人。带着荣誉战斗！
Chat_Messages/DA13: 卡利班的愤怒在我心中回响！
Chat_Messages/DA14: Only death follows in our wake!
我们的行动只带来死亡！
Chat_Messages/DA15: The chase is over. Now, the blade falls.
追逐结束了。现在，刀锋落下。
Chat_Messages/DA16: To me, Dark Angels! Victory is at hand!
来吧，黑暗天使们！胜利就在眼前！
Chat_Messages/DA19: Your life is forfeit, but your soul could still find deliverance.
你的生命将被剥夺，但你的灵魂仍有可能找到解放。
Chat_Messages/DA20: I will stand sentinel for the Chapter’s honor.
我将为战团的荣誉站岗。
Chat_Messages/DA21: No one can outrun our retribution.
没有人能逃脱我们的报复。
Chat_Messages/DA22: The Chapter's engines will not falter under my watch.
在我看守下，战团的引擎不会熄火。
Chat_Messages/DA23: 通过牺牲，我们找到救赎。
Chat_Messages/DA24: We shall fulfill our duty, no matter the cost.
我们将履行我们的职责，无论代价如何。
Chat_Messages/DA25: The hunt never ends. Duty compels us forward.

Chat_Messages/GSC66-Chat0: From the wastelands of Damnathor, we rise to claim our freedom!

Chat_Messages/GSC66-Chat3: 那超出了我的能力范围。

你战斗得很好，但我们的起义现在已经无法阻挡。

Chat_Messages/GSC66-Chat11: We know your strength, yet you know nothing about us.

Chat_Messages/GSC66-Chat12: Our Ascension is near! We will taste freedom at last.

Chat_Messages/GSC66-Chat13: With our shackles unbound, no enemy can outrun us!
我们的枷锁已经解开，没有敌人能逃过我们的追击！
Chat_Messages/GSC66-Chat14: We ride under the gaze of the Star Children, unstoppable and free.

骑行吧，兄弟们！星辰之子在看着我们！

你只是另一个暴君，我们已经崛起来推翻你。

我们是真信仰的传播者，假天使！
Chat_Messages/GSC66-Chat0-UM46: We no longer cower before False Angels. Our Ascension beckons!

Chat_Messages/GSC66-Chat0-AM2: Ride now, brethren, and overrun those who once shackled us!
现在骑行吧，兄弟们，冲垮那些曾经束缚我们的人！

你只能看到我们想让你看到的！

Chat_Messages/GSC69: There is nothing you can do to stop our ascension!
你无法阻止我们的崛起！
Chat_Messages/GSC70: Each blast casts down the unbeliever!

Chat_Messages/GSC71: Be ready for anything, and prepare to strike.

Chat_Messages/GSC73: Forward! We rise from the dust this day!

Chat_Messages/EC55-Chat0: If it is death you crave, who am I to deny it?
如果你渴望死亡，我又怎能拒绝呢？

犹豫会让快乐之刃变得迟钝。

啊...又一个空洞的敌人被强加给我。

我感觉你在颤抖。是恐惧...还是期待？
Chat_Messages/EC57-Chat7: You might yet deliver an amusing time.

Chat_Messages/EC57-Chat9: I shall relish the sight of your pathetic remains.
我将享受看你可怜的遗骸的乐趣。
Chat_Messages/EC57-Chat10: Oh, the screams I will wrench out of your throat.
哦，我将从你的喉咙里扭出的尖叫。

Chat_Messages/EC57-Chat13: Bask in your empty hopes while you can.

终于，一个值得对手从平庸中崛起！
Chat_Messages/EC56-Chat8: I hope your blade is sharper than your sense.
我希望你的刀比你的理智更锋利。

不要眨眼，否则你会错过真正的美。

Demo/UMTutorial: Start here! Spar with your Chapter Master to learn the teachings of the Codex before heading out into battle.
从这里开始！在走上战场之前，与你的战团长切磋，学习圣典的教导。
Demo/UMDeck1: Outgun your opponents with reliable firepower before they can get to you.
在对手能够接近你之前，用可靠的火力压制他们。
Demo/UMDeck2: Follow the teachings of the Codex Astartes to prevail in battle!
遵循阿斯塔特圣典的教导，战胜战斗中的敌人！
Demo/UMDeck3: Lead the unstoppable war machines of the Ultramarines into battle.
引领极限战士的不可阻挡的战争机器进入战斗。
Demo/UMDeck4: Prove your mastery and devotion to the Codex, making the most of your available units and stratagems.
证明你对圣典的精通和忠诚，充分利用你的可用单位和计谋。
Demo/UMDeck5: Charge straight into the enemy with the strongest close-combat units in the Chapter!
带领战团中最强的近战单位直接冲向敌人！
Demo/BLTutorial: The Chaos Gods bestow you with their gifts! Follow the Ruinous Path and learn to master the powers the Dark Pacts can offer.
混沌诸神赐予你他们的礼物！遵循毁灭之道，学会掌握黑暗契约所能提供的力量。
Demo/BLDeck1: The devotees of Khorne gather together in this blood-seeking warband, ready to fulfill the will of Abaddon, and tint the stars in red.
恐虐的信徒们聚集在这个寻血的战队中，准备执行阿巴顿的意志，用红色染色星辰。
Demo/BLDeck3: Bend reality to your will with the gifts of Tzeentch and scheme your way to victory with the meticulous use of psychic powers and stratagems.
用奸奇的礼物将现实弯曲于你的意志，通过精心使用心灵力量和计谋，策划你的胜利之路。
Demo/BLDeck2: Follow the enthralling of Slaanesh and find pleasure in your deadly deeds as your troops rush into battle in a frenzy of blood and pain.
跟随色孽的迷惑，找到你的致命行为的乐趣，当你的军队在血与痛苦的狂热中冲入战斗。
Demo/BLDeck4: Unleash tides of rot and fill the battlefield with relentless, unwavering troops blessed by Nurgle to conquer your enemy.
释放腐烂的潮汐，用纳垢祝福的坚定不移的军队填满战场，征服你的敌人。
Demo/BLDeck5: Chaos Undivided shall conquer all! Push your Legionaries to earn the blessings of all Chaos Gods and achieve absolute power.
混沌未分将征服一切！推动你的军团战士获得所有混沌诸神的祝福，实现绝对的力量。
Demo/BLDeck6: Excess and disease band toghether to exploit the synergies between their daemonic gifts and bring death to the battlefield.
过度与疾病联手，利用他们的恶魔礼物之间的协同效应，将死亡带到战场。
Demo/LeviathanDeck1: Unleash the chitinous tides of your brood and overwhelm your prey with endless invasion swarm.
释放你的巢穴中的甲壳潮汐，用无尽的入侵虫群淹没你的猎物。
Demo/LeviathanDeck2: Use the Tyranids adaptive capabilities to evolve past your enemies and prey on their weaknesses.
利用泰伦虫族的适应能力，超越你的敌人，捕食他们的弱点。
Demo/LeviathanDeck3: Deploy your vanguard predators to hunt down your enemies and whittle down their defenses, before your largest bioforms clear up any remaining resistance.
部署你的先锋掠食者战车，猎杀你的敌人，削弱他们的防御，然后让你最大的生物形态清理任何剩余的抵抗。
Demo/LeviathanDeck4: Relay the orders from the Hive Mind to your beasts through the synaptic links and turn primal ferocity into an organized carnage
通过突触链接，将虫巢意志的命令传达给你的野兽，将原始的凶残转化为有组织的屠杀。
Demo/LeviathanDeck5: Lead your horde and predate the enemy in a brutal hunt that features great numbers and fast attacks.
领导你的部队，以大量和快速的攻击在残酷的狩猎中捕食敌人。
Demo/GoffDeckTutorial: Learn your know-wots before taking control of your Waaagh!
在控制你的Waaagh之前，先学习你的知识！
Demo/GoffDeck1: Ready for a good scrap? Overwhelm your opponent with endless tides of Orks!
准备好一场激烈的战斗了吗？用无尽的欧克蛮人潮汐淹没你的对手！
Demo/GoffDeck2: Give your enemies a fast and furious krumpin' with your Stormboyz.
用你的风暴小子给你的敌人一个快速而狂暴的击打。
Demo/GoffDeck3: Kunnin' but brutal! Control the battlefield and wait for the right moment to overwhelm the enemy with your mobz.
狡猾但残暴！控制战场，等待用你的暴民淹没敌人的正确时机。
Demo/GoffDeck4: Show your know wots with the best vehicles and mekboyz in your Waaagh!
用你的Waaagh中最好的车辆和技师小子展示你的知识！
Demo/GoffDeck5: Show who's the greatest warboss and stomp your enemies with the strongest units in the Waaagh!
展示谁是最伟大的战争头目，并用Waaagh中最强大的单位践踏你的敌人！
Demo/AeldariDeckTutorial: Master the unique weaponry of the Aeldari to become an effective leader of the Saim-Hann Wild Host.
掌握艾达灵族的独特武器，成为萨姆-罕狂野骑手的有效领导者。
Demo/AeldariDeck1: Strike and fade! Command the Wild Host and launch attacks at frightening speeds to overwhelm your opponent's forces.
攻击并消失！指挥狂野骑手，以惊人的速度发动攻击，压倒你的对手的力量。
Demo/AeldariDeck2: Pierce and shred your foes with shuriken weaponry and perform efficient assaults to maintain your presence on the battlefield and slay your opponent.
用星镖武器穿刺并撕碎你的敌人，进行有效的攻击以保持你在战场上的存在，并杀死你的对手。
Demo/AeldariDeck3: Hold the enemy back patiently and manage your hand carefully to unleash a powerful combo that will crush the enemy.
耐心地阻止敌人，谨慎地管理你的手牌，以释放一个强大的组合，将敌人粉碎。
Demo/AeldariDeck4: Even after death, the Aeldari are determined to protect the Craftworld. Awaken your army of Wraithbone constructs and become retribution against your foes!
即使在死后，艾达灵族也决心保护方舟世界。唤醒你的灵骨构造军队，成为对你的敌人的报复！
Demo/AeldariDeck5: Lead the Saim-Hann Wild Riders to victory in storming airborne assaults! Hold the enemy while your fighters take off and claim the skies.
引导萨姆-罕的狂野骑手在风暴空袭中取得胜利！把握住敌人，让你的战士起飞并占领天空。
Demo/SautekhDeckTutorial: Learn the secrets of immortality and command your army as a mighty Phaeron.
学习不朽的秘密，作为强大的法皇指挥你的军队。
Demo/SautekhDeckDescriptionScarab: No threat is too small. Summon an unending swarm of scarabs and overwhelm even the most resilient enemies with an incessant volley of attacks.
没有威胁太小。召唤无尽的圣甲虫虫群，用连续不断的攻击淹没即使是最坚韧的敌人。
Demo/SautekhDeckDescriptionImplacable: Contain the enemy and bide your time to gain great power and scour the battlefield with the greatest warriors of the Sautekh dynasty.
包围敌人并等待时机，以获得巨大的力量，并用索泰克王朝的最强战士横扫战场。
Demo/SautekhDeckDescriptionRelentless: Make the galaxy tremble with an ever-growing legions of enthralled, unyielding warriors of living metal.
让银河系颤抖于不断增长的活体金属战士军团的威力之下。
Demo/SautekhDeckDescriptionAstromancy: Read the flow of the cosmos and direct events towards your victory while commanding a reanimating army that even death can't stop.
阅读宇宙的流动，指挥一支即使死亡也无法阻止的复活军队，引导事件走向你的胜利。
Demo/SautekhDeckDescriptionEldritch: Master the power of divination to always be one step ahead of the enemy and execute your artificious plans.
掌握占卜的力量，始终领先敌人一步，执行你的巧妙计划。

Demo/Welcome/Intro: You have been selected to participate in this closed alpha in which you'll be able to test the latest updates, collect cards, build decks and face opponents with your own strategies! In this alpha you will be able to:
你已被选中参加这个封闭的Alpha测试，在这里你将能够测试最新的更新，收集张牌，建立卡组，并用你自己的策略面对对手！在这个Alpha测试中，你将能够：
Demo/DraftMode/PayScreen1: Choose a warlord to lead your army and face other players in famous battles across the grim dark Galaxy! Draft your way to victory by picking between the randomly offered card packs to create your deck.
选择一位战将来领导你的军队，并在阴暗的银河系中的著名战役中面对其他玩家！通过在随机提供的张牌群体中挑选，选秀你的胜利之路来创建你的卡组。
Demo/DraftMode/PayScreen2: From the Eye of Terror, we shall bring no mercy.
