Demo/TauEmpireDeckDescription1: Focus your superior firepower on the enemy Warlord by stacking Markerlight on it and finish it off in a single round.
将你的优越火力集中在敌方的战将上，通过堆叠标记灯并在一轮内将其击败。
Demo/TauEmpireDeckDescription2: Gain control of the battlefield with reliable T'au Drones and finish off the opponent before they can build their board up.
利用可靠的钛帝国无人机控制战场，并在对手建立阵型之前将其击败。
Demo/TauEmpireDeckDescription3: Embody the teachings of the Mont'ka with the swift strike of your Battlesuits, leveraging their superior maneuverability and firepower.
通过你的战斗服的迅速攻击，体现蒙特卡的教导，利用他们的优越机动性和火力。
Demo/TauEmpireDeckDescription4: Etherals inspire Fire Warriors into seemingly supernatural feats. Deploy wave after wave of troops and finish the enemy under a storm of pulse fire.
以太族激励烈火战士进行看似超自然的壮举。部署一波又一波的军队，并在脉冲火力的风暴下结束敌人。
Demo/TauEmpireDeckDescription5: Use the T'au technological superiority to build a quick board of high-damage units that will leave no escape to the enemy.
利用钛帝国的技术优势，快速建立高伤害单位的棋盘，不给敌人任何逃脱的机会。
Demo/TauEmpireDeckDescription6: Embody the teachings of the Kauyon and thread slowly using Markerlight to bring down the enemy and clear the way for your most powerful units.
体现空育的教导，慢慢地使用标记灯来击败敌人，为你最强大的单位清理道路。
Demo/SororitasDeckDescription1: Unleash the fires of vengeance upon your enemies, deploying unrelenting waves of Battle Sisters into the battlefield.
向你的敌人释放复仇之火，部署无情的战斗修女波澜不惧地进入战场。
Demo/SororitasDeckDescription2: Protect the sanctity of the Imperium with an army of faithful and merciless Sisters of Battle. Balance out prayers and aggression for a relentless conquest.
用一支忠诚无情的战斗修女军队保护帝国的圣洁。平衡祈祷和侵略，以进行无情的征服。
Demo/SororitasDeckDescription3: When all seems lost, only faith will guide you onwards. Hold down the enemy and cultivate your Faith to get the most out of your army's tactics and deeds.
当一切似乎都失去了，只有信仰会引导你前进。压制敌人并培养你的信仰，以最大限度地发挥你的军队的战术和行为。
Demo/SororitasDeckDescription4: Prayer is not a mere rite but a blade to be wielded. Muster your Faith to deal devastating blows unto the unsuspecting enemy.
祈祷不仅是一种仪式，而是一把要挥舞的剑。集结你的信仰，对毫无防备的敌人造成毁灭性的打击。
Demo/SororitasDeckDescription5: Lead the condemned and the repentant to deliverance with a fearless and violent assault headlong towards the enemy.
带领被定罪和悔过的人，用无畏和暴力的攻击直冲敌人，带他们走向解放星。
Demo/SororitasDeckDescription6: Wage Wars of Faith with the most zealous and fervent Sisters. Purge the unclean and slay the heretic with the most aggressive units in your ranks.
与最狂热和热切的战斗修女一起发动信仰之战。用你队伍中最具攻击性的单位清除不洁之物，杀死异教徒。
Demo/GenestealerCultsDeckDescription1: Strike from the shadows and overrun your enemy with invisible blows. Harness deception and strike with formidable force before the foe can react.
从阴影中发起攻击，用无形的打击压倒你的敌人。利用欺骗，在敌人反应之前以强大的力量攻击。
Demo/GenestealerCultsDeckDescription2: As the Cult casts off its cloak of shadows in a full-scale uprising, its many claws strike as one. Rally your broodkin and overthrow the oppressor!
当教派在全面起义中脱下阴影的斗篷时，它的众多爪子如一体般攻击。集结你的巢族，推翻压迫者！
Demo/GenestealerCultsDeckDescription3: The Day of Ascension has come. Unleash your forces in open insurrection to overwhelm your enemy and receive the divine favour of the Star Children.
飞升之日已经到来。发动公开叛乱，压倒你的敌人，接受星辰之子的神圣恩惠。
Demo/GenestealerCultsDeckDescription4: Sabotage the enemy's supply lines and prepare to unleash the full might of the Cult when the opportunity arises.
破坏敌人的补给线，准备在机会来临时释放教派的全部力量。
Demo/GenestealerCultsDeckDescription5: Deploy your forces covertly and ambush your unsuspecting enemies. Keep them off balance until the Cult's greatest threats rise to deliver the final blow.
秘密部署你的部队，伏击毫无防备的敌人。让他们失去平衡，直到教派的最大威胁崛起，给予最后一击。
Demo/GenestealerCultsDeckDescription6: Engage in subterfuge and sabotage operations to unravel your enemy's schemes. Command the battlefield with a tight grip, awaiting the perfect moment to strike.
进行阴谋和破坏行动，瓦解敌人的计划。以铁腕指挥战场，等待完美的时机进行攻击。
Demo/AstraMilitarumDeck1: Flood the battlefield with your shock troops and overwhelm the enemy in quick, unrelentless attacks.
用你的突击军队淹没战场，以快速、无情的攻击压倒敌人。
Demo/AstraMilitarumDeck2: When all seems lost there's still one undisputable answer: more firepower. Secure the battlefield with your tanks and artillery, before pushing forward for an overwhelming victory.
当一切看似失去时，仍有一个无可争议的答案：更多的火力。用你的坦克和炮兵确保战场，然后向前推进，取得压倒性的胜利。
Demo/AstraMilitarumDeck3: Carry your guardsmen to the frontline where they are needed most. Make good use of your armoured transports and find the opportunity to strike and claim victory.
将你的步兵运送到最需要他们的前线。充分利用你的装甲运输车，找到攻击并取得胜利的机会。
Demo/AstraMilitarumDeck4: Some battles are won by lightning fast attacks. Others become tests of attrition. Shield your key units and deploy massive firepower to overwhelm the helpless enemy!
有些战斗是由闪电般的快速攻击赢得的。其他的则成为消耗战。保护你的关键单位，并部署大量火力，压倒无助的敌人！
Demo/AstraMilitarumDeck5: Master the best qualities of your infantry and armoured companies to exert unbearable pressure on the enemy.
掌握你的步兵和装甲公司的最佳品质，对敌人施加无法承受的压力。
Demo/AstraMilitarumDeck6: When every bullet counts, wise is the officer who shows no doubt, who leads their forces onward with conviction, pressing forward until the enemy frontline crumbles.
当每一颗子弹都至关重要时，明智的军官不会有任何疑虑，他们带领他们的军队坚定地前进，直到敌人的前线崩溃。
Demo/DarkAngelsDeck1: Hold off the enemy while your forces take on their missions, before smiting the opponent with the explosive might of the Dark Angels.
在你的部队执行任务时抵挡敌人，然后用黑暗天使的爆炸力量击败对手。
Demo/DarkAngelsDeck2: Prizing speed and mobility above all else, the Ravenwing are integral to the Dark Angels’ combat strategies. Use their unmatched speed to ravage the foe in a quick assault.
鸦翼重视速度和机动性，是黑暗天使战斗策略的重要组成部分。利用他们无与伦比的速度快速袭击敌人。
Demo/DarkAngelsDeck3: The Deathwing can manifest onto the battlefield with unerring accuracy, delivering the death blow to an enemy already ravaged by the Unforgiven forces.
死翼能准确无误地出现在战场上，对已被戴罪者部队破坏的敌人进行致命打击。
Demo/DarkAngelsDeck4: The Inner Circle fights with privileged insight, striking at the precise moment and location required to tip the balance of battle.
内环以特权洞察力战斗，准确地在需要改变战斗平衡的时刻和地点进行攻击。
Demo/DarkAngelsDeck5: The Ravenwing seek to encircle their foe, corralling them with methodical manoeuvres and target selection and ensuring noone can escape from their hunt.
鸦翼试图包围他们的敌人，用有条不紊的策略和目标选择把他们赶到一起，确保没有人能逃脱他们的狩猎。
Demo/DarkAngelsDeck6: The Deathwing Terminators often wait in teleportariums, ready to strike. Upon arrival, devastation follows in their wake.
死翼终结者经常在传送室里等待，准备攻击。一旦到达，他们将带来毁灭性的后果。
Demo/EmperorsChildrenDeck1: Indulgence is their weapon, and agony its vessel. Poison the battlefield with suffering and sap the enemy’s will with every exquisite drop of torment.
放纵是他们的武器，痛苦是其容器。用苦难毒化战场，用每一滴精致的折磨削弱敌人的意志。
Demo/EmperorsChildrenDeck2: Orchestrate excruciating aural barrages to shatter the most resilient defensive lines using the Emperor's Children's signature sonic weaponry.
指挥帝皇之子的标志性音波武器，发动痛苦的音波攻击，粉碎最坚韧的防线。
Demo/EmperorsChildrenDeck3: Refined through pain, the Emperor’s Children strike with alchemical precision. Enhance your warriors with potent elixirs to turn every skirmish into a brutal performance.
通过痛苦提炼，帝皇之子以炼金术的精确度攻击。用强效的药剂增强你的战士，将每一场小冲突变成残酷的表演。
Demo/EmperorsChildrenDeck4: Blessed by ruinous powers, the III Legion fights alongside Daemons of the Dark Prince, offering devotion in flesh, torment and suffering.
被毁灭之力祝福的III军团与黑暗王子的恶魔并肩作战，以肉体、折磨和苦难表达虔诚。
Demo/EmperorsChildrenDeck5: Every strike, every motion, every death—flawless. Lead with elegance and exacting control, overwhelming the enemy beneath a mask of immaculate violence.
每一次攻击，每一个动作，每一次死亡——无懈可击。以优雅和精确的控制为首，用无暇的暴力之面具压倒敌人。
Demo/EmperorsChildrenDeck6: Keep the pressure to satisfy the Emperor's Children's hunger for sensation, driving your forces to ever more depraved bloodshed by the offering of boons and exotic elixirs.
保持压力以满足帝皇之子对感觉的渴望，通过提供恩赐和异国药剂，驱使你的军队进行更加堕落的杀戮。
Event_Description/EventModeDesc_OLD:
Choose a Warlord to lead your army and face other players in famous battles across the grim dark Galaxy!
Draft your way to victory by picking between the offered card packs to create your event deck.
The more victories you can achieve, the better the reward at the end!

选择一位战将来领导你的军队，并在阴暗的银河系中的著名战役中面对其他玩家！
通过在提供的张牌群体中选择，以选秀的方式走向胜利，创建你的活动卡组。
你能取得的胜利越多，最后的奖励就越好！
Event_Description/DemoEventDesc_OLD: During the War of Beasts Marneus Calgar openly challenged the Warmaster. Urged to humiliate the Chapter Master, Abaddon and his elite teleported before Calgar and his retinue on Saint's Haven, where battle immediately broke.
在兽之战期间，马涅乌思·卡尔加公开挑战了战帅。阿巴顿和他的精英应邀羞辱战团长，他们在圣港前方传送到卡尔加和他的随从面前，战斗立即爆发。
Event_Description/Event/EventModeDesc:
Choose a Warlord to lead your army and face other players in grand battles across the grim dark Galaxy!
Draft your way to victory by picking between the offered card packs to create your event deck.
Explore the drafting menu during the demo and see how many victories you can achieve!

选择一位战将来领导你的军队，并在阴暗的银河系中与其他玩家进行宏大的战斗！
通过在提供的卡组群体中选择，制定你的赛事卡组，以此来赢得胜利。
在演示过程中探索选秀菜单，看看你能获得多少胜利！
Event_Description/DemoEventDesc: In a Galaxy ripe for conquest, the many warring factions fight to claim it for their own. There is no respite, there is no haven, there is only the law of blade and bullet. Will you be able to lead your faction towards the path of eternity?
在一个熟透的征服星系中，许多交战的派系为了自己而争夺它。没有休息，没有避难所，只有刀剑和子弹的法则。你能否引导你的派系走向永恒之道？

Event_Description/Raid/IndividualTooltip: Your personal tally of Medals earned in this Raid. When you reach each milestone, you get a massive discount for buying that item with Medals, as long as it has been unlocked by all players.
你在这次突袭中获得的奖牌的个人总计。当你达到每个里程碑时，只要所有玩家已经解锁该物品，你就可以用奖牌购买该物品时获得大幅度的折扣。
Event_Description/General/GracePeriodDes: This is your final opportunity to claim the event's special rewards. During the grace period, you can spend any remaining event resources, but you won't be able to earn more through battles or missions.
这是你获取活动特别奖励的最后机会。在宽限期间，你可以花费任何剩余的活动资源，但你将无法通过战斗或布道所赚取更多。

Event_Description/Draft/HelpTooltip: Select your warlord, build your deck from the draft options available, and face other players with it! If you are defeated 3 times, your run will end.
选择你的战将，从可用的选秀选项中构建你的卡组，并用它与其他玩家对战！如果你被击败3次，你的比赛将结束。
Event_Description/Draft/TimedEventHelpTo: Special draft event! All Skulls gained in draft mode during the event will contribute points to the faction of your chosen Warlord and to your Alliance. Reach milestones to unlock a greater prize at the end of the event for all participating Alliances members.
特别选秀活动！活动期间在选秀模式中获得的所有头骨将为你的神选者战将和你的联盟贡献积分。达到里程碑以解锁活动结束时为所有参与联盟成员的更大奖励。

Event_Description/Draft/UMRF2/Descriptio: Prepare the Imperium's defences as the Ultramarines and Astra Militarum or join the assaulting forces to engulf it in darkness. Which side will you guide to victory?
准备帝国的防御设施，作为极限战士和星界军，或者加入攻击力量，将其淹没在黑暗中。你会引导哪一方取得胜利？

MainMenu/Event/EventModeDesc:
Choose a Warlord to lead your army and face other players in grand battles across the grim dark Galaxy!
Draft your way to victory by picking between the offered card packs to create your event deck.
Explore the drafting menu during the demo and see how many victories you can achieve!

• Unlock the Premium rewards in this faction's Campaign, including a Starter Deck and a Legendary Card in the first node.
• <color=#E98A00FF>{0}</color> Campaign Points for this faction in the Daily Login Bonus, every day, just for logging in. If you have several Premium Campaigns, you get this bonus for ALL of them!
• This one-time purchase will provide benefits for this faction forever, as the last Campaign node can be claimed repeatedly!

• 解锁此派系的Campaign中的Premium奖励，包括首个节点的入门卡组和一张传奇牌。
• <color=#E98A00FF>{0}</color> 每天只需登录，就能在每日登录奖励中为此派系获得Campaign积分。如果你有多个Premium Campaign，那么所有的都可以获得这个奖励！
• 这个一次性购买将为此派系永久提供利益，因为最后一个Campaign节点可以反复领取！

MainMenu/Welcome/Subtitle:
War rages across the stars. Ancient civilisations and upstart empires fight endless battles across innumerable worlds. 
Humanity stands alone, beset on all sides by the heretic, the mutant, and the alien. 
There is no mercy. There is no respite. Choose your faction and get ready for battle!

战争蔓延星辰。旗手文明和新兴帝国在无数世界中争战。
人类孤独站立，被异教徒、突变体和外星人从四面八方围攻。
没有仁慈。没有喘息。选择你的阵营，准备战斗！

MainMenu/Welcome/SubtitleAfterTutorial:
You are now ready to plunge yourself into the grim darkness of the 41st Millennium.
Discover the core mechanics of each faction in Practice Mode, sharpen your skills in Draft Mode, or test your mettle in Multiplayer Mode.
All game modes allow you to complete Missions and progress through the Campaign. Remember you can change your preferred faction at any time.
Good luck on the battlefield!

你现在已经准备好投身于这场关乎银河系存亡的末日之战！
在练习模式中探索每个军队的核心机制，在选秀模式中磨练你的技巧，或在多人模式中测试你的勇气。
所有游戏模式都允许你完成布道所并在战役中取得进展。记住，你可以随时更改你喜欢的军队。
祝你在战场上好运！

Titles/1f6cd29e489414b92a3a21d6a94fb1ad: 看不见的仪式的守护者
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Prebattle/Ventris: Lord Calgar. The Ork horde is preparing to attack.
卡尔加尔领主。欧克蛮人的大军正准备攻击。
I am always ready, Lord. Let us begin.
我总是准备好的，领主。让我们开始吧。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn1/Calgar1: Regular sparring keeps our reflexes sharp and hones our technique.
定期的切磋让我们的反应更敏锐，技术更熟练。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn1/Ventris1: I could not ask for a more worthy opponent.
我无法找到比你更值得的对手。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn2/Calgar1: I have ordered some of our battle-brothers to assist.
我已经命令我们的一些战斗修士来协助。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn2/Ventris1: A Reiver! An expert in close-combat. I should keep him at range.
一个劫掠者！近战专家。我应该让他保持距离。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn3/Calgar1: A wise move, Captain. But you cannot always fight alone.
连长，明智的举动。但你不能总是独自战斗。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn3/Calgar2: Let us both bring in reinforcements.
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn5/Calgar1: You learn the most from your losses. Take these lessons with you into future battles.
你从失败中学到的最多。把这些教训带入未来的战斗。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn5/Ventris1: Come, Brothers, let us fight. For Courage and Honour!
来吧，兄弟们，让我们为了勇气和荣誉而战！
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn6/Ventris1: I should strike swiftly, to deal with his troops before I am overwhelmed.
我应该迅速攻击他的军队，以免我被压倒。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn6/Calgar1: A shrewd strategy, as defined in the Codex Astartes.
这是阿斯塔特圣典中定义的精明策略。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn7/Ventris1: Now I must press the advantage!
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn7/Ventris2: I have taken a lot of damage. I must be more cautious, and utilise the strength of my brothers.
我受到了很大的伤害。我必须更加谨慎，并利用我的兄弟们的力量。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn8/Calgar1: Well done, Uriel. You are, as ever, an exacting student.
做得好，乌列尔。你一如既往，是个严格的学生。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn8/Radio1: Lord Calgar. Captain Ventris. Your presence is requested at the frontline. The Orks have begun their attack!
卡尔加尔领主。连长文特里斯。需要你们在前线。欧克蛮人已经开始他们的攻击！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn1/Ventris1: Brothers! Today we fight for the Emperor and the Imperium. We march for Macragge!
兄弟们！今天我们为帝皇和帝国而战。我们为马库拉格而行！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn6/Ventris1: These Orks are stronger than they look. Ultramarines, withdraw and regroup.
这些欧克蛮人比他们看起来更强大。极限战士，撤退并重新组织
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn1/Ventris1_OU: Brothers! Today we fight for freedom. For the Emperor. For honour and courage!
兄弟们！今天我们为自由而战。为帝皇。为荣誉和勇气！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn6/Ventris1_OU: These Orks are stronger than they look. Ultramarines, fall back and regroup!
这些欧克蛮人比他们看起来更强大。极限战士，后退并重新集结！
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Prebattle/Calgar2: First, Uriel, I want you to show me you are ready. Face me in combat!
首先，乌列尔，我希望你向我证明你已经准备好。和我进行战斗！
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn4/Ventris1: Two targets. My brother and I stand ready.
两个目标。我和我的兄弟准备就绪。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn8/Ventris1: 是时候结束这场战斗了。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Prebattle/Ventris: Lord Calgar! The Greenskin horde is preparing to attack!
卡尔加尔领主！绿皮兽人部队正在准备攻击！
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Prebattle/Calgar1: Good. Let them come. We’ll show them what it means to fight Space Marines.
很好。让他们来。我们将向他们展示与星际战士战斗的意义。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Prebattle/Ventris: I’m always ready, Lord. Let’s fight.
我总是准备好的，主人。让我们战斗。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn1/Calgar1_OUT: It feels good to spar, don’t you think?
感觉好像在切磋，你不觉得吗？
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn1/Tip1:
This is your Warlord.
He has an Attack value of 2.
Drag onto the enemy to attack.

这是你的战将。
他的攻击值为2。
拖到敌人上进行攻击。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn1/Tip2: You deal damage equal to your Attack value, lowering the enemy's Health.
你造成等于你攻击值的伤害，降低敌人的生命值。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn1/Tip3: The enemy fights back though! You also take damage equal to their Attack value.
敌人也会反击！你也会受到等于他们攻击值的伤害。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn1/Ventris1_OU: Always. I couldn’t ask for a more worthy opponent.
总是。我找不到更值得的对手了。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn2/Calgar1_OUT: Let’s liven things up. I’ve asked some of our Battle-Brothers to assist.
让我们活跃一下。我已经请了一些我们的战斗修士来帮忙。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn2/Tip1: You win the match when the enemy Warlord’s Health drops to zero and dies.
当敌人的战将的生命值降到零并死亡时，你就赢得了比赛。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn2/Tip2: However, if your Warlord dies first, you lose. Be careful!
然而，如果你的战将先死，你就输了。要小心！
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn2/Ventris1_OU: At close-combat, he’ll tear me apart. I should keep him at range.
在近战中，他会把我撕成碎片。我应该让他保持距离。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn2/Ventris1OLD: A Reiver! At close-combat, he’ll tear me apart. I should keep him at range.
劫掠者！在近战中，他会把我撕成碎片。我应该让他保持距离。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn3/Calgar1_OUT: A smart move, Captain. But you cannot always fight alone.
连长，你的举动很聪明。但你不能总是独自战斗。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn3/Calgar2_OUT: Let us both call upon our Battle-Brothers to fight.
让我们召唤我们的战斗修士来战斗。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn3/Tip1: Initiate a normal attack, then switch to Ranged mode.
发动一次普通攻击，然后切换到远程模式。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn3/Tip2: Now drag your Warlord onto the Primaris Reiver to do a Ranged Attack.
现在将你的战将拖到原铸劫掠者上进行远程攻击。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn3/Tip3: Always choose your attack mode carefully. Deal as much damage as you can while taking as little in return.
总是仔细选择你的攻击模式。尽可能多地造成伤害，同时尽可能少地承受伤害。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn4/Tip1: You draw one card per turn, and can hold up to 10 cards at once.
你每回合抽一张牌，一次最多可以持有10张牌。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn4/Tip2: Deploy your Primaris Intercessor by dragging the card onto the battlefield.
通过将张牌拖到战场上来部署你的Primaris仲裁者。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn4/Tip3: Newly-deployed troops can’t attack until the next turn.
新部署的军队在下一个回合前不能攻击。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn5/Calgar1_OUT: There is no shame in falling to a superior force.
向更强大的力量屈服并无可耻。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn5/Tip1: Defeat the Primaris Reiver with your Intercessor with a Ranged Attack.
用你的仲裁者进行远程攻击，击败Primaris劫掠者。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn5/Ventris1_OU: Then I shall become the superior force. Come, Brothers, let us fight!
那么我将成为优势力量。来吧，兄弟们，让我们战斗！
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn6/Ventris1_OU: I should deal with his troops while I can, before I get overwhelmed.
我应该在我还能应对的时候处理他的军队，免得我被淹没。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn6/Calgar1_OUT: A wise strategy, as defined in the Codex Astartes.
这是一种明智的策略，如阿斯塔特圣典所定义的。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn6/Tip1:
Playing a card costs Energy.
Each turn, your Energy replenishes and increases by 1.

出牌需要能量。
每轮，你的能量会恢复并增加1。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn6/Tip2: You lack Energy to deploy a Devastator Centurion, but both Reivers can be played.
你缺乏能量来部署破坏者百夫长，但两个劫掠者都可以被打出。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn7/Tip1: You don’t need to attack every turn. Sometimes it is wiser to hold back.
你不需要每个回合都攻击。有时候，保持克制更明智。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn7/Ventris1_OU: Now I can put the pressure on.
现在我可以施加压力了。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn7/Ventris2_OU: I’ve taken a lot of damage. I'll be cautious, and let my brothers fight this time.
我受了很多伤。我会小心，让我的兄弟们这次战斗。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn8/Calgar1_OUT: Well done, Uriel. You are as ever a good student.
做得好，乌列尔。你一如既往是个好学生。
TutorialData/Tutorial1/Turn8/Radio1_OUT: Lord Calgar. Captain Ventris. Come quickly. The Orks have begun their attack!
Lord Calgar。连长Ventris。快来。欧克蛮人已经开始他们的攻击！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Prebattle/Ghazghk: Come on boyz! We’z gonna give deez Space Marine gitz a gud krumpin’!
来吧，小子们！我们要给这些星际战士们一顿好痛打！
Dat’s der fightin’ spirit! Hear dat, boyz? It’s time for WAAAAAAGHHHH!
那就是战斗的精神！听到了吗，小子们？是WAAAAAAGHHHH的时间了！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Prebattle/Radio1: Boss! Boss! I brought me stabba, boss! Let me at ‘em!
老大！老大！我带了我的刺刀，老大！让我去打他们！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn1/Tip1: Most units have special abilities. Makari gives adjacent units a Melee Attack bonus.
大多数单位都有特殊能力。玛卡里给相邻单位提供近战攻击加成。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn2/Ghazghkull1: 伙伴？这里只有一个地精。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn2/Ghazghkull2: I’z can never get any peace round ‘ere.
我在这里永远得不到任何的安宁。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn4/Ghazghkull1: Yeah… Sumtting dat’ll hit deez Space Marine boyz ‘ard.
是的...有些东西会对这些星际战士小子造成重创。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn5/Ghazghkull1: I’z is da mighty Ghazghkull, and I’z got skillz of me own!
我是强大的碎骨者，我有我自己的技能！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn2/Ghazghkull2: Enough standin' around. Let's get to fightin'.
别再站着不动了。我们开始战斗吧。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn4/Ghazghkull1: Yeah… Sumtting dat’ll hit deez Space Marine boyz ded ‘ard.
是的...有些东西会对这些星际战士小子造成重创。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn5/Ghazghkull1: I’z is da mighty Ghazghkull, and I’z got cunnin' of me own!
我是强大的碎骨者，我有我自己的技能！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn2/Radio1: Look boss, I brought me mates, too!
看老大，我也带来了我的伙伴！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn2/Radio2: Just you wait, boss. Just you wait!
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn2/Radio3: Don’ worry, boss. I’ll be back.
别担心，老大。我会回来的。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn2/Tip1: The [[tide]] trait lets you play multiple copies of the same card this turn.
[[tide]]特性让你在这个回合可以打出多张相同的张牌。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn2/Tip2: Click on a card to see what it does. Hover over a trait to see its definition. Try it with Makari.
点击一张牌看看它的作用。将鼠标悬停在特性上查看其定义。试试看玛卡里。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn3/Tip1: Troops with [[mob]] trigger an effect when a friendly unit does a Melee attack.
拥有[[mob]]的军队在友方单位进行近战攻击时会触发一个效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn3/Tip2: Take control! Deploy Makari, attack with your units, and end the turn when ready.
接管控制权！部署玛卡里，用你的单位攻击，准备好时结束回合。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn4/Radio1: Boss, I fink we need new tactics!
老大，我觉得我们需要新的策略！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn4/Tip1: Stratagems are special cards that have an instant effect on the battle.
计谋是特殊的张牌，它们对战斗有即时效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn4/Tip3: Units with [[vanguard]] protect other friendly units from being attacked.
拥有[[vanguard]]的单位可以保护其他友方单位不被攻击。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn5/Tip1: Warlords and some troops have [[talent]]. Each turn, they create a Stratagem in your hand.
战将和一些军队拥有[[talent]]。每轮，他们在你的手中创造一个计谋。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn5/Tip2: Cards with [[ephemeral]] will disappear at the end of the turn if they are not used.
拥有[[ephemeral]]的张牌如果在回合结束时未使用，将会消失。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn5/Tip3: Take control! Attack with your units, and end the turn when ready.
接管控制权！用你的单位攻击，准备好时结束回合。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn6/Ghazghkull1: 让我们结束这场战斗，小子们！WAAAAAGH！
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn6/Ghazghkull2: Whole worlds burn in my boot prints.
整个世界在我的脚印中燃烧。
TutorialData/Tutorial2/Turn6/Tip1: It’s now up to you to drive back the Space Marines. Use what you've learned to win this battle!
现在轮到你驱退星际战士。利用你所学的知识赢得这场战斗！
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Prebattle/Orikan1: I have foreseen the future… and you wouldn’t like it.
我已经预见了未来……你不会喜欢的。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Prebattle/Zahndre: Ready my legions – a glorious victory will be mine.
准备我的军团 - 辉煌的胜利将属于我。
No tricks or illusions will ever fool me.
没有任何技巧或幻觉能够欺骗我。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn1/Tip1: Many Necron troops have the [[remnant]] trait. When killed, they leave a Remnant on the board.
许多太空死灵的军队都有[[remnant]]特性。当他们被杀死时，他们会在棋盘上留下一个残余。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn2/Orikan1: Do you call that a strategy?
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn2/Orikan2: Your tiny mind is no match for mine.
你微小的思维无法与我的相匹敌。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn2/Tip1: Remnants can be Reanimated with certain cards and abilities. Some troops trigger a special effect when Reanimated.
剩余可以通过某些卡牌和技能重新唤醒。一些军队在重新唤醒时会触发特殊效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn2/Tip2: Remnants only remain in play until the end of their owner's turn.
剩余只会留在游戏中直到其所有者回合结束。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn2/Zahndrekh1: In a tangled web of outcomes, I will find the way.
在纷繁复杂的结果中，我将找到出路。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn3/Orikan1: Do what you will - you will soon be forgotten.
随你怎么做 - 你很快就会被遗忘。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn3/Zahndrekh1: An inferior opponent can be crushed without a moment’s thought.
一个劣质的对手可以在一瞬间被粉碎。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn4/Orikan1: A tiny adjustment to my calculations can have sweeping results.
对我的计算进行微小的调整可以产生广泛的结果。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn4/Tip1: Troops with [[artifice]] trigger the effect when using a stratagem.
拥有[[artifice]]的军队在你使用计谋时会触发一个效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn4/Tip2: Some troops trigger a special effect when Reanimated.
一些军队在复活时会触发特殊效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn4/Zahndrekh1: My legions will be reborn, and your defeat is inevitable.
我的军团将重生，你的失败是不可避免的。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn5/Orikan1: My name has been written throughout the aeons.
我的名字已经写在了永恒之中。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn5/Tip1: Attacking or damaging a Remnant will destroy it.
攻击或损坏残余会将其摧毁。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn5/Zahndrekh1: A moment’s reflection begets my victory.
片刻的反思使我取得胜利。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn6/Orikan1: You defied my predictions, and I must respect that.
你违背了我的预测，我必须尊重这一点。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Turn6/Tip1: Carry on playing and finish off your opponent.
继续游戏并击败你的对手。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Victory/Orikan1: Clearly, I need to go back in time and make adjustments.
显然，我需要回到过去做些调整。
TutorialData/Tutorial3/Victory/Zahndrekh: I am eternal; victory shall be mine.
我是永恒的；胜利将属于我。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Prebattle/Sylar1: Come with me - I will open your eyes to the warp.
跟我来 - 我会让你看到亚空间。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Prebattle/Sylar2: Why hold back? Unleash your true potential!
为什么要退缩？释放你的真正潜力！
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Prebattle/Varro1: There is no honour in foolishness.
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn2/Sylar1: I command powers beyond what you could possibly fathom.
我指挥的力量超出了你可能探寻的范围。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn2/Sylar2: Embrace Chaos before it’s too late!
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn2/Tip1: This Troop will deal 2 damage to an enemy when receiving a [[markOfChaos]].
这支军队在收到 [[markOfChaos]] 时将对一个敌人造成 2 点伤害。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn2/Tip2: The [[markOfKhorne]] gives the troop +2 Melee Attack and [[vanguard]].
这个 [[markOfKhorne]] 会使军队获得 +2 近战攻击和 [[vanguard]]。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn3/Sylar1: I will follow Abaddon to the end of everything!
我会跟随阿巴顿到一切的尽头！
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn3/Tip2: The Noise Marine gains a [[markOfSlaanesh]] when your warlord takes damage.
当你的战将受到伤害时，噪音战士会获得一个[[markOfSlaanesh]]。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn3/Tip3: The [[markOfSlaanesh]] grants +2 Melee Attack and +2 Ranged Attack.
该 [[markOfSlaanesh]] 赋予+2近战攻击和+2远程攻击。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn4/Sylar1: There is always a method to insanity.
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn4/Tip1: More than one [[markOfChaos]] can be stacked on a troop.
一个军队上可以叠加多个 [[markOfChaos]]。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn4/Varro1: I can see through your plan.
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn5/Sylar1: You are just a plaything of the Gods.
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn5/Tip1: [[vulnerable]] amplifies the damage received by enemies.
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn6/Tip1: [[markOfNurgle]] 会使目标获得 +1 生命值，并 [[regeneration]] 1。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn6/Varro1: The future is not set, hope always glimmers.
未来并非既定，希望总是闪烁。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn7/Tip1: 这张 [[markOfTzeentch]] 卡牌赋予+2生命值和 [[camouflage]]。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn7/Tip2: Troops with [[strike]] trigger an effect when attacking.
具有 [[strike]] 的部队在攻击时触发效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn7/Tip3: Some cards amplify their effects based on the number of Dark Pacts on your troops
一些卡牌会根据你的军队上的黑暗契约数量来增强它们的效果
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Turn8/Tip3: It’s now up to you to defeat Tigurius. Finish him off!
现在轮到你击败Tigurius。把他干掉！
TutorialData/Tutorial4/Victory/Varro1: May Ultramar stand in the times to be.
愿奥特拉玛在未来的时代中屹立不倒。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Prebattle/Ghaelyn: Travelling the webway brings many surprises.
穿越网道总会带来许多惊喜。
You are interlopers, and you will be repelled.
你们是入侵者，你们将被击退。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Prebattle/Imotekh: The galaxy will only know peace when I am its ruler.
只有我成为其统治者，银河系才会知道和平。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn1/Ghaelyn1: Cleanse this place! We must protect the Craftworld!
让我们净化这个地方！我们必须保护方舟世界！
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn1/Imotekh1: You will whisper my name with fear and respect.
你会带着恐惧和尊重低声呼唤我的名字。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn1/Tip1: When attacking with a unit with [[shuriken]], it will immediately deal its [[shuriken]] damage.
当使用具有[[shuriken]]的单位进行攻击时，它将立即造成其[[shuriken]]的伤害。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn1/Tip2: If this damage defeats the enemy unit, it will not have the chance to retaliate.
如果这个伤害击败了敌人的单位，它将没有机会反击。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn1/Tip3: Remember that the [[shuriken]] ability only triggers when attacking!
记住：只有在攻击时才会触发 [[shuriken]] 能力！
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn1/Tip4: Units with [[shuriken]] are very effective on the offense but weaker on the defence.
装备[[shuriken]]的单位在进攻上非常有效，但在防守上较弱。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn2/Ghaelyn1: A swift assault is the best approach.
迅速的攻击是最好的方法。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn2/Imotekh1: I will show you the futility of your actions.
我会让你看到你行动的徒劳。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn3/Ghaelyn1: I will not let this sanctuary be corrupted.
我不会让这个圣所被污染。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn3/Imotekh1: You can’t stop that which has been set in motion.
你无法阻止已经启动的事物。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn4/Ghaelyn1: The wrath of Khaine grows within me!
凯恩的愤怒在我体内增长！
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn4/Tip1: Units with the [[waystone]] ability will drop a Spirit Stone when destroyed.
具有 [[waystone]] 能力的单位在被摧毁时会掉落一颗灵魂石。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn4/Tip2: Click on the Spirit Stone to collect it.
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn4/Tip3: You can keep the tally of collected Spirit Stones here.
你可以在这里记录收集到的灵魂石的数量。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn4/Tip4: If you have enough Spirit Stones, some cards will consume them when played to trigger additional effects.
如果你有足够的灵魂石，一些张牌在出牌时会消耗它们以触发额外的效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn5/Imotekh1: Your life is a brief flicker to that of an immortal.
你的生命对于不朽者来说只是短暂的闪烁。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn5/Tip1: Spirit Stones are destroyed when attacked or damaged.
当被攻击或受到伤害时，灵魂石会被摧毁。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn7/Tip1: Both Troops and Stratagems can consume Spirit Stones to trigger additional effects.
军队和计谋都可以消耗灵魂石来触发额外的效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn7/Tip2: Plan your actions carefully and decide when to collect and spend Spirit Stones.
仔细规划你的行动，决定何时收集和花费灵魂石。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Turn8/Tip1: Carry on playing and drive out the interlopers!
继续游戏并驱逐入侵者！
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Victory/Ghaelyn1: My life has been spent preparing for this.
我一生都在为此做准备。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Victory/Ghaelyn2: When the Craftworlds unite, we will prevail.
当方舟世界联合时，我们将会胜利。
TutorialData/Tutorial5/Victory/Imotekh1: You proved yourself to be a worthy foe.
你证明了自己是一个值得对手。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Prebattle/Uriel1: It seems the distress signal came in too late. This world is almost overrun.
看来救援信号来得太晚了。这个世界几乎被占领了。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Prebattle/Uriel2: Bolters ready! We must cleanse this infestation!
爆矢枪准备好！我们必须清除这个侵扰！
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn1/Uriel1: We will not fail, we are Ultramarines.
我们不会失败，我们是极限战士。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn2/Uriel1: No pest will stand against the might of the Imperium!
没有任何害虫能抵挡住帝国的力量！
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn3/Tip1: Troops with [[swarm]] can merge together into a single troop to add their stats.
具有 [[swarm]] 的军队可以合并成一个军队，以增加它们的属性。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn3/Tip2: To have two troops [[swarm]] together, play the new troop to the LEFT of the one in board.
要让两个军队[[swarm]]在一起，将新的军队放在棋盘上的军队的左边。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn3/Uriel1: Stay alert! The creatures are moving in strange patterns…
保持警惕！这些生物正在以奇怪的模式移动...
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn4/Uriel1: I will tear you down and destroy you in His name.
我将以他的名义击败你，毁灭你。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn5/Tip1: Sometimes you will not want your troops to [[swarm]] together, even if they can.
有时候，即使你的部队可以群集在一起，你也不想让它们[[swarm]]。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn5/Tip2: If you play your troop anywhere OTHER than LEFT of a troop on board with the same name, they will not [[swarm]].
如果你在棋盘上的军队的其他位置放置你的军队，而不是左边，他们将不会[[虫群]]。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn6/Tip1: Units with [[synapse]] transfer the benefits of Stratagems you play on them to adjacent units
具有 [[synapse]] 的单位将你对其使用的计谋效果传递给相邻的单位。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn6/Uriel1: There! That large Xenos seems to be strengthening the lesser ones.
那里！那个大异形似乎在增强那些次要的异形。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn6/Uriel2: Bring that thing down! We must kill it to break the synaptic link.
把那个东西打倒！我们必须杀死它才能断开突触链接。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn7/Tip1: Some troops will provide additional effects when you trigger [[synapse]] on a friendly unit.
当你对一支友方单位触发 [[synapse]] 时，一些军队将提供额外效果。
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Turn7/Tip2: Carry on playing and finish off Uriel Ventris.
TutorialData/Tutorial6/Victory/Uriel1: This place is no longer safe. Fall back!
这个地方不再安全。后退！
TutorialData/TutorialMessage/GoToMission: Great battle! You can now claim your mission reward to boost your progress and strengthen your deck. Let's check your reward.
伟大的战斗！你现在可以领取你的布道所奖励以提升你的进步并强化你的卡组。让我们看看你的奖励。
TutorialData/TutorialMessage/CheckMissio: Here you will find your active missions. Completing a mission's objective rewards you with <color=#E98A00FF>Campaign points</color> for your active Campaign. <color=#8CEC39FF>Let's claim your Campaign points</color>.
在这里，你会找到你的活跃任务。完成任务目标会为你的活跃布道所奖励<color=#E98A00FF>布道所积分</color>。<color=#8CEC39FF>让我们来领取你的布道所积分</color>。
TutorialData/TutorialMessage/GoToCampaig: Great! Let's <color=#8CEC39FF>head to the Campaign menu</color> and spend your <color=#E98A00FF>Campaing points</color> on powerful rewards.
太好了！让我们<color=#8CEC39FF>前往布道所菜单</color>，并用你的<color=#E98A00FF>布道所积分</color>兑换强大的奖励。
TutorialData/TutorialMessage/InCampaignD: A faction's <color=#E98A00FF>Campaign track</color> is a great way to get new cards. <color=#8CEC39FF>Use the points</color> you get when completing missions to unlock new cards, cosmetics and more. <color=#8CEC39FF>Let's unlock your first reward node!</color>
一个派系的<color=#E98A00FF>布道所轨迹</color>是获得新张牌的好方法。<color=#8CEC39FF>使用积分</color>，你在完成任务时获得的积分来解锁新的张牌，化妆品和更多。<color=#8CEC39FF>让我们解锁你的第一个奖励节点！</color>
TutorialData/TutorialMessage/LevelUpCard: You now have more than one copy of your Warlord. You can use the extra copies to <color=#E98A00FF>forge it and level up</color> the card's visual appearance. You will also get <color=#E98A00FF>Forge points</color>, which will net you additional rewards. <color=#8CEC39FF>Let's go to your collection and upgrade your Warlord!</color>
你现在有超过一份的战将副本。你可以使用额外的副本来<color=#E98A00FF>锻造并升级</color>张牌的视觉外观。你也会得到<color=#E98A00FF>锻造积分</color>，这将为你带来额外的奖励。<color=#8CEC39FF>让我们去你的收藏并升级你的战将！</color>
TutorialData/TutorialMessage/GoToForgeDe: Each card upgrade gives you <color=#E98A00FF>Forge points</color> for the faction it belongs to. <color=#8CEC39FF>Let's visit the Forge</color> and check your progess.
每张牌的升级都会为它所属的派系提供<color=#E98A00FF>锻造积分</color>。<color=#8CEC39FF>让我们去锻造厂</color>看看你的进度。
TutorialData/TutorialMessage/InForgeDesc: Use card duplicates to level up your card's visuals and earn <color=#E98A00FF>Forge points</color>. Each faction's forge has great rewards, including <color=#E98A00FF>offensive and defensive cards</color> that can't be obtained in any other place. <color=#8CEC39FF>Claim your first reward</color> before joining the fight again!
使用张牌副本来升级你的张牌视觉并获得<color=#E98A00FF>锻造积分</color>。每个派系的锻造厂都有大奖，包括<color=#E98A00FF>攻击和防御张牌</color>，这些都不能在其他任何地方获得。<color=#8CEC39FF>在再次加入战斗之前领取你的第一个奖励</color>！
Warlord_Lore/GOF28: Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka is a mighty prophet of the Waaagh! He is the most influential greenskin in the galaxy, and commands billions to war.
碎骨者·斯拉卡是Waaagh的强大先知！他是银河系中最有影响力的绿皮怪，指挥无数欧克蛮人参战。
Warlord_Lore/GOF27: Boss of a band of Stormboyz, Zagstruk is known for his ambition and his temper. He has a pair of bionic legs called Da Vulcha’s Klaws, which he uses to rip his foes apart.
札格斯查克是风暴小子的一群头目，以其野心和脾气而闻名。他有一对名为秃鹫之爪的仿生腿，他用它们撕裂敌人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF29: Grukk Face-Rippa is huge, even by Ork warboss standards. He is known for his giant power klaw and a temper that has started countless wars.
格鲁克·脸撕者巨大，即使按照欧克蛮人战争头目的标准。他以他的巨大能量爪和引发无数战争的脾气而闻名。
Warlord_Lore/GOF1: Cannon fodder, living shields, mine-field sweepers, emergency rations... A cunning Grot will always have a place and opportunities in Ork society.
炮灰，活动盾牌，扫雷者，紧急口粮... 在欧克蛮人社会中，狡猾的地精总会有一席之地和机会。
Warlord_Lore/GOF2: Ghazghkull's official banner-waver. Makari is considered the luckiest grot alive, after surviving nine whole years next to Ghazghkull and being reincarnated multiple times.
碎骨者的官方旗手。玛卡里被认为是最幸运的地精，因为他在碎骨者旁边活了整整九年，并且多次转世。
Warlord_Lore/GOF3: In a rare flash of genius, the Orks discovered that the only thing needed to make Squigs more destructive was to fit as many explosives as possible on them.
在一次罕见的天才闪现中，欧克蛮人发现，让跳跳更具破坏性的唯一方法就是在它们身上装上尽可能多的炸药。
Warlord_Lore/6953a78f17b3b404e87967beecc: Rough and tough to their core, Ork Boyz are the mainstay of Ork Mobs. At the shout of "WAAAGH!" these mobs will charge forward against the enemy in a flurry of gore and violence.
欧克蛮人小子粗糙而坚韧，是欧克蛮人暴群的主力。在"WAAAGH!"的呼喊下，这些暴群会在血腥和暴力的风暴中冲向敌人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF5: Tough and determined, these Orks are carried by Trukks, heavy transport vehicles capable of dropping whole mobs where they can do their best choppin'.
坚韧和坚决，这些欧克蛮人乘坐蛮人卡车，这些重型运输车辆能够将整个暴群投入战斗，他们可以砍杀敌人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF6: Stormboyz use rokkit packs to hurl themselves into battle. Braking systems are rare in Ork gadgets, so they will only stop when hitting an enemy, a wall or running out of fuel.
风暴小子使用火箭背包投身战斗。欧克蛮人的装备中很少有刹车系统，所以他们只有在撞到敌人、墙壁或者燃料耗尽时才会停下来。
Warlord_Lore/GOF4: Capable of both chopin' and shootin', these versatile boyz charge while unleashing a flurry of bullets with their Sluggas and finish the job up close and personal.
这些多功能的小子在冲锋时用短铳发射一阵子弹，然后在近战中完成任务。
Warlord_Lore/GOF8: The Hornhelmz were one of the battle-hardened mobs at the core of Ghazghkull’s Waaagh! during the first invasion of Armageddon.
号角盔小子孩是碎骨者的Waaagh中最有经验的暴群之一，在哈米吉多顿的第一次入侵中处于核心地位。
Warlord_Lore/GOF9: Even if they disregard marksmanship, there is nothing orks love more than good "dakka". This is likely due to their enjoyment of the violent noise and recoil of automated gunfire.
即使他们忽视了射击技巧，欧克蛮人最喜欢的还是好的"达卡"。这可能是因为他们喜欢自动枪火的暴力噪音和后坐力。
Warlord_Lore/GOF14: Due to their aggressive nature it is inevitable for Orks to receive many scars. Veteran Orks show off their scars with pride and arrogance as a symbol of status.
由于他们的侵略性，欧克蛮人不可避免地会受到许多伤疤。老兵欧克蛮人以骄傲和傲慢的态度展示他们的伤疤，作为地位的象征。
Warlord_Lore/GOF13: Lootaz steal and scavenge enemy weaponry to gather bits and pieces for the Meks, who use this material to build, among other things, the Deffguns that Lootas use in battle.
这些欧克蛮人偷窃和搜刮敌人的武器，为技师收集零碎的材料，技师用这些材料制造了许多东西，包括战利品者在战斗中使用的死亡之枪。
Warlord_Lore/GOF11: The most respected Nobs carry the warband's banner into battle. Banner Nobs are inspiring and fearsome in combat, especially when they learn the banner can be used as a weapon.
最受尊敬的强蛮人在战斗中携带战队的旗帜。旗帜强蛮人在战斗中鼓舞人心，令人畏惧，尤其是当他们学会可以将旗帜用作武器时。
Warlord_Lore/GOF21: Mekboys are in charge of creating the greatest "dakka" and mantaining all of the Ork's vehicles and weaponry. Without them, Orks would lack much of their fighting power.
技师小子负责创造最大的"达卡"并维护所有欧克蛮人的车辆和武器。没有他们，欧克蛮人将失去他们的大部分战斗力。
Warlord_Lore/GOF15: The Orks that other Orks are scared of. Burna Boyz are lunatics that will set anything or anyone on fire for the simple joy of watching them "do the burny dance".
其他欧克蛮人都害怕的欧克蛮人。喷火小子是疯子，他们会为了简单的看他们在火焰中跳舞的乐趣而点燃任何东西或任何人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF16: Orks prefer direct solutions, such as huge, armoured, hydraulic killing-klaws. Orks who get obsessed with this way of war are known as Big Krumpaz.
欧克蛮人更喜欢直接的解决方案，比如巨大的，装甲的，液压杀手爪。对这种战争方式着迷的欧克蛮人被称为大克朗帕兹。
Warlord_Lore/GOF18: Orks will only seek help from Painboyz when they have no other choice. Returning to the battlefield is often more appealing than a Painboy's anesthesia, also known as a concussion.
欧克蛮人只有在别无选择的时候才会寻求痛苦小子的帮助。返回战场通常比痛苦小子的麻醉更具吸引力，也就是所谓的脑震荡。
Warlord_Lore/GOF17: The smallest of Ork combat walkers. After a volunteer Grot is forced into a Killa Kan and feels the rush of power, they often seek Orks that tormented him in the past for a rematch.
欧克蛮人战斗步行机器中最小的一种。当一名自愿的地精被强行塞进杀戮机甲并感受到力量的冲击后，他们常常寻找过去折磨他的欧克蛮人进行复仇。
Warlord_Lore/GOF19: After a thunderous headbutt from Ghazghkull, Ugrak saw the light (many lights, actually) and decided to pledge his red power klaw to the hardest-hitting Warlord he had ever met.
在碎骨者·斯拉卡的一次雷鸣般的头槌后，乌格拉克看到了光明（实际上是很多光明）并决定将他的红色能量爪献给他所遇到的最强大的军阀。
Warlord_Lore/GOF20: Thrill-seeking Orks will never be satisfied by ground-based exhilaration. These individuals, considered unstable by other Orks, take to the skies in search of greater euphoria.
寻求刺激的欧克蛮人永远不会满足于地面上的兴奋。这些被其他欧克蛮人认为不稳定的个体，会冲向天空寻找更大的快感。
Warlord_Lore/GOF23: Only the hardest of the hard have what it takes to join Da Goff Guard of Ghazghkull Thraka. To spot 'Ardshell Gurk in battle, just look for the second biggest bloodbath.
只有最强硬的战士才有资格加入碎骨者·斯拉卡的戈夫卫队。要在战场上找到硬壳格尔克，只需寻找第二大的血战即可。
Warlord_Lore/GOF24: Most Orks hate being knocked out before chopping a git during battle. Battlewagons solve that issue, carrying them into the front lines while shrugging off enemy fire.
大多数欧克蛮人讨厌在战斗中砍敌人前被击倒。战斗堡垒解决了这个问题，他们在抵挡敌人火力的同时将欧克蛮人带入前线。
Warlord_Lore/GOF26: Fairly compared to an armour-plated mountain covered in guns, the Stompa is a walking idol to Gork and Mork. These gargantuan war machines sometimes reach the size of a Reaver Titan.
与一个覆盖着枪炮的装甲板山相比，践踏巨机是对格克和摩克的行走偶像。这些巨大的战争机器有时会达到劫掠者泰坦的大小。
Warlord_Lore/GOF30: Squigs are some of the most common Ork pets. As it's customary in Ork "Kultur", they can also be weaponized and thrown against an enemy.
跳跳是欧克蛮人最常见的宠物。按照欧克蛮人的习俗，他们也可以被武器化并投向敌人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF32: Snotlings are unable to use Ork weaponry, which resulted in them occupying the lowest strata of Ork society. Still, do not trust any Orkoid near explosive material.
鼻涕精无法使用欧克蛮人的武器，这导致他们处于欧克蛮人社会的最底层。然而，不要信任任何靠近爆炸物的绿皮肤生物。
Warlord_Lore/GOF33: Orks display inhuman degrees of resilience and are able to withstand seemingly fatal wounds that would render many unable to fight with little to no long-term consequences.
欧克蛮人展现出超人的恢复力，能够承受看似致命的伤口，这些伤口会使许多人无法战斗，但几乎没有长期后果。
Warlord_Lore/GOF34: After damaging his head with a Bolter shell, Ghazghkull believes Gork and Mork provide him with the information to conquer the Galaxy and turn the stars green.
在一颗爆矢枪弹头破坏了他的头部后，碎骨者相信格克和摩克为他提供了征服银河系并将星星变绿的信息。
Warlord_Lore/GOF38: Ork "Kultur" above all else is based entirely around fighting. As a Warboss earns victories, he also gains respect and increases the number of boyz he commands in battle.
欧克蛮人的文化完全基于战斗。随着战争头目赢得胜利，他也获得了尊重，并增加了他在战斗中指挥的小子的数量。
Warlord_Lore/GOF44: Skorchas are unreliable devices capable of spraying burning Promethium over an area where any unfortunate victim will be reduced to burning remains in seconds.
喷火器是不可靠的设备，能够在任何不幸的受害者所在的区域喷洒燃烧的钷，几秒钟内就会将他们化为燃烧的残骸。
Warlord_Lore/GOF39: A Waaagh is born when a single Warboss manages to organize a massive number of Orks and lead them to fight and conquer. They are often so large that they can raze planetary systems.
当一个战争头目设法组织大量的欧克蛮人并带领他们战斗和征服时，就会诞生一个Waaagh。他们通常如此庞大，以至于可以摧毁行星系统。
Warlord_Lore/GOF40: Orks dislike the lack of fighting to the point they will start seeking a bigger, meaner enemy right after the end of a battle.
欧克蛮人不喜欢缺乏战斗，以至于他们会在战斗结束后立即开始寻找更大、更凶狠的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF41: A way to stop an Ork from fighting might be to move all enemies out of his reach, but so far it hasn't been successfully tested given the rates of in-fighting among Orks.
阻止欧克蛮人战斗的一种方法可能是将所有的敌人移出他的攻击范围，但到目前为止，由于欧克蛮人之间的内斗率，这种方法还没有成功过。
Warlord_Lore/GOF42: Wearing an Irongob means that the wearer is a mighty warlord indeed. Many outside Ork society don't know this, but a headbutt from the wearer will be enough to teach them.
戴上铁颚意味着穿戴者确实是一位强大的军阀。许多欧克蛮人社会以外的人不知道这一点，但穿戴者的头槌足以教育他们。
Warlord_Lore/GOF46: Stormboyz jump attacks are completely unpredictable. Their Rokkit Packs allow them to raze the battlefield efficiently but are also prone to misfiring and landing failures.
风暴小子的跳跃攻击完全无法预测。他们的火箭背包允许他们有效地摧毁战场，但也容易发生误火和着陆失败。
Warlord_Lore/GOF48: Roks are hollowed-out asteroids fitted with guns, engines, and packed full of Orks itching for a fight. They can drop troops straight into battle, blasting anything that gets in the way.
岩石是被挖空的小行星，装有枪炮、引擎，并装满了渴望战斗的欧克蛮人。他们可以将军队直接投入战斗，炸掉任何挡在路上的东西。
Warlord_Lore/GOF22: A Deff Dread embodies the main ideals of Ork warfare: they're big, shooty and stompy. These combat walkers bring enough firepower to tip the scales of any battle in the Orks' favour.
死亡无畏机甲体现了欧克蛮人战争的主要理念：他们大，他们射击，他们踩踏。这些战斗步行者带来足够的火力，可以使任何战斗都倾向于欧克蛮人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF25: Gorkanauts are built with the sole purpose of being "proper killy". Equipped with a Deffstorm Mega-Shoota and the massive Klaw of Gork, they are incredibly fearsome in battle.
格克机甲的建造唯一的目的就是致命。配备了死亡风暴超级射枪和格克的巨大爪子，他们在战斗中无比可怕。
Warlord_Lore/GOF36: Coming in all shapes and sizes, the clanking walkers and vehicles of the Orks are designed with one common purpose in mind: to shoot, chop and krump any git in their way.
欧克蛮人的步行者和车辆形态各异，但设计的共同目的是：射击，砍杀和踩踏他们路上的任何敌人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF35: Ork encampments are often hard to differentiate from actual battlefields. There are countless accounts of Orks charging out of strongholds that are hidden in plain sight.
欧克蛮人的营地往往很难与实际的战场区分开来。有无数的记录，欧克蛮人从藏在人们眼前的要塞中冲出来。
Warlord_Lore/GOF37: Grukk's might and ambition pushed him to leave his planet to fight and conquer whole systems. By the time he arrived at Sanctus Reach, his Waaagh was counted in billions.
格鲁克的力量和野心推动他离开他的星球去战斗和征服整个系统。当他到达圣裁者之域时，他的Waaagh已经达到了数十亿。
Warlord_Lore/GOF7: Crazed Orks belonging to Kults of Speed favour warbikes. These deafening contraptions can be seen approaching in clouds of black exhaust smoke, their riders grinning maniacally.
疯狂的欧克蛮人属于极速帮派，他们喜欢蛮人摩托。这些震耳欲聋的装置可以看到在黑色排气烟雾中接近，他们的骑手疯狂地咧嘴笑。
Warlord_Lore/GOF10: Not wanting to be left out of the WAAAGH!, gretchin construct these small tanks to mimic their bigger Ork brethren. However, the tiny tanks have a tendency to explode.
不想被WAAAGH！排除在外，地精构造这些小坦克来模仿他们更大的欧克蛮人兄弟。然而，这些小坦克有爆炸的倾向。
Warlord_Lore/GOF12: Orky-tech defies the laws of physics, but some Orks, called Spannerz, seem to have an affinity for it nonetheless. These Orks will tinker with the ‘worky bitz’ to improve it.
欧克科技违反了物理定律，但是一些欧克蛮人似乎仍然对它有亲和力。这些欧克蛮人会对技术部分进行修补和改进。
Warlord_Lore/GOF31: A charging mob of Orks is often preceded by a vast cloud of black smoke from all the exhausts and overheating weaponry. This can help to hide their advance.
欧克蛮人的冲锋暴群通常在所有排气和过热武器的大量黑烟之前。这可以帮助隐藏他们的进攻。
Warlord_Lore/GOF43: Gretchin may be small and individually weak, but get enough of them in one place and they can be a force to be reckoned with, striking at an enemy from all angles.
地精可能小而个体弱，但是如果在一个地方有足够多的地精，他们可以成为一个不容忽视的力量，从所有角度攻击敌人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF45: Ork battlecries may seem absurd to the casual listener, but they seem to work. The amount of shouting seems to compel them all to fight even harder.
欧克蛮人的战斗口号对于偶然的听众来说可能看起来荒谬，但是它们似乎有效。大量的喊叫似乎使他们所有人更加努力地战斗。
Warlord_Lore/GOF47: Gork is the more brutally kunnin’ (or is it kunningly brutal?) of the two Ork deities, and entreating his name grants some of his strength to nearby Orks.
格克是两个欧克蛮人神祇中更残忍狡猾的一个，呼唤他的名字会赋予附近的欧克蛮人一些力量。
Warlord_Lore/GOF55: The rank and file of Ork armies, tides of Boyz crash against enemy forces as a green tide of howling violence, armed with sluggas and choppas that are as crude as they are deadly.
欧克蛮人军队的普通士兵，如绿色潮汐般的小子们对敌军发起咆哮的暴力冲击，他们手持粗糙却致命的短铳和砍刀。
Warlord_Lore/GOF56: What's faster than a Warbuggy, killier than a Warbike and flies through the air like a bird? Orks don't know, so they attach rotors and rokkits to scavenged Warbikes and pilot them into battle.
比战车更快，比蛮人摩托更杀人，像鸟一样在空中飞翔的是什么？欧克蛮人不知道，所以他们在收集来的蛮人摩托上装上旋翼和火箭，驾驶它们投入战斗。
Warlord_Lore/GOF57: Bigger and meaner than regular orks, Nobz act as sergeant-at-arms, champions, oppressors and role models. They tend to lead by example, plunging head-first into the thick of battle.
比普通欧克蛮人更大更凶的强蛮人，他们充当军士、冠军、压迫者和榜样。他们通常以身作则，头先冲入战斗的厚重中。
Warlord_Lore/GOF58: With the roar of engines and the crackle of flames, Snazzwagon drivers race each other to the front lines on these lightly-built speedsters, howling as they create a devastating inferno.
随着引擎的轰鸣和火焰的噼啪声，Snazzwagon驾驶员们驾驶着这些轻型赛车互相竞速，一边咆哮一边制造出毁灭性的火海。
Warlord_Lore/GOF59: Orks can become addicted to the intense kickback and explosive sounds of firearms. Those fondest of these sensations will devote their time to finding reasons to pull the trigger again.
欧克蛮人可能会对火器的强烈反冲力和爆炸声音上瘾。那些最喜欢这些感觉的人会把时间都用来找理由再次扣动扳机。
Warlord_Lore/GOF60: Tankbustas enter the battlefield with a primal desire to hunt down armoured vehicles, scavenging the greatest trophies from their prey to brag of their felled quarries.
坦克破坏者带着狩猎装甲载具的原始欲望进入战场，从他们的猎物中搜寻最大的战利品，以炫耀他们击败的猎物。
Warlord_Lore/GOF61: Once, Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies were used to feed Squigs to Speed Freeks on the move. It was only after a rabid Attack Squig was accidentally launched that its true potential was realised.
曾经，Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies被用来给移动中的暴走团喂食跳跳。只有在一只疯狂的攻击跳跳被意外发射后，它的真正潜力才被意识到。
Warlord_Lore/GOF62: These specialists prefer to rely on "kunnin' trikz" rather than fighting the opponent head-on. Kommandos are distrusted by most other Greenskins, who find their methods distinctly "un-Orky".
这些专家更喜欢依赖"狡猾的把戏"，而不是直接与对手战斗。蛮人特种兵受到大多数其他绿皮人的不信任，他们发现他们的方法明显"不像欧克蛮人"。
Warlord_Lore/GOF63: Sometimes, a Battlewagon bears so much weaponry it becomes a Gunwagon. These piloted beasts ravage enemy lines until an unlucky shot to its ammunition depots makes them explode spectacularly.
有时，战斗堡垒装备了如此多的武器，它变成了兽人炮车。这些驾驶的野兽摧毁敌人的阵线，直到一颗不幸的子弹击中它的弹药库，使它们壮观地爆炸。
Warlord_Lore/GOF64: Flames and the resulting sizzle of scorched enemies have an undeniable appeal to the Orks. Greenskins with functioning Burnas will go great lengths to reduce anything to cinders.
火焰和随之而来的烧焦敌人的嘶嘶声对欧克蛮人有着无法抗拒的吸引力。拥有功能正常的喷火枪的绿皮人会走很长的路程，只为把任何东西烧成煤渣。
Warlord_Lore/b4d6d186eb95a3f468013c5be64: Ork medicine is not an exacting kind of science, and often seems to do more harm than good. However, treated Orks have been known to get up and fight after the most severe injuries.
欧克蛮人的医学并不是一种精确的科学，往往似乎比好处更多。然而，经过治疗的欧克蛮人已知在最严重的伤害后起身并战斗。
Warlord_Lore/6ba4b132d24528844a86304f8ce: From all the ways Orks could worship their gods Gork and Mork, it's very convenient that the main method to show devotion to Gork just happens to be more fighting.
在所有欧克蛮人可以崇拜他们的神祇格克和摩克的方式中，向格克表达虔诚的主要方法恰好是更多的战斗，这非常方便。
Warlord_Lore/9dcbe3d0c04b02f4fbb19974ae0: It's theorized that Ork tech is somehow warp-infused, as it only seems to work because the Orks believe it should. That would explain why Ork weapons are useless to anyone else.
有理论认为欧克蛮人的技术以某种方式融入了亚空间，因为它似乎只是因为欧克蛮人相信它应该工作。这就解释了为什么欧克蛮人的武器对其他人无用。
Warlord_Lore/98d3c65702746b04baf7f5ead1a: Ork mechanical repairs tend to consist of nothing but a Mekboy hitting it hard with a hammer. Somehow, this seems to work.
欧克蛮人的机械修理通常只包括一个技师小子用锤子猛击它。不知怎么的，这似乎有效。
Warlord_Lore/508002f5d7ee54f4686aefa2e6a: Eternal fanatics of the crushin' and krumpin', Orks often outfit vehicles with a giant spiked ball on a chain that they swing in battle against enemy tanks and structures.
永恒者是粉碎和压碎的狂热者，欧克蛮人经常装备车辆，用巨大的带刺的球链在战斗中对敌人的坦克和结构挥舞。
Warlord_Lore/9f4e1b7ea9f00da458c6a859a4e: As far as Orks are concerned, there is no such thing as too much dakka. If there’s the slightest amount of space left on a vehicle, then it clearly needs more guns!
就欧克蛮人而言，没有太多的达卡。如果车辆上还有一点空间，那么它显然需要更多的枪！
Warlord_Lore/20d0f4451f16fc441836a02f99b: Orks like nothing more than fighting, and the rallying cry of WAAAAGH! draws them to battle from far and wide.
欧克蛮人最喜欢的就是战斗，而WAAAGH！的集结号召使他们从四面八方赶来参战。
Warlord_Lore/3ebb159036778d14ebd1c48451a: Every Ork knows that Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka is the greatest warboss ever! Just being in his presence inspires the boyz to fight as hard as they can.
每个欧克蛮人都知道，加兹古尔·萨卡是有史以来最伟大的战争头目！仅仅在他的存在下，小子们就会尽全力战斗。
Warlord_Lore/8425b809e9e64e24f9035f709f5: Don’t make Zagstruk mad! He’ll leap into the air on his bionic legs and make ready to plunge onto his target in a devastating attack.
别惹札格斯查克生气！他会用他的仿生腿跳上空中，准备对目标进行毁灭性的攻击。
Warlord_Lore/UM47: Famed Captain of the 4th Company. He has oftentimes defied the Codex Astartes, making use of tactics that clashed with Guilliman's teachings.
第四公司的著名连长。他多次违抗阿斯塔特圣典，使用与基利曼教导相冲突的战术。
Warlord_Lore/UM48: Chief Librarian of the Ultramarines chapter. He possesses the unique psychic ability to foresee events before they come to pass and uses these visions to guide his brothers to victory.
极限战士战团的智库馆长。他拥有独特的心灵能力，可以预见未来的事件，并利用这些预见指导他的兄弟们取得胜利。
Warlord_Lore/UM46: Marneus Calgar is the Chapter Master of the Ultramarines. He was the first known Space Marine to go through the Rubicon Primaris to become a Primaris Space Marine.
马涅乌思·卡尔加是极限战士的战团长。他是第一个通过原铸之界成为原铸星际战士的已知星际战士。
Warlord_Lore/UM2: Infiltrator squads are among the most numerous and versatile of the Space Marines, capable of both disrupting key enemy targets and defending strategical positions.
渗透者小队是星际战士中最多和最多样化的，能够破坏关键的敌人目标并防守战略位置。
Warlord_Lore/UM3: The Firstborn squads of Tactical Marines are heavily trained in the use of a myriad of weapons to quickly adapt to any situation in battle.
战术兵的长子小队在使用各种武器方面接受了严格的训练，以便在战斗中快速适应任何情况。
Warlord_Lore/UM4: Squads of Assault Intercessors swiftly charge into battle and slay their enemies with a combination of ranged and brutal close-quarter strikes.
突击仲裁者小队迅速冲入战斗，用远程和残酷的近战攻击组合杀死他们的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/UM5: Reivers are elite assault specialists with special training and wargear for rapid insertion and lightning-fast strikes. They can sow turmoil before the enemy even knows they are there.
劫掠者是精英突击专家，他们接受了特殊的训练和战争装备，用于快速插入和闪电般的攻击。他们可以在敌人甚至不知道他们在那里之前制造混乱。
Warlord_Lore/UM6: Primaris Intercessor Squads are the mainstay of the new breed of Space Marines, capable of brutal firepower without compromising on their predecessor's versatility.
原铸仲裁者小队是新一代星际战士的主力，能够展现出残酷的火力，而不会妨碍他们前任的多功能性。
Warlord_Lore/UM7: After the atrocities that the tyranids commited on Macragge, the Ultramarines forged the first squads specialised in battling bio-horrors.
在泰伦虫族在马库拉格犯下的暴行之后，极限战士铸造了第一支专门对抗生物恐怖的小队。
Warlord_Lore/UM9: Inceptors use their speed and bulk to spearhead Space Marine attacks. Their immense firepower is enough to leave the enemy open to an attack by follow-up waves of Space Marines.
先驱者利用他们的速度和体积来领导星际战士的攻击。他们的巨大火力足以让敌人对星际战士的后续攻击波开放。
Warlord_Lore/UM10: These heavy support squads are armed with Plasma Incinerators, perfect for providing covering fire and powerful enough to annihilate enemies caught in the Hellblaster's sight.
这些重型支援小队装备有等离子焚化枪，非常适合提供掩护火力，足以消灭被地狱轰击者瞄准的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/UM11: Space Marines on bikes can attack at phenomenal speeds, using surprise and momentum to overwhelm their enemies.
骑自行车的星际战士可以以惊人的速度进行攻击，利用惊喜和动力压倒他们的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/UM12: As the most gifted tank commander of the Ultramarines, Antaro Chronus became the first Marine to bear the title of "Spear of Macragge" since the times of the Great Crusade.
作为极限战士最有天赋的坦克指挥官，安塔罗·克罗努斯成为自大远征时代以来第一个获得“马库拉格之矛”头衔的海军。
Warlord_Lore/UM13: Leading from the front with crozius in hand, the chaplain’s role is to inspire faith and fury in those fighting alongside him, as well as to perform the sacred rituals of the chapter.
牧师手持克罗修斯在前线领导，他的角色是激发与他并肩作战的人的信仰和愤怒，以及执行战团的神圣仪式。
Warlord_Lore/UM15: Serving with Chaplain Kastor, Polixis was instrumental in saving planet Atari from suffering a horrible fate after it was overrun by a chaos cult uprising.
在阿塔里星球被混沌教派起义占领后，波利克西斯在牧师卡斯托的帮助下，成功地挽救了阿塔里星球免受可怕的命运。
Warlord_Lore/UM16: Sergeant Allectius fought to protect Cassothea from a massive Necron attack. When his superior fell in battle, Allectius assumed Company command for the rest of the gruelling campaign.
军士阿莱克修斯为保护卡索西亚免受大规模太空死灵攻击而战。当他的上级在战斗中倒下时，阿莱克修斯接管了公司的指挥权，直到艰苦的战役结束。
Warlord_Lore/UM17: A recent improvement of anti-gravitic technology in the Imperium gave way to the Impulsor, a fast-moving assault tank capable of deploying a Primaris squad into the heart of battle.
帝国在反重力技术的最近改进为冲击者突击艇的出现铺平了道路，这是一种快速移动的突击坦克，能够将原铸小队部署到战斗的中心。
Warlord_Lore/UM18: Ancients are unshakable warriors from a Chapter's Honour Guard who are sworn to carry the Chapter's Standard forward, not dishonour or lose it, and protect it with their lives.
旗手是战团荣誉卫队中坚定不移的战士，他们誓言将战团的旗帜向前推进，不辱没也不丢失，用他们的生命保护它。
Warlord_Lore/UM19: The Gravis power armour of Aggressor Marines is customised with a shoulder-mounted grenade launcher to increase their ability to deliver cover fire and contest rough terrain.
侵略者海军陆战队的重甲定制了肩部安装的榴弹发射器，以增强他们提供掩护火力和应对崎岖地形的能力。
Warlord_Lore/UM20: Unmatched veteran marksman and instructor. No less than four Ultramarines Captains attribute their success to the teachings of Torias Telion.
无与伦比的老兵狙击手和教官。不少于四位极限战士连长将他们的成功归功于军士特利昂的教导。
Warlord_Lore/UM21: Judiciars are the embodiment of the Chapter Master's will in the battlefield, in charge of keeping Space Marines in line and quieting any sign of disobedience.
裁决者是战团长在战场上的意志的化身，负责维持星际战士的纪律，平息任何不服从的迹象。
Warlord_Lore/UM22: Fast, aggressive and hard-hitting, a perfectly coordinated assault from an Inceptor Squad could break the lines of even the most resilient foes.
快速，侵略性强，打击力强，先驱者小队的完美协调攻击能打破甚至最坚韧的敌人的防线。
Warlord_Lore/UM23: These expert and methodical warriors enter the battlefield in richly ornamented panoplies, bearing Storm Shields capable of withstanding the most destructive strikes.
这些专家和有条不紊的战士身着华丽的盔甲进入战场，携带能抵挡最具破坏力的攻击的风暴盾。
Warlord_Lore/UM24: Veteran of the Indomitus Crusade, Lucian Calsius has proved himself time and again despite being a relative newcomer to the Chapter.
作为不屈远征的老兵，副官卡尔修斯多次证明了他的价值，尽管他在战团中相对较新。
Warlord_Lore/UM25: Battle-brothers who train as Devastator Centurions must endure additional intense training just to learn to handle the immense recoil of their weaponry.
接受破坏者百夫长训练的战斗修士必须经受额外的激烈训练，才能学会处理他们武器的巨大后坐力。
Warlord_Lore/UM26: Not all battles can be fought with bolter and chainsword. When it comes to matters of the warp, Ultramarine Librarians are trained in countless techniques, both offensive and defensive.
并非所有的战斗都可以用爆矢枪和链锯剑来进行。在处理亚空间的事务时，极限战士智库接受了无数攻击和防御技术的训练。
Warlord_Lore/UM27: Their mighty armour allows them to advance through difficult terrain with ease. Instead of heavy guns, they wield Siege Drills capable of shattering buildings and armoured vehicles.
他们强大的盔甲使他们能轻松穿越困难的地形。他们手持的不是重型枪械，而是能够粉碎建筑和装甲车辆的攻城钻。
Warlord_Lore/UM28: The largest Dreadnought model ever deployed in battle. Mortally wounded Primaris Marines are interred into these machines and given another chance to serve the Emperor.
这是有史以来在战斗中部署的最大无畏机甲模型。致命伤的原铸星际战士被安置在这些机器中，再次得到为帝皇服务的机会。
Warlord_Lore/UM29: The lauded Cato Sicarius is one of the greatest heroes of the Ultramarines. He's been known to perform great feats and has snatched victory from the jaws of defeat on many occasions.
备受赞誉的连长西卡瑞斯是极限战士中的最伟大英雄之一。他以完成伟大壮举而闻名，多次在败局之中夺得胜利。
Warlord_Lore/UM30: This main battle tank provides armoured support to the units on the ground. It uses anti-gravitic technology developed by Belisarius Cawl.
这辆主战坦克为地面单位提供装甲支援。它使用由贝利萨留斯·考尔开发的反重力技术。
Warlord_Lore/UM35: Guided by the principles of the Codex Astartes, the Ultramarines are the most disciplined and cohesive fighting force in the Imperium.
极限战士由阿斯塔特圣典的原则指导，是帝国最有纪律和凝聚力的战斗力量。
Warlord_Lore/UM36: The Codex Astartes has much to say about the perils of an exhausted fighting force. To hold back and recover today means to prevail tomorrow.
阿斯塔特圣典对于疲惫的战斗力量的危险有很多说法。今天保持后退并恢复意味着明天能够取得胜利。
Warlord_Lore/UM37: Not all battles can be won on the ground alone. Sometimes it is better to step back and unleash devastation in the form of flaming holy promethium.
并非所有的战斗都可以仅在地面上赢得。有时候，最好退后一步，以燃烧的神圣钷的形式释放毁灭。
Warlord_Lore/UM38: Calling in the support of these distinctive gunships can swiftly turn the tide of battle in the Ultramarines’ favour.
呼叫这些独特的炮舰的支援可以迅速地将战斗的潮汐转向极限战士的有利。
Warlord_Lore/UM39: Capable of swiftly learning from the actions of their enemies, the Ultramarines can turn any attack on their own into a devastating counterassault.
极限战士能够迅速从敌人的行动中学习，他们可以将任何对他们自己的攻击转变为毁灭性的反攻。
Warlord_Lore/UM40: The Ultramarines have long memories, and no slight will ever go unpunished. Should an Ultramarine fall in battle, his brothers will not rest until vengeance is done.
极限战士有着长久的记忆，任何轻蔑都不会被忽视。如果一位极限战士在战斗中阵亡，他的兄弟们不会休息，直到复仇完成。
Warlord_Lore/UM1: New recruits to the Ultramarines start off as lightly armoured scouts to prove their worth. Despite their junior status, they provide a vital function to the chapter’s operations.
新加入极限战士的新兵首先要作为轻装甲侦查兵来证明他们的价值。尽管他们的地位较低，但他们对战团的行动提供了重要的功能。
Warlord_Lore/UM8: Space Marine Eliminators are expert marksmen who stalk the highest value targets across the battlefield and eliminate them with well-placed sniper shots.
星际战士歼灭者是专业的狙击手，他们在战场上潜行，用精准的狙击手法消灭最高价值的目标。
Warlord_Lore/UM14: These veteran Space Marines serve as the Chapter Master’s personal retinue and are charged with protecting him and carrying his standard into battle.
这些老兵星际战士作为战团长的私人随从，负责保护他并在战斗中携带他的旗帜。
Warlord_Lore/d94f91051ecfe014f97577ff573: This title is bestowed upon the Ultramarines’ foremost tank commander. He reports directly to the Chapter Master and is an advisor in all matters to do with heavy armour.
这个头衔被授予极限战士中最杰出的坦克指挥官。他直接向战团长汇报，并在所有与重型盔甲相关的事务中担任顾问。
Warlord_Lore/0544047df88d2ba4cad9c17ff08: Whether by their adherence to the Codex Astartes or their ability to adapt to any situation, it is undeniable the Ultramarines have achieved many victories and defied impossible odds.
无论是他们对阿斯塔特圣典的遵守，还是他们适应任何情况的能力，极限战士无疑取得了许多胜利，挑战了不可能的赔率。
Warlord_Lore/UM31: Since the dawn of time when tribes of proto-humans on Terra battled against one another, mastery of the higher ground has proven to be a key element in ensuring victory.
自从泰拉的原始人部落在黎明时分互相战斗以来，掌握高地已被证明是确保胜利的关键元素。
Warlord_Lore/UM32: When it comes to tactical principles, the Ultramarines need look no closer than the Codex Astartes, which contains a wealth of strategic advice for any situation.
在战术原则上，极限战士只需参考阿斯塔特圣典，其中包含了任何情况下的丰富战略建议。
Warlord_Lore/UM33: Vanguards are elite reconnaissance troops, who can slip behind enemy lines and wreak havoc. They were used to great effect in the Pariah Nexus campaign.
先锋是精英侦查军队，他们可以潜入敌人的后方并制造混乱。他们在驱灵死域的战役中发挥了巨大的效果。
Warlord_Lore/9238c27730a0c424288d46ed0f4: As Captain of the 4th Company, Uriel Ventris is also the Master of the Fleet, responsible for coordinating the Chapter's warship armada when engaging in ship-to-ship combat.
作为第四连的连长，乌列尔·文特里斯也是舰队之主，负责在进行舰舰战斗时协调战团的战舰舰队。
Warlord_Lore/f923701f207d23a4f81d6ff5891: Those with psychic powers are feared throughout the Imperium and for good reason – channelling the warp can open gateways to that realm and bring forth nightmares.
拥有精神力量的人在帝国中受到恐惧，原因很简单 - 引导亚空间可以打开通往那个领域的门户，带来噩梦。
Warlord_Lore/c4ff279078605aa42942c8dd16b: Divining the future is beyond the ability of most psykers. But Varro Tigurius is no ordinary psyker. His visions offer glimpses of the future that can aid his brothers in battle.
预测未来超出了大多数灵能者的能力。但瓦罗·提古里乌斯不是普通的灵能者。他的预见提供了可以帮助他的兄弟们在战斗中的未来的一瞥。
Warlord_Lore/cf0b346f70e748c4bbfc4dc03ab: The simplest use of the warp is to channel it into destructive energy. This power can take many forms, such as lightning, flame, or sheer telekinetic force.
使用亚空间最简单的方法是将其引导成破坏性的能量。这种力量可以采取许多形式，如闪电，火焰或纯粹的心灵力量。
Warlord_Lore/0740581c2c0523745a42dbec1b2: The warp isn’t just used to destroy. By manipulating the energies of the warp, it’s possible to grant benefits that strengthen and empower oneself and one’s allies in battle.
亚空间不仅用于破坏。通过操纵亚空间的能量，可以赋予加强和赋能自己和战斗中的盟友的好处。
Warlord_Lore/dcbd28525888ce54aaa93a47ba4: Marneus Calgar is known for being one of the greatest tacticians in the Imperium, able to predict enemy movements and counter them before they even have a chance to strike.
马涅乌思·卡尔加以帝国最伟大的战术家之一的身份而闻名，能够预测敌人的动向，并在他们有机会攻击之前进行反击。
Warlord_Lore/UM41: Bolters are capable of firing self-propelled rounds that explode after hitting the target. Slowly throughout the millennia, the Bolter became a holy symbol of the Emperor's wrath.
爆矢枪能够发射自推进的弹药，这些弹药在击中目标后爆炸。经过千年的演变，爆矢枪成为了帝皇愤怒的神圣象征。
Warlord_Lore/UM43: The greatest of the Ultramarines are chosen to bear the sacred relics of the chapter, offering a great advantage in battle.
极限战士中最伟大的人被选中承载战团的神圣遗物，这在战斗中提供了巨大的优势。
Warlord_Lore/UM44: The Ultramarines possess a wealth of heavy armoured support for both the ground and air. These work in unison with the Space Marines on the ground to drive back the enemy.
极限战士拥有大量的重型装甲支援，包括地面和空中。这些与地面的星际战士一起协同作战，驱退敌人。
Warlord_Lore/UM34: Even the Codex Astartes cannot deny that getting up close and personal generally yields effective results... at great danger of course.
即使是阿斯塔特圣典也不能否认，亲近和个人通常会产生有效的结果...当然，这是非常危险的。
Warlord_Lore/UM42: The strict command hierarchy of the Ultramarines allows them to deploy quickly and efficiently while letting every squad perform their duties to maximum effect.
极限战士严格的指挥等级制度使他们能够快速有效地部署，同时让每个小队都能发挥最大的效果。
Warlord_Lore/UM45: The Ultramarines take their oaths of brotherhood extremely seriously. If one encounters trouble, others will quickly rally around.
极限战士非常重视他们的兄弟誓言。如果有人遇到麻烦，其他人会迅速集结。
Warlord_Lore/ec0d25faeb266ea4eaec41ae72b: Famed Captain of the 4th Company. He has oftentimes defied the Codex Astartes, making use of tactics that clashed with Guilliman's teachings.
第四连的著名连长。他经常违背阿斯塔特圣典，使用与基利曼的教导相冲突的战术。
Warlord_Lore/UM55: Primarily proficient in the use of ranged weaponry, Sternguard Veterans have a record of making every shot count, and are entrusted with the use of rare specialist ammunition in battle.
擅长远程武器的肃卫老兵，每发子弹必中，他们在战斗中有权使用稀有专业弹药。
Warlord_Lore/UM56: Since the times of the Horus Heresy, the Ultramarines have been known for their sturdy leadership, from their Chapter Masters and heroes to their Captains and squad Sergeants.
自荷鲁斯之乱以来，极限战士以坚实的领导力而闻名，无论是他们的战团长和英雄，还是连长和小队军士。
Warlord_Lore/UM57: Following the Ultramarine's taste for adaptability, this highly flexible all-terrain vehicle is able to both open a breach through enemy lines and swiftly engage the enemy's scouting elements.
遵循极限战士的适应性，这种高度灵活的全地形载具既能在敌人阵线中打开缺口，又能迅速对敌人的侦查元素进行攻击。
Warlord_Lore/UM58: A Desolation Marine squad can provide long-range support to their battle brothers, carrying heavy weaponry that would prove unwieldy to any that hadn't crossed the Rubicon Primaris.
荒凉海军队能为战斗兄弟提供远程支援，携带重型武器，对未越过原铸之界的人来说，这些武器显得笨重。
Warlord_Lore/UM59: While the Chapter's battle brothers engage the enemy in the front lines, the Stormtalon Gunship acts as both an interceptor in the skies, and a menace to the enemy's rear lines.
当战团的战斗兄弟在前线与敌人交战时，风暴爪炮艇在天空中担任拦截者，同时对敌人的后方线路构成威胁。
Warlord_Lore/UM60: The return of Guilliman in one of the Imperium's darkest hours was, for many, the turning point that pushed them to fight with more zeal than ever to see the Imperium return to its former glory.
基利曼在帝国最黑暗的时刻回归，对许多人来说，这是他们决定以更大的热情去战斗，期待看到帝国恢复昔日荣光的转折点。
Warlord_Lore/UM61: The Apothecarion is tasked with the recovery of fallen battle brother gene-seed. The recovered material is taken back to the Chapter, so that it may again be used in the creation of a new battle brother.
药剂厅负责回收堕落的战斗兄弟基因种子。回收的材料被带回战团，以便再次用于创造新的战斗兄弟。
Warlord_Lore/UM62: The overwhelming force of an Ultramarine attack will rapidly take control of strategic targets and minimize the chances of enemy retaliation.
极限战士的压倒性攻击力将迅速控制战略目标，最大限度地减少敌人反击的机会。
Warlord_Lore/UM63: Spread thin fighting wars across the vast Galaxy, the Chapter Council of the Ultramarines plays an essential role in deploying the optimal resources for each campaign.
在广袤的银河系中分散作战，极限战士的战团议会在为每场战役部署最佳资源中发挥了关键作用。
Warlord_Lore/UM64: Primaris or Firstborn, recruit or Captain, the duty of an Ultramarine to the Chapter and the Imperium only ends with his last breath.
无论是原铸者还是初生者，新兵还是连长，极限战士对战团和帝国的职责只有在他最后一口气时才结束。
Warlord_Lore/SAU35: Imotekh is the Phaeron of the Sautekh dynasty, and ruler of dozens of tomb worlds across the galaxy. He is a strategic genius who is constantly looking for ways to expand his empire.
伊莫特克是索泰克王朝的法皇，统治着银河系中的数十个墓穴世界。他是一位战略天才，不断寻找扩大帝国的方法。
Warlord_Lore/30007162b68992e41a422f20617: Imotekh’s strategic prowess has been honed over millions of years. He knows exactly where to place himself in battle to do the most damage and reap the greatest rewards.
伊莫特克的战略才能经过数百万年的磨砺。他知道在战斗中如何定位自己，以造成最大的伤害并获得最大的回报。
Warlord_Lore/SAU36: One of the galaxy’s greatest generals. Zahndrekh is known for abiding to a strict code of conduct in battle – fighting honourably and treating prisoners with respect.
扎恩德雷克是银河系最伟大的将军之一。他以在战斗中遵守严格的行为准则而闻名——光明正大地战斗，尊重俘虏。
Warlord_Lore/d8a14171b08b54144ba9dbf324b: Zahndrekh has been waging constant war on the galaxy for millennia. He has a seemingly endless supply of warriors, such that he never lets up the pressure on his opponent.
扎恩德雷克已经在银河系中进行了数千年的不断战争。他拥有看似无尽的战士，以至于他从不放松对对手的压力。
Warlord_Lore/SAU37: A great Cryptek, known for his powers over time itself. He opposed the biotransference process that turned the Necrontyr into undying Necrons, but has since embraced all it has to offer.
一位伟大的墓穴技师，以他对时间本身的掌控而闻名。他反对将惧亡者转变为不朽的太空死灵的生物质转移过程，但自那时起，他接受了它所提供的一切。
Warlord_Lore/cbabeb234380634479feab1a1b4: Orikan’s mastery over time itself lets him peer into the past and the future alike, and even ‘walk back’ time to correct the mistakes he made earlier.
奥利坎对时间的掌握使他能够窥视过去和未来，甚至“倒退”时间以纠正他之前犯的错误。
Warlord_Lore/SAU1: Often sent into battle in seemingly endless swarms, these small silver beetle-like constructs can break down matter into pure energy for their Necron masters.
这些小型银色甲壳虫状的构造体经常被派去战斗，它们可以将物质分解为纯能量供他们的太空死灵主人使用。
Warlord_Lore/SAU2: These flying constructs use their monomolecular proboscis to inject frenzied units with energy, driving them to even greater madness and destructive potential.
这些飞行构造体使用他们的单分子喙向狂热单位注入能量，使他们陷入更大的疯狂和破坏潜力。
Warlord_Lore/SAU3: Some Necron warriors fall victim to a curse of madness that leaves them craving flesh and blood. Draped in the skins of their enemies, they are a terrifying sight to behold.
一些太空死灵武士成为疯狂诅咒的受害者，他们渴望肉和血。他们身披敌人的皮肤，是一种恐怖的景象。
Warlord_Lore/SAU4: These Necron warriors carry Gauss Flayers – weapons that shoot a bright green flash of molecular disassembling energy. An enemy is reduced to its constituent atoms in seconds.
这些太空死灵武士携带高斯撕裂枪——这种武器发射出一道明亮的绿色分子解构能量闪光。敌人在几秒钟内被分解为基本原子。
Warlord_Lore/SAU5: The standard infantry troop for the Necrons. The great Sautekh Overlords were only able to conquer countless planets thanks to these soulless automata following their every order.
太空死灵的标准步兵军队。伟大的索泰克霸主能够征服无数星球，全靠这些无灵魂的自动机遵循他们的每一个命令。
Warlord_Lore/SAU6: Immortals are powerful Necrons, still able to think and act with basic sentience. Often armed with Tesla Carbines, they fire living energy that arcs from one enemy to another.
不朽者是强大的太空死灵，仍然能够具有基本的知觉和行动能力。他们通常装备特斯拉卡宾枪，发射的是活的能量，从一个敌人弧形跳到另一个敌人。
Warlord_Lore/SAU7: The wraith is a stealthy construct able to phase in and out of space-time thanks to its Phase Shifter device. This allows it to scout the battlefield and report back to its masters.
幽冥是一种能够通过其相位转换器设备在时空中进出的隐形构造体。这使它能够侦查战场并向其主人报告。
Warlord_Lore/SAU8: Each Immortal carries a spark of the living being they once were – now all they sense is the thrill of the kill and the satisfaction of obeying their masters.
每个不朽者都带有他们曾经是的生物的火花——现在他们感觉到的只是杀戮的刺激和服从主人的满足感。
Warlord_Lore/SAU9: Destroyers are Necrons cursed with an uncontrollable urge to destroy all life. Ophydian destroyers are able to burrow into pocket dimensions and re-emerge to ambush their prey.
毁灭者是被诅咒的太空死灵，他们有无法控制的破坏所有生命的冲动。奥菲迪安毁灭者能够钻入口袋维度并重新出现以伏击他们的猎物。
Warlord_Lore/SAU10: Praetorians serve as enforcers of ancient Necrontyr law. Usually a rare sight in battle, the rediscovery of many Tomb Worlds by the Sautekh kept them in the dynasty's front lines.
执政官是古代惧亡者法律的执行者。通常在战斗中很少见，但索泰克对许多墓穴世界的重新发现使他们处于王朝的前线。
Warlord_Lore/SAU11: Technomancers are a specialised type of Cryptek, able to repair Necron troops and canoptek constructs in the midst of battle.
机械巫师是一种专门的墓穴技师，能够在战斗中修复太空死灵军队和墓穴构造体。
Warlord_Lore/SAU12: An airborne unit known for its versatility, fast speed and erratic movement. A swarm of tomb blades can quickly overwhelm even the toughest defences.
一种以其多功能性、快速和不规则的移动而闻名的空中单位。一群墓穴之刃可以迅速压倒即使是最坚固的防御。
Warlord_Lore/SAU13: Large anti-gravitic constructs shaped like arachnids. They cruise the battlefield conducting repairs on Necron systems, while their large bodies create and deploy canoptek scarabs.
大型反重力构造体，形状像蜘蛛。他们在战场上进行太空死灵系统的修复，同时他们的大身体创造并部署墓穴圣甲虫。
Warlord_Lore/SAU14: Equipped with fierce short-range weaponry, Cryptothralls keep threats out of their master's way, allowing them to carry out their masterful plans without interference.
配备了猛烈的短程武器，神秘奴能够将威胁从他们的主人身边排除，让他们能够毫无干扰地执行他们的高明计划。
Warlord_Lore/SAU15: Deathmarks are assassins and snipers that can phase in an out of space-time at will in order to ambush their prey. Very few enemies who have met one ever live to tell the tale.
死印战士是刺客和狙击手，他们可以随意在时空中进出，以便伏击他们的猎物。遇到他们的敌人很少有人能活着讲述这个故事。
Warlord_Lore/SAU16: This modified version of the Doom Scythe is often used as a troop transport. As well as attacking with its Tesla weaponry, it can drop Necron troops to the heart of battle.
这种改装版的毁灭之镰常常被用作军队运输。除了用其特斯拉武器进行攻击，它还可以将太空死灵军队投送到战斗的中心。
Warlord_Lore/SAU17: The Psychomancer is a specialised Cryptek able to create illusions and hard-light constructs in order to unleash an enemy’s worst fears against them.
精神巫师是专门的墓穴技师，能够创造幻象和硬光构造，以便将敌人的最大恐惧释放出来。
Warlord_Lore/SAU18: Shockingly fast and nimble for their size, few enemies can withstand the overwhelming flurry of attacks that these Destroyers can unleash with their Hyperphase weaponry.
这些毁灭者的速度和敏捷性令人震惊，他们的体型之大，很少有敌人能抵挡住他们用超相位武器释放的攻击。
Warlord_Lore/SAU19: Necron warriors inevitably rise back up to fight again, but the process can take some time. This construct speeds up the reanimation process with a beam of repairing nano-scarabs.
太空死灵武士总是会重新站起来战斗，但这个过程可能需要一些时间。这个构造体通过一束修复纳米圣甲虫的光线加速了复活过程。
Warlord_Lore/SAU20: Specialised Crypteks with power over time itself. They can speed it up or slow it down to suit the battle, aiding their allies or hindering their opponents as needed.
专门的墓穴技师，他们对时间本身有控制权。他们可以加速或减慢时间以适应战斗，帮助他们的盟友或阻碍他们的对手。
Warlord_Lore/SAU21: This distinctive attack aircraft is capable of operating both in the void and within planetary atmospheres. The sound of it approaching is known to instil terror in its enemies.
这种独特的攻击飞机能够在虚空和行星大气层内操作。它的接近声音被知道能在敌人中引发恐惧。
Warlord_Lore/SAU22: This destroyer has mounted itself onto a repulsor chassis, and bound its limbs into heavy gauss cannons, ideal for obliterating all living beings from afar.
这个毁灭者将自己安装在反击者坦克底盘上，并将其四肢绑在重型高斯加农炮上，非常适合从远处消灭所有生物。
Warlord_Lore/SAU23: Elite protectors and emissaries of the nobility. They were granted the highest quality necrodermis, making them extremely hard to damage. They plough into battle with their warscythes.
贵族的精英保护者和使者。他们被授予最高质量的死灵皮，使他们极难受到伤害。他们手持战镰冲入战斗。
Warlord_Lore/SAU24: This mobile weapons platform is slow-moving but brings doom to all enemies. It is loaded with powerful Tesla weaponry, and once in range, it shows the true meaning of annihilation.
这个移动武器平台移动缓慢，但给所有敌人带来毁灭。它装载了强大的特斯拉武器，一旦在射程内，它就会展示毁灭的真正含义。
Warlord_Lore/SAU25: The superior targeting systems of Hexmark Destroyers enables them to easily unleash volleys of death with their six Disintegrator Pistols, quickly turning any living organisms into dust.
巫印毁灭者的优越瞄准系统使他们能够轻松地用他们的六把分解手枪释放死亡的齐射，迅速将任何生物转化为尘土。
Warlord_Lore/SAU26: These specialized Crypteks wield plasmic lances that can make even the air scream in agony. The living lightning that they wield makes short work of any enemy that gets too close.
这些专门的墓穴技师挥舞电浆长枪，可以让空气都在痛苦中尖叫。他们挥舞的活雷能够迅速解决任何靠得太近的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/SAU27: Individually, Necron scarabs are weak and easily dealt with, but in large numbers, they can pose a serious threat to even the most hardened enemy.
单独来看，太空死灵的圣甲虫是弱小且容易处理的，但是数量众多时，他们甚至可以对最坚硬的敌人构成严重威胁。
Warlord_Lore/SAU28: Once, these skeletal vehicles dragged unwilling Necrontyr to the furnaces for bio-transference. Now, they trawl the battlefield for damaged Necrons, ready to return them to the fight.
曾经，这些骨架车辆将不情愿的惧亡者拖到炉子里进行生物转移。现在，他们在战场上寻找受伤的太空死灵，准备让他们重返战斗。
Warlord_Lore/SAU29: Necron Lords of the Sautekh Dynasty are counted among the most aggressive and eager in attempting a new wave of expansion to restore the Necrons to their former glory.
索泰克王朝的太空死灵领主被认为是最具侵略性和渴望尝试新的扩张浪潮的人，以恢复太空死灵的昔日荣耀。
Warlord_Lore/SAU30: Fearsome hexapedal walkers, equipped with powerful weaponry and usually deployed against enemy tanks and armour. Their precision targeting relay can also provide data to allied units.
可怕的六足步行者，装备有强大的武器，通常被部署对抗敌人的坦克和盔甲。他们的精确瞄准中继也可以向盟友单位提供数据。
Warlord_Lore/SAU31: A huge construct fitted with a devastating doomsday blaster. Doomstalkers are often used as sentries to protect Necron overlords and their treasures.
一个装备了毁灭性末日爆破枪的巨大构造体。毁灭者常常被用作哨兵，保护太空死灵霸主和他们的宝藏。
Warlord_Lore/SAU32: Even the greatest Sautekh can succumb to the destroyer curse. These towering Skorpekhs efficiently butcher enemy lines while commanding the frenzied in brief moments of clarity.
即使是最伟大的索泰克也会屈服于毁灭者的诅咒。这些高大的斯科尔佩克高效地屠杀敌人的阵线，同时在短暂的清醒时刻指挥狂热者。
Warlord_Lore/SAU33: Obyron is the bodyguard of Nemesor Zahndrekh and accompanies his master on all campaigns. He is the main reason why Zahndrekh has managed to survive this long.
奥比龙是复仇之王赞德瑞克的保镖，陪伴他的主人参加所有的战役。他是赞德瑞克能够存活这么久的主要原因。
Warlord_Lore/SAU34: A massive mobile fortress, it serves both as a formidable assault platform and as a symbol of Necron dominance. Many have fled in terror after seeing a monolith rise over the battlefield.
一个巨大的移动要塞，既是强大的突击平台，也是太空死灵统治的象征。许多人在看到夜石在战场上升起后，都会恐惧地逃跑。
Warlord_Lore/65b2be828179515458a282cf1b0: Only the most strong-willed of the nobility were chosen to become Overlords, retaining their sentience and individuality through the biotransference process.
只有最坚强的贵族被选为霸主，他们通过生物质转移过程保留了他们的意识和个性。
Warlord_Lore/27a4b748a7bf358499f038aa098: Even a Necron that has been shattered into its component parts can reform. The living necrodermis pulls limbs back together so that the warrior can serve its overlord once more.
即使一个太空死灵被打碎成各个部分，也可以重组。活体死灵皮肤将四肢拉回一起，使武士可以再次为他的霸主服务。
Warlord_Lore/eb17cd22c6a5d7941a7456838d9: Mounted atop a monolith, this giant weapon emits a stream of anti-matter particles that detonate on contact with other matter.
这个巨大的武器安装在夜石之上，发射一股反物质粒子流，与其他物质接触时会爆炸。
Warlord_Lore/SAU38: The legions of the Sautekh Dynasty excel in systematic extermination, concentrating their fire upon a target until it's completely obliterated.
索泰克王朝的军团擅长系统性的灭绝，他们会集中火力攻击目标，直到它完全被消灭。
Warlord_Lore/SAU39: Every other species that encounters the Necrons soon learns that they are incredibly hard to kill. Necron warriors can arise back into the fray after sustaining the most grievous of injury.
每一个与太空死灵接触的物种都会很快了解到，他们非常难以被杀死。太空死灵武士可以在受到最严重的伤害后重新站起来战斗。
Warlord_Lore/SAU40: Necrons are extremely durable in battle. Even great enemy battalions will lose all hope when they see their numbers dwindle while the Necron host remains mostly unchanged.
太空死灵在战斗中极其耐久。即使是伟大的敌人大队也会在看到他们的人数减少，而太空死灵的主力基本上没有变化时，失去所有的希望。
Warlord_Lore/SAU41: Endless are the tales of Necron shattered bodies reforming on the battlefield. Witchfire flaring back to life in their dead eye-lenses confirms a Necron has not yet been bested.
关于太空死灵在战场上重组的故事无穷无尽。他们的死眼镜片中再次闪烁的魔火证实了太空死灵还没有被击败。
Warlord_Lore/SAU42: The Sautekh dynasty is determined to retake their ancient domain and will not let anything get in their way. Even the most hardened defenders are pushed back by the endless tide.
索泰克王朝决心夺回他们的古老领土，不会让任何事情阻挡他们的道路。即使是最坚硬的防御者也会被无尽的潮汐推回。
Warlord_Lore/SAU43: Many Necron weapons are equipped with pulsing orbs, charged to the brim with eldritch energies. When activated, they can unleash an amount of power equivalent to a solar flare.
许多太空死灵的武器都装备有脉冲球，充满了奇异的能量。当它们被激活时，它们可以释放出相当于太阳耀斑的能量。
Warlord_Lore/SAU44: Some Necron Overlords bind disruption fields into their weapons, allowing them to shred even the heaviest of tank armour without difficulty.
一些太空死灵霸主将干扰场绑定到他们的武器中，使他们能够轻易地撕碎最重的坦克盔甲。
Warlord_Lore/SAU45: Necron commanders have had millions of years to master the art of tactics and strategy, and they are rarely left surprised.
太空死灵的指挥官已经有数百万年的时间来掌握战术和策略的艺术，他们很少会被惊讶。
