Warlord_Lore/SAU46: Canoptek Spyders shouldn't be understimated. Their fabricator function is so optimized that an unchecked group of them could overwhelm a whole army by creating an endless tide of Scarabs.
不应该低估墓穴蜘蛛。他们的制造功能优化得如此完美，以至于一个未受检查的群体可以通过创造无尽的圣甲虫来压倒整个军队。
Warlord_Lore/SAU47: Necron Overlords are inherently vindictive. If you destroy something belonging to them, they will hold nothing back in their vengeance.
太空死灵霸主天生就是报复心重。如果你破坏了他们的东西，他们在复仇时不会留下任何东西。
Warlord_Lore/SAU48: Necrons can overcharge the molecular disintegration emitters in their weapons to flay away additional layers of enemy armour in explosive eruptions of glowing dust.
太空死灵可以超载他们武器中的分子解构发射器，以爆炸性的方式剥去敌人盔甲的额外层次，产生发光的尘埃。
Warlord_Lore/SAU49: This powerful artifact pulses with energy that supercharges Necron self-repair systems and is able to bring entire legions back into fighting conditions.
这个强大的神器脉冲着能量，超充太空死灵的自我修复系统，能够使整个军团恢复到战斗状态。
Warlord_Lore/SAU50: By phasing through their dimensional corridors, Necron units can appear anywhere on the battlefield.
通过穿越他们的维度走廊，太空死灵单位可以出现在战场的任何地方。
Warlord_Lore/SAU51: The sound of incoming Doom Scythes and Night Scythes is known to terrify the enemy, even before the aircraft unleash their devastating payload.
即将到来的毁灭之镰和夜镰的声音会让敌人恐惧，即使在飞机释放他们的毁灭性负载之前。
Warlord_Lore/SAU52: Canoptek Scarabs are equipped with self-destruction protocols, that cause them to explode in a hail of razor-sharp fragments.
墓穴圣甲虫配备了自毁协议，使它们在一片锐利碎片的冰雹中爆炸。
Warlord_Lore/SAU53_OLD: All Necron troops obey their overlord without question. At the overlord’s command, they will stop what they are doing and unleash their weapons in perfect synchronicity.
所有太空死灵军队毫无疑问地服从他们的霸主。在霸主的指挥下，他们会停止正在做的事情，并以完美的同步性释放他们的武器。
Warlord_Lore/SAU53: When a Necron is slain, its crawling limbs reattach, its sundered torso reforms, and the Necron rises again. There is no rest for Necrons who fall in the service of their master.
当一个太空死灵被杀，它的爬行肢体重新连接，它的破碎躯干重塑，太空死灵再次崛起。对于在主人服务中倒下的太空死灵，没有休息。
Warlord_Lore/SAU54: Not all Necron overlords command from the rear. Many like to take to the battlefield themselves to personally unleash carnage upon their enemies.
并非所有太空死灵霸主都在后方指挥。许多人喜欢亲自走上战场，向他们的敌人亲自释放大屠杀。
Warlord_Lore/SAU55: Necron overlords are not known to retreat. The many victories achieved over millions of years honed their pride to the point of being disgusted by the mere idea of falling back.
太空死灵霸主并不以撤退而闻名。经过数百万年的胜利，他们的骄傲被磨练到对退缩的想法感到厌恶的程度。
Warlord_Lore/SAU56: There is no escaping the wrath of the Sautekh Dynasty. Planet after planet have fallen against magnificent displays of meticulous annihilation.
无法逃避索泰克王朝的愤怒。一个又一个的星球在精心的毁灭展示中倒下。
Warlord_Lore/SAU57: Necron Tomb Worlds are scattered across the entire galaxy. Each one contains millions of dormant Necrons, ready to awaken and unleash war upon anyone who stumbles upon them.
太空死灵的墓穴世界散布在整个银河系。每一个都包含着数百万个休眠的太空死灵，准备唤醒并对任何偶然发现他们的人发动战争。
Warlord_Lore/SAU58: Every Necron overlord knows that it is their destiny to rule over the entirety of creation, and absolutely nothing will stop them from pursuing this goal.
每个太空死灵霸主都知道，他们的命运就是统治整个创世界，绝对没有什么能阻止他们追求这个目标。
Warlord_Lore/SAU65: Royal Wardens exist to ensure the will of their Overlord is carried out by the Dynasty's armies, but they possess enough initiative and command to adapt these plans in the midst of battle.
皇家守望的存在是为了确保他们的霸主的意愿通过王朝的军队得以执行，但他们拥有足够的主动性和指挥官的能力，可以在战斗中适应这些计划的变化。
Warlord_Lore/BL34: After Horus' death, Abaddon formed the Black Legion and took on the title of Warmaster, determined to overcome Horus' failure and become the one to bring down the False Emperor.
荷鲁斯死后，阿巴顿组建了黑色军团，并接过了战帅的头衔，决心克服荷鲁斯的失败，成为推翻假帝皇的人。
Warlord_Lore/97e959444b53f424ea4285e2ca0: At the end of the Horus Heresy, Chaos Space Marines from all legions came together under Abaddon’s banner to join the Black Crusade against the Imperium.
荷鲁斯之乱结束时，所有军团的混沌星际战士都在阿巴顿的旗帜下聚集，加入了对帝国的黑色远征。
Warlord_Lore/BL35: Known as the Herald of the Apocalypse, Haarken Worldclaimer’s job is to proclaim the coming of Abaddon’s forces in order to spread fear and confusion among enemies.
被称为启示录的传令者，夺星者哈肯的任务是宣告阿巴顿军队的到来，以在敌人中间散播恐惧和混乱。
Warlord_Lore/61046837c330b48978b4af52012: Haarken’s Helspear is a daemon-touched weapon that incites its bearer into ever greater fury every time it is plunged into a victim.
哈肯的地狱之矛是一把被恶魔触摸过的武器，每次插入受害者时，都会激发其持有者更大的愤怒。
Warlord_Lore/BL36: A former Word Bearer, Sylar cast off his original colours and joined Abaddon as a sorcerer. Both a gift and a curse, his formidable command of the warp came at a cost to his sanity.
前怀言者赛拉尔脱下了他原来的颜色，作为一名巫师加入了阿巴顿。他对亚空间的强大掌控既是一种礼物，也是一种诅咒，他的理智付出了代价。
Warlord_Lore/edafa88b75667466da893bea3f6: A sorcerer reaches into the warp without regard. This yields powerful and devastating results but corruption and insanity constantly pick away at the sorcerer’s soul.
巫师毫无顾忌地进入亚空间。这产生了强大而毁灭性的结果，但腐败和疯狂不断侵蚀巫师的灵魂。
Warlord_Lore/141c5ed661a9e42bd9a793f0d2a: Sylar's mastery of the Warp is such that he can make it flow through his warriors, bestowing upon them the blessings of the Gods and increasing their effectiveness in battle.
赛拉尔对亚空间的掌控如此之强，他可以让它流经他的战士们，赐予他们神的祝福，提高他们在战斗中的效果。
Warlord_Lore/453b0e8f88e094a17866a6979f3: Powerful Sorcerers can channel streams of unholy power through their eyes, charring and melting anything caught in their view.
强大的巫师可以通过他们的眼睛引导邪恶的力量流动，烧焦并融化任何被他们视线捕捉到的东西。
Warlord_Lore/7bf8ce67fb6be4744ae44345a5b: The energies of Chaos can be manipulated to course through the body, swelling the frame with the strength to tear a tank in two.
混沌的能量可以被操纵，使其流经身体，使身体充满力量，足以撕裂一辆坦克。
Warlord_Lore/BL1: Chaos spawn are mindless mutants who have been twisted into monsters by Chaos and lost all sense of sentience and sanity. All that’s left is the urge to kill.
混沌魔物是失去了所有理智和理性的无脑突变体，被混沌扭曲成怪物。剩下的只有杀戮的冲动。
Warlord_Lore/BL2: The Black Legion recruits Chaos Space Marines from other legions, chapters and warbands. Upon joining the Black Legion, these recruits repaint their armour to black and gold.
黑色军团从其他军团、战团和战队中招募混沌星际战士。加入黑色军团后，这些新兵会将他们的盔甲重新涂成黑色和金色。
Warlord_Lore/BL3: Whether they hail from the days of the Horus Heresy or have turned recently, the combination of their gene-given gifts with blessings of the dark Gods makes them an enemy to fear.
无论他们来自荷鲁斯之乱的时代，还是最近才转变，他们的基因赋予的天赋与黑暗诸神的祝福结合，使他们成为令人恐惧的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/BL6: Remnants of an ancient Thousand Sons ritual, these marines appear to be nothing but ancient dust within suits of power armour. Ominous and silent, they are obedient automatons.
这些战士是千子古老仪式的残余，他们看起来只是动力盔甲内的古老尘土。噩兆号和沉默，他们是服从的自动机。
Warlord_Lore/BL7: Empowered by the Blood God, berserkers charge into battle with little regard for personal safety. Their only desire is to shed as much blood as possible.
由血神赋予力量，狂战士们毫不顾及个人安全地冲入战斗。他们唯一的愿望就是尽可能多地流血。
Warlord_Lore/BL8: Within the Black Legion, the followers of Slaanesh seek pain to fulfil their desires. Noise Marines do this by using sonic weaponry to fell their enemies with an unbearable shriek.
在黑色军团中，色孽的追随者寻求痛苦以满足他们的欲望。噪音战士通过使用声波武器以无法承受的尖叫声击倒他们的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/BL9: These Chaos Space Marines have given up all semblance of humanity and are entirely possessed by daemons. They feel no pain, and their bodies can mutate and warp.
这些混沌星际战士已经放弃了所有的人性，完全被恶魔附身。他们不感到痛苦，他们的身体可以变异和亚空间。
Warlord_Lore/BL10: When a Chaos Space Marine devotes himself to Nurgle, his body is blessed by the Grandfather to fester and bloat with disease and decay.
当一个混沌星际战士投身于纳垢，他的身体被祖父赐福，充满疾病和腐败。
Warlord_Lore/BL11: A Chaos Space Marine faces many threats, from dying in battle to succumbing to corruption and madness. Few ever survive to become veterans.
混沌星际战士面临许多威胁，从战斗中死亡到屈服于腐败和疯狂。很少有人能活下来成为老兵。
Warlord_Lore/BL12: Sometimes a warrior captures the interest of the Ruinous Powers. Champions of the Black Legion will do whatever it takes to earn the favour of the whole ruinous pantheon.
有时候，一个战士会引起毁灭之力的兴趣。黑色军团的冠军将尽一切可能赢得整个毁灭神殿的青睐。
Warlord_Lore/BL13: The Chosen are power-hungry veterans of the Chaos Space Marine warbands, known to undertake the most destructive and dangerous missions for the glory of Chaos.
神选者是混沌星际战士战队中对权力渴望无比的老兵，他们以执行最具破坏力和危险性的任务来为混沌的荣耀而闻名。
Warlord_Lore/BL14: Weapons infused with the power of daemons are truly fearsome to face in battle. They can cut straight through the thickest armour and empower the wielder in the process.
武器被恶魔的力量注入，真正令人在战斗中畏惧。它们可以直接切穿最厚的盔甲，并在此过程中赋予持有者力量。
Warlord_Lore/BL15: Blessed by Khorne, the Master of Executions stalks the battlefield looking for enemy champions and commanders to decapitate. Every trophy taken is savoured.
被恐虐祝福的斩首大师在战场上潜行，寻找敌方的冠军和指挥官进行斩首。每一个取得的奖杯都被珍视。
Warlord_Lore/BL16: When a Chaos Space Marine wishes to offer himself up completely to the Gods, he must spend months preparing his body with rituals and ceremonies.
当一个混沌星际战士希望完全奉献自己给神灵，他必须花费数月的时间用仪式和庆典来准备他的身体。
Warlord_Lore/BL17: Moving undetected through the warp, these Chaos Space Marines can slide into reality to ambush their targets at will and then disappear again just as quickly.
这些混沌星际战士在亚空间中悄无声息地移动，可以随意滑入现实来伏击他们的目标，然后同样迅速地再次消失。
Warlord_Lore/BL18: Transformed by the blessings of Nurgle, this formation of Black Legionaries wreaks ruin upon their enemies with toxic weaponry that renders them unable to defend themselves.
被纳垢的祝福转化，这支黑色军团战士的队伍用有毒的武器对敌人造成毁灭，使他们无法自卫。
Warlord_Lore/BL19: Specialised warriors in exceptionally heavy armour. In battle, they relentlessly advance towards enemy lines discharging deadly volleys while protected by their ironclad panoplies.
这些专业的战士穿着异常重的盔甲。在战斗中，他们不停地向敌人的阵线推进，同时发射致命的齐射，而他们的铁甲则保护着他们。
Warlord_Lore/BL20: A member of a hedonistic Chaos Space Marine formation devoted to Slaanesh. They swore allegiance to Abaddon, for he grants them endless opportunities to create anguish and torment.
一个奉献给色孽的混沌星际战士队伍的成员。他们向阿巴顿宣誓效忠，因为他给予他们无尽的机会来制造痛苦和折磨。
Warlord_Lore/BL5: The Hounds of Abaddon is a group of elite Khorne Berzerkers within the Black Legion. They plunge into battle with enraged fervour to take the enemy's skulls for the Skull Throne.
阿巴顿的猎犬是黑色军团中的精英恐虐狂战士团队。他们以狂热的热情投入战斗，为了骷髅王座取得敌人的头颅。
Warlord_Lore/BL22: These specialized psykers are able to channel daemons into living hosts even in the midst of battle, binding both of them together to create a Possessed Space Marine.
这些专门的灵能者能够在战斗中将恶魔引导入活体宿主，将两者绑定在一起，创造出一名附魔星际战士。
Warlord_Lore/BL23: Chaos Sorcerers call upon the warp to devastate their opponents. The constant exposure to the Immaterium quickly takes its toll, and most sorcerers end up insane.
混沌巫师呼唤亚空间来摧毁他们的对手。持续接触非物质世界很快就会产生影响，大多数巫师最终都会疯狂。
Warlord_Lore/BL24: The Chosen are already elite veterans of the Black Legion. Any among them to gain additional recognition as a champion is a formidable warrior indeed.
神选者已经是黑色军团的精英老兵。其中任何一员能够获得额外的认可并成为冠军，无疑都是一位强大的战士。
Warlord_Lore/BL25: A former Chaplain who has embraced Chaos. Dark Apostles live in the hope of someday being chosen for possession by powerful daemons.
一个已经接受混沌的前牧师。黑暗使徒生活在希望有一天被强大的恶魔选中附身的期待中。
Warlord_Lore/BL26: An Obliterator is a former techmarine who has been corrupted to become a mutant hybrid of man, machine and daemon.
泯灭者曾是科技战士，但被腐化成为人、机器和恶魔的突变体混合体。
Warlord_Lore/BL27: These terrifying Daemon Engines butcher their prey with cannons, claws and tendrils. They are often seen sprawling war zones in search of bodies to tear and souls to consume.
这些恐怖的恶魔引擎用大炮、爪子和触须屠杀他们的猎物。他们经常在战区四处寻找要撕裂的尸体和要吞噬的灵魂。
Warlord_Lore/BL28: A critically injured warrior can be entombed inside the bulk of a Helbrute to continue the fight for Chaos. Most consider this a terrible fate, a mockery by the gods.
一个重伤的战士可以被安置在地狱兽的大块体内继续为混沌战斗。大多数人认为这是一种可怕的命运，是神的嘲笑。
Warlord_Lore/BL29: Over ten thousand years, some warriors have gained status and respect to be considered champions among their kind. In battle, other legionaries will rally around them.
在过去的一万年里，一些战士获得了地位和尊重，被认为是他们种族中的冠军。在战斗中，其他军团战士会围绕他们集结。
Warlord_Lore/BL30: The most powerful champions of Chaos are elevated to high standing and granted additional blessings. They serve as commanders on the battlefield.
混沌最强大的冠军被提升到高位，并获得额外的祝福。他们在战场上担任指挥官。
Warlord_Lore/BL31: This bestial daemon engine charges towards its foes to rip them to pieces in close combat. They can tear even the heaviest armour to pieces with their claws.
这种兽性的恶魔引擎冲向敌人，用近战将他们撕成碎片。他们可以用他们的爪子将最重的盔甲撕成碎片。
Warlord_Lore/BL32: A powerful sorcerer who was once a member of the Thousand Sons. His mastery of the warp is such that he once brought Magnus the Red, his former master, to his knees.
曾是千子军团的一员，这位强大的巫师对亚空间的掌控程度之高，曾使他的前任导师红魔马格努斯屈膝。
Warlord_Lore/BL33: Known as the Arch-Lord Discordant, he emits an aura of scrapcode that quickly corrupts all machine spirits nearby, sowing confusion and chaos in enemies.
被称为混沌领主，他散发出的废码光环迅速腐蚀附近所有的机魂，使敌人陷入混乱。
Warlord_Lore/3f38d2e2c83df4b4c9052ef4a51: To the warriors of the Black Legion, being possessed by a daemon is a great honour, and the means to even greater power.
对于黑色军团的战士来说，被恶魔附身是一种巨大的荣誉，也是获得更大力量的途径。
Warlord_Lore/BL37: All warriors of the Black Legion vie to be noticed by Abaddon, for gaining the Warmaster’s favour is the fastest route to power and status.
所有黑色军团的战士都竞相得到阿巴顿的注意，因为得到战帅的青睐是获得权力和地位的最快途径。
Warlord_Lore/BL38: Dark Apostles offer up prayers to the Gods to direct their attention to their corrupted followers. If they are deemed worthy, the Gods will bestow a mote of their power onto them.
黑暗使徒向诸神献上祈祷，引导他们的注意力转向他们的堕落追随者。如果他们被认为值得，诸神将赐予他们一点力量。
Warlord_Lore/BL39: Mutations are but the favour of the Dark Gods made manifest. These blessings aid warriors chosen by the Gods to outlive constant battles, and further spread the influence of Chaos.
突变只是黑暗诸神的恩惠的体现。这些祝福帮助神选者在不断的战斗中存活下来，并进一步扩大混沌的影响力。
Warlord_Lore/BL40: Many Chaos Marines believe that they were betrayed by the Emperor during the Horus Heresy, not the other way around. They have spent millennia planning revenge.
许多混沌海军士兵认为他们在荷鲁斯之乱中被帝皇背叛，而不是反过来。他们花了千年时间策划复仇。
Warlord_Lore/BL41: Daemonic possession makes a warrior far stronger and tougher in battle… all for the small price of one’s soul.
恶魔的附身使战士在战斗中变得更强更坚韧...只需付出灵魂的小小代价。
Warlord_Lore/BL42: Its bitter hatred towards the Emperor and its thirst for revenge against the Imperium pushes the Black Legion ever further. They will not rest until Terra goes up in flames.
对帝皇的深深仇恨和对帝国的复仇欲望推动黑色军团不断前进。他们不会停止，直到泰拉化为灰烬。
Warlord_Lore/BL43: Khorne rallies his followers to ever greater levels of frenzy, bestowing great strength in combat in exchange for madness and fanaticism.
恐虐激励他的追随者达到更高的狂热程度，以疯狂和狂热换取战斗中的强大力量。
Warlord_Lore/BL44: Chaos Space Marines will often enter into pacts with daemons, offering their service in exchange for power and glory.
混沌星际战士常与恶魔签订契约，以他们的服务换取力量和荣耀。
Warlord_Lore/BL45: To court the gaze of the Chaos Gods is to risk their whims. The champions of chaos who cannot bear the gifts of the gods now exist only as mindless aberrations.
向混沌诸神献媚就要冒着他们反复无常的风险。无法承受诸神赠予的混沌勇士现在只存在于无意识的畸形之中。
Warlord_Lore/BL46: The four Chaos Gods bestow gifts upon their followers in the form of marks and powerful mutations that the Black Legion wields in battle to further spread the domain of Chaos.
四位混沌诸神以标记和强大的突变赠予他们的追随者，黑色军团在战斗中使用这些来进一步扩大混沌的领域。
Warlord_Lore/BL47: Those sworn to spread the corruption of Nurgle become vectors of decay, horrifically resilient as their master's blessings makes their rotting brains inured to bodily pain.
那些发誓要传播纳垢的腐败的人成为了衰败的载体，他们因为主人的祝福使他们腐烂的大脑对身体痛苦变得麻木，变得恐怖的坚韧。
Warlord_Lore/BL48: Tzeentch is always manipulating the fates, tugging at strands in inscrutably subtle ways to change the course of history.
奸奇总是在操纵命运，以难以理解的微妙方式拉扯着线索来改变历史的进程。
Warlord_Lore/BL49: Those devoted to Slaanesh throw themselves into battle to feed on the pain that surrounds them, channelling all these deadly delights to enter a frenzy of gore and pain.
那些忠于色孽的人投身于战斗，以吸取周围的痛苦，将所有这些致命的欢愉转化为疯狂的血腥和痛苦。
Warlord_Lore/BL50: Chaos Space Marines thrive on cruelty and ruthlessness and will never show mercy. Putting the weak out of their misery is standard practice.
混沌星际战士以残忍和无情为生，永远不会表现出怜悯。消除弱者的痛苦是标准做法。
Warlord_Lore/BL51: After the Horus Heresy, the exiles were banished to the warp storm known as the Eye of Terror. For ten thousand years they fought and planned their revenge.
荷鲁斯之乱后，流亡者被放逐到被称为恐惧之眼的扭曲风暴中。他们战斗并策划复仇了一万年。
Warlord_Lore/BL52: It’s possible to call upon the Dark Gods for assistance during battle. The Gods are fickle and may not respond, but when they do, the effects are devastating.
在战斗中，有可能呼唤黑暗诸神的援助。诸神反复无常，可能不会回应，但当他们回应时，效果是毁灭性的。
Warlord_Lore/BL53: Heldrakes are winged daemon engines that swoop across the battlefield and plunge down on enemy aircraft, ripping them to shreds to dominate the sky.
地狱魔龙是有翼的恶魔引擎，它们在战场上翱翔，冲向敌方飞机，将它们撕成碎片，以统治天空。
Warlord_Lore/BL54: A powerful daemon bound into the sword of the same name that is wielded by Abaddon the Despoiler. It can rend even reality apart.
被束缚在同名剑中的强大恶魔，由掠夺者阿巴顿挥舞。它甚至可以撕裂现实。
Warlord_Lore/BL55: Over the course of the millennia following the Horus Heresy, Abaddon has commanded the forces of Chaos in large-scale attacks against the Imperium known as Black Crusades.
在荷鲁斯之乱后的千年间，阿巴顿指挥混沌力量对帝国进行了大规模的袭击，这些袭击被称为黑色远征。
Warlord_Lore/BL4: Warbands of the Black Legion are known to be diverse and adaptable, but something proves true across them all: those in commanding positions have been blessed by the Gods of Chaos.
黑色军团的战队以其多样性和适应性而闻名，但有一点在所有战队中都被证实：那些在指挥位置上的人都得到了混沌神的祝福。
Warlord_Lore/BL21: Not even the temporary loss of his arms stopped this warrior from fighting. Originally one of Angron's World Eaters, he found a new purpose after joining Abaddon and his Black Legion.
即使暂时失去了他的手臂，这位战士也没有停止战斗。他原本是安格隆的吞世者之一，但在加入阿巴顿和他的黑色军团后找到了新的目标。
Warlord_Lore/BL62: The tendrils of Chaos spread far and wide, and have influenced millions across through the millennia. Dark Disciples traverse the Galaxy, seeking more adepts to join the fight against the Imperium.
混沌的触角遍布四方，影响了千百万年来的无数生灵。黑暗门徒穿越银河，寻找更多的信徒加入对抗帝国的战斗。
Warlord_Lore/BL63: Havocs bring heavy firepower to the lines of the Black Legion, wielding weaponry so powerful they often see themselves as gods, eliminating targets with each twitch of the finger.
浩劫为黑色军团的战线带来重型火力，他们手持的武器强大到他们常常将自己视为神，每次手指的微动都能消灭目标。
Warlord_Lore/BL64: Its not uncommon for a Chaos Marine to be possessed by a Daemon. Once these murderous denizens of the Warp take over, the Marine's thoughts and actions are no longer his alone.
混沌战士被恶魔附身并不罕见。一旦这些来自亚空间的杀戮居民接管，战士的思想和行动就不再只属于他自己。
Warlord_Lore/ASH1: His mastery of predictions and ability to peer into the past and future has allowed the Saim-Hann to fight for the times ahead with hope and determination.
他对预测的掌握和洞察过去未来的能力，使得萨姆-罕能够带着希望和决心为未来的战斗而战。
Warlord_Lore/ASH2: Expert jetbike rider, Eliac Zephyrblade is known for leading entire warhosts in perfectly orchestrated assaults to reclaim planets previously inhabited by the Aeldari.
喷气摩托专家伊莱亚克·泽菲尔刃以领导整个战团进行完美协调的攻击而闻名，他们的目标是收复曾经被艾达灵族居住的星球。
Warlord_Lore/ASH3: A warden of the Saim-Hann, Ghaelyn has fulfilled her duties time and again leading counteroffensives against any foe who dared attack an Aeldari sanctuary.
作为萨姆-罕的守护者，盖琳一次又一次地履行了她的职责，领导反攻行动，对抗任何敢于攻击艾达灵族圣地的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/ASH4: All Aeldari are trained for battle at some point in their lives, and all will don the war mask wilfully in times of war to protect their Craftworld.
所有艾达灵族人在生活的某个阶段都会接受战斗训练，他们都会在战争时期自愿戴上战争面具，保护他们的方舟世界。
Warlord_Lore/ASH5: Many Storm Guardians once served Aspect Shrines dedicated to close combat. When necessity calls, they will once more use the deadly skills they once honed to perfection.
许多风暴守护者曾在专门从事近战的支派神殿服役。当需要时，他们会再次使用他们曾经磨砺至完美的致命技能。
Warlord_Lore/ASH6: Aeldari Rangers follow the Path of the Outcast. Many still serve their craftworld by seeking out potential threats and trying to locate lost Maiden Worlds to create new sanctuaries.
艾达灵族的游侠遵循流浪者之道。许多人仍然通过寻找潜在的威胁和试图找到失落的少女世界来创建新的庇护所，为他们的方舟世界服务。
Warlord_Lore/ASH7: So few are the Aeldari that all are battle-trained and part of a Guardian Host. Saim-Hann Guardians are also trained in jetbike combat, but are yet to earn the right to ride into battle.
艾达灵族人数稀少，所有人都接受过战斗训练，并成为守护者军团的一部分。萨姆-罕的守护者也接受了喷气摩托战斗训练，但尚未获得进入战斗的权利。
Warlord_Lore/ASH8: Combining their psychic abilities and military experience, Warlock cast runes of battle to bolster the guardian hosts at their command and eliminate threats to the Craftworld.
战巫结合他们的心灵能力和军事经验，施放战斗符文以增强他们指挥下的守护者军团，并消除对方舟世界的威胁。
Warlord_Lore/ASH9: Saim-Hann Windriders expertly handle their jetbikes at astounding speeds and impossible angles. They have been known to defeat enemies before they even hear the sound of the engines.
萨姆-罕的驭风者摩托在惊人的速度和不可能的角度上熟练地驾驶他们的喷气摩托。他们已经被知道在敌人甚至听到引擎声音之前就击败了敌人。
Warlord_Lore/ASH10: These Raptor jetbikes are ridden into battle by a pair of Aeldari rangers. Accustomed to firing at high speeds, the pillion rider harasses enemy forces with pinpoint sniper accuracy.
这些猛禽喷气摩托是由一对艾达灵族游侠骑入战场的。习惯于高速射击，后座骑手以精准的狙击技巧骚扰敌军。
Warlord_Lore/ASH11: The deadliest of the close combat squads deployed by the Aeldari. These excellent infiltrators stalk their prey through the shadows before falling upon them with the wrath of Khaine.
艾达灵族部署的近战小队中最致命的。这些优秀的渗透者在阴影中潜伏，然后以凯恩的愤怒袭击他们的猎物。
Warlord_Lore/ASH12: In Aeldari Mythology, the hawk is a symbol of retribution. These aerial troops pay homage to their mythological homonym by dealing swift death to their enemies from the skies.
在艾达灵族神话中，鹰是报复的象征。这些空中军队通过从天空中迅速杀死敌人，向他们的神话同名词致敬。
Warlord_Lore/ASH13: Warp Spiders epitomise the doctrine of aggressive defence. Using an arcane dimensional device, they teleport in the blink of an eye and strike without warning from unseen quarters.
次元蜘蛛体现了积极防御的教条。他们使用神秘的次元设备，在眨眼之间传送并从看不见的地方毫无预警地攻击。
Warlord_Lore/ASH14: The body and weapons of Ghost Warriors like the Wraithblade are powered by a spirit stone, allowing the dead to control these constructs and fight for the Craftworld again.
像幽冥之刃这样的幽灵战士的身体和武器都由灵魂石驱动，使死者能够控制这些结构并再次为方舟世界战斗。
Warlord_Lore/ASH15: Specialized in close combat, they use precision and agility to efficiently slay their prey. Their piercing war cry is amplified into a mind-wreaking shock wave by their masks.
他们擅长近战，利用精确和敏捷有效地杀死猎物。他们的穿透性战斗呐喊被他们的面具放大成精神破坏的冲击波。
Warlord_Lore/ASH16: Nuadhu is possibly the most skilled and rash rider in existence. A legend among the Wild Riders of the Saim-Hann, he's often seen commanding impossible strike and fade charges.
努阿杜可能是现存最熟练和鲁莽的骑手。作为萨姆-罕的狂野骑手中的传奇，他经常被看到指挥不可能的攻击和消退冲锋。
Warlord_Lore/ASH17: Death doesn't grant respite from war to the Aeldari. Spiritseers can bring Ghost warriors to life by using a spirit stone, which contains the soul of a departed Aeldari.
死亡并未让艾达灵族从战争中得到休息。灵魂先知可以通过使用灵魂石，其中包含了一个已故艾达灵族的灵魂，将幽灵战士带回生活。
Warlord_Lore/ASH18: One of the mainstays of Saim-Hann armies, Vypers are highly mobile weapon platforms, capable of laying enemies down with intense and precise firepower.
作为萨姆-罕军队的主力之一，蝮蛇战车是高度移动的武器平台，能够用强烈和精确的火力将敌人击倒。
Warlord_Lore/ASH19: Witchblades not only enhance a Warlock's psychic abilities but can also be used as conduits for the wielder's powers and turn them into terrifying opponents at close quarters.
巫术之刃不仅能增强战巫的灵能，还可以作为施展力量的通道，使他们在近战中变得可怕。
Warlord_Lore/ASH20: The most common Aeldari ghost warriors. Wraithguard are impervious to damage and enter battle armed with terrifying weapons able to open momentary rifts between the warp and realspace.
最常见的艾达灵族幽灵战士就是幽冥守卫。他们对伤害免疫，装备着能在亚空间和真实空间之间瞬间开启裂缝的恐怖武器。
Warlord_Lore/ASH21: Crimson Hunters are trained to become exceptional pilots and marksmen, to the point that even the most complex and deadly manoeuvres come naturally to them.
绯红猎手经过训练，成为出色的飞行员和射手，即使是最复杂和致命的动作对他们来说也是信手拈来。
Warlord_Lore/ASH22: No Aspect Warrior revels more in destruction than the Fire Dragons. When deployed straight into the heart of battle using a vehicle, they can cause immense disarray to enemy lines.
没有哪个支派武士比火龙更喜欢破坏。当他们乘坐车辆直接投入战场中心时，他们能对敌人的阵线造成巨大的混乱。
Warlord_Lore/ASH23: Striking Scorpions are merciless killers without exception. Their ability to become one with the shadows has turned many battles around against unsuspecting enemies.
突击蝎是无情的杀手，无一例外。他们融入阴影的能力已经让许多毫无防备的敌人翻盘。
Warlord_Lore/ASH24: Few dare speak the true name of Wraithblades for fear of inciting the wrath of Khaine, the Aeldari god associated with murder, violence and war.
很少有人敢说出幽冥之刃的真名，因为他们害怕引发凯恩的愤怒，这是艾达灵族与谋杀、暴力和战争相关的神。
Warlord_Lore/ASH25: Spurring their allies as they wreak havoc through enemy lines, these battle-psykers are vital in performing the sudden assault strategies of the Saim-Hann.
这些战斗灵能者在他们的盟友中激起热情，他们在敌人的阵线中制造浩劫，对萨姆-罕的突然攻击策略至关重要。
Warlord_Lore/ASH26: Lightly armoured but heavily armed, the War Walkers serve as scouts and mobile heavy support in rough terrain. The formidable power of their weapons can take whole enemy squads at once.
战行者机甲轻装甲但重武器，作为侦查和移动重支援在崎岖地形中服务。他们武器的强大力量可以一次性消灭整个敌人的小队。
Warlord_Lore/ASH27: The Falcon is a fast, mobile and hard-hitting Grav-tank. This versatile vehicle is driven only by veteran pilots who wholly exploit its flight capability to rain death upon the enemy.
猎鹰战车是一种快速、机动且打击力强的反重力坦克。这种多功能车辆只由老兵驾驶，他们充分利用其飞行能力对敌人进行死亡打击。
Warlord_Lore/ASH28: Boasting an unmatched attunement with the spirits of the Saim-Hann, Qelenaris has led countless departed Aeldari back into battle, ready to fulfil their duties as they did in life.
以无与伦比的灵魂共鸣自豪，凯伦纳瑞斯引领无数已逝的艾达灵族回归战场，准备履行他们生前的职责。
Warlord_Lore/ASH29: Based on the Falcon's design, the Wave Serpent acts as a specialized troop transport in battle, bringing whole squads of Guardians to the heart of battle.
基于猎鹰战车的设计，波蛇战车在战斗中充当专门的军队运输工具，将整个守护者小队带到战斗的中心。
Warlord_Lore/ASH30: Fire Prisms are the dedicated tank-hunters of the Saim-Hann. They are armed with a Prism Cannon, a powerful weapon capable of felling a Necron Monolith with a single shot.
炎晶坦克是萨姆-罕的专用坦克猎手。他们装备有光晶炮，这是一种强大的武器，能够一击就摧毁太空死灵的夜石。
Warlord_Lore/ASH31: No defence can withstand a Saim-Hann strike. Winged Autarchs put their enemies in impossible situations commanding Aeldari Warhosts from a vantage position.
任何防御都无法抵挡萨姆-罕的攻击。翼装司战将敌人置于不可能的情况中，从有利位置指挥艾达灵族的战队。
Warlord_Lore/ASH32: Only former great heroes of the Saim-Hann pilot their statuesque Wraithlords. In battle, these towering warrior-nobles fight in much the same manner as they once did in life.
只有萨姆-罕的前大英雄才能驾驶他们的雕像般的幽冥领主。在战斗中，这些高大的战士贵族以他们生前的方式进行战斗。
Warlord_Lore/ASH33: This sinister aircraft harbours multiple essences of deceased Aeldari who act as co-pilots. Only the most determined Spiritseers can fly them and interact with the departed unscarred
这架阴险的飞机内藏有多个已逝艾达灵族的精髓，他们充当副驾驶。只有最坚定的灵魂先知才能驾驶它们，并与已逝者无损地互动。
Warlord_Lore/ASH34: Huge and all-powerful, the Avatar is a god incarnate, the embodiment of the Aeldari deity Khaine and a deadly opponent even for the mightiest powers in the Galaxy.
巨大而全能的化身是神的化身，是艾达灵族神祇凯恩的化身，即使对银河系中最强大的力量也是致命的对手。
Warlord_Lore/ASH35: Few foes can stand up to a Wraithknight's power. Armed with some of the heaviest weaponry of the Aeldari, these ghost warriors can obliterate masses of soldiers in a heartbeat.
很少有敌人能抵挡住幽冥骑士的力量。这些幽灵战士装备了艾达灵族的一些最重型武器，可以在一瞬间消灭大量士兵。
Warlord_Lore/ASH36: In the expert hands of a Saim-Hann pilot, Aeldari vehicles can perform seemingly impossible manoeuvres that would surprise even the most agile foes.
在萨姆-罕飞行员的熟练操作下，艾达灵族的车辆可以执行看似不可能的动作，这会让即使是最敏捷的敌人也感到惊讶。
Warlord_Lore/ASH37: Long ago, the Aeldari mastered travel through the labyrinthine dimension known as the Webway. Traversing the infinite mazes of this dimension, they can enter battle undetected.
很久以前，艾达灵族已经掌握了穿越被称为网道的迷宫维度的旅行。他们穿越这个维度的无尽迷宫，可以悄无声息地进入战斗。
Warlord_Lore/ASH38: When Aeldari seers sense a looming menace, they summon the certainty and confidence of ancient days into all near them. Doubt and fear are washed away, leaving way to grim resolve.
当艾达灵族的先知感知到一种潜在的威胁时，他们会将古代的确定和自信召唤到所有接近他们的人身上。疑虑和恐惧被冲走，留下的只有冷酷的决心。
Warlord_Lore/ASH39: It's not only the Saim-Hann pilots that should be feared. All Aeldari are trained warriors determined to fight for the Craftworld and capable of assaulting key enemy targets.
不仅仅是萨姆-罕的飞行员应该被人畏惧。所有的艾达灵族都是受过训练的战士，决心为方舟世界战斗，能够攻击敌人的关键目标。
Warlord_Lore/ASH40: These fighters represent the pinnacle of Aeldari aeronautic prowess. Piloted by Saim-Hann's most expert Crimson Hunters, they clear the skies and bring aerial support like no other.
这些战士代表了艾达灵族航空技术的巅峰。由萨姆-罕最专业的绯红猎手驾驶，他们清理天空，提供无与伦比的空中支援。
Warlord_Lore/ASH41: There once was a time in which the Webway spanned the Galaxy. Those days might be long gone, but Aeldari still make use of these dimensional gates to traverse the stars.
曾经有一段时间，网道横跨整个银河系。那些日子可能已经过去很久了，但艾达灵族仍然利用这些维度门来穿越星辰。
Warlord_Lore/ASH42: The agile and perfectly choreographed way of war of the Saim-Hann can wreak havoc to the enemy lines before they even know they're being attacked.
萨姆-罕灵活且完美的战争方式可以在敌人甚至还不知道自己正在被攻击之前对敌人的阵线造成破坏。
Warlord_Lore/ASH43: With their ability to travel at high speeds and teleport short distances, anyone who dares take their eyes from the shadows is doomed to fall against the Saim-Hann.
凭借他们的高速移动和短距离传送能力，任何敢于从阴影中移开视线的人都注定会在萨姆-罕面前倒下。
Warlord_Lore/ASH44: Like the bloody spear of Khaine, the Wild Rider clans strike from above, their riders and pilots screaming war cries into the raging winds.
就像凯恩的血腥长矛一样，狂野骑手部落从上方攻击，他们的骑手和飞行员在狂风中大喊战斗口号。
Warlord_Lore/ASH45: Sometimes referred to as the shriek-that-kills, the chilling scream of the Howling Banshees inflicts severe damage to the nervous systems of their foes.
有时被称为杀人的尖叫，狂嚎女妖的寒冷尖叫对敌人的神经系统造成严重伤害。
Warlord_Lore/ASH46: There is no safe refuge against Saim-Hann airborne strikes. Their preternatural ability in the skies is only matched by the precision of their weaponry even at high speeds.
对萨姆-罕的空中攻击没有安全的避难所。他们在天空中的超自然能力只能与他们高速飞行时武器的精准度相匹敌。
Warlord_Lore/ASH47: All Aeldari are trained in the handling of shuriken weaponry. The Bladestorm is a commonly used tactic, in which they lay down a hail of continuous fire with pinpoint accuracy.
所有艾达灵族都接受了星镖武器的训练。剑风暴是一种常用的战术，他们用这种战术发射连续的火力，精准无比。
Warlord_Lore/ASH48: In Aeldari myth, the Serpent is believed to know all secrets, past and present. In their language, the word for Serpent and secret knowledge is the same: "Saim".
在艾达灵族的神话中，蛇被认为知道所有的秘密，过去和现在的。在他们的语言中，蛇和秘密知识的词是相同的：“萨姆”。
Warlord_Lore/ASH49: Farseers can wield the eldritch energies as a weapon and are able to will vast psychic storms into existence, powerful enough to injure even heavily armoured enemies.
先知能够将奥秘能量作为武器，能够将强大的心灵风暴变为现实，足以伤害甚至是重装甲的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/ASH50: Saim-Hann's greatly skilled pilots exploit their vehicle's exceptional speed to seemingly vanish from the battlefield, returning moments later to deal death once again.
萨姆-罕的高技能飞行员利用他们的车辆的超常速度在战场上消失，几个瞬间后再次出现，再次带来死亡。
Warlord_Lore/ASH51: Infinity Circuits spread throughout all Aeldari Craftworlds. Inside it reside the souls of the departed Aeldari, which act as a massive ancestral mind to guide the living.
永恒回路遍布所有艾达灵族的方舟世界。在其中居住着已故的艾达灵族的灵魂，他们像一个庞大的祖先的思想一样指导着生者。
Warlord_Lore/ASH52: The Aeldari are not numerous enough to defend their Craftworlds from every attacker, and are forced to call upon the spirits of the dead to fill their ever-thinning ranks.
艾达灵族的数量不足以保卫他们的方舟世界免受每一个攻击者的侵害，他们被迫呼唤死者的灵魂来填补他们日益稀薄的行列。
Warlord_Lore/ASH53: Survival alone is not enough - the Aeldari long to see their civilisation restored to its former glory.
仅仅生存是不够的 - 艾达灵族渴望看到他们的文明恢复到昔日的辉煌。
Warlord_Lore/ASH54: When an Avatar of Khaine strikes with this ancient weapon, it can be heard shrieking as it tastes mortal flesh. This is no regular blade, but a manifestation of a dark and sinister god.
当凯恩化身用这把古老的武器攻击时，它可以听到尖叫声，因为它品尝到了凡人的肉体。这不是普通的刀剑，而是一个黑暗而邪恶的神的显现。
Warlord_Lore/ASH61: The advanced gravity-defying technology on the platforms allows the Eldar to rapidly and effortlessly move heavy weapons across the field of battle regardless of terrain.
这些平台上的先进反重力技术使艾尔达人能够迅速且毫不费力地在战场上移动重型武器，无论地形如何。
Warlord_Lore/ASH62: Patient and methodical aspect warriors, Dire Avenger's Shuriken Catapults are equipped with an advanced targeter that allows them to unleash a flurry of shurikens with pinpoint precision.
耐心且有方法的支派武士，凶暴复仇者的手里剑弹射器配备了先进的瞄准器，使他们能够以精准的定位释放一阵阵的星镖。
Warlord_Lore/ASH63: Exarchs at front of Dire Avengers have an uncanny ability to read the ebb and flow of battle, leading their squads with tactics designed to deny attacks of opportunity from opponents.
站在凶暴复仇者前线的主教有着不可思议的能力去读懂战斗的涨落，他们以设计来阻止对手机会攻击的战术来领导他们的小队。
Warlord_Lore/ASH64: More aggressive and daring than their kindred, the fighting passion and spirit of the Saim-Hann Craftworld is often reminiscent of Khaine's hunger for battle.
比他们的亲族更具侵略性和胆大，萨姆-罕的方舟世界的战斗激情和精神经常让人想起凯恩对战斗的渴望。
Warlord_Lore/ASH65: The anti-gravitic motors of Shining Spears’ gleaming jetbikes allow them to skim over the roughest terrains weaving through dense jungles and crumbling architecture without slowing.
闪耀之矛的喷气摩托搭载反重力马达，使他们能够在最崎岖的地形上滑行，穿越密集的丛林和破败的建筑，而不减速。
Warlord_Lore/ASH66: Shining Spear Exarchs possess preternatural reflexes and a deep understanding of their jetbikes dynamics, steering confidently at high speeds even with their eyes shut tight.
闪耀之矛的主教拥有超自然的反应力和对喷气摩托动态的深入理解，即使闭上眼睛也能在高速下自信地驾驶。
Warlord_Lore/ASH67: The Hornet is a small attack craft deployed for reconnaissance and raid missions, speeding ahead of the main force to harry priority targets and strike before the enemy can respond.
黄蜂是一种小型攻击飞船，用于侦察和突袭任务，超前于主力部队，骚扰优先目标并在敌人能反应之前攻击。
Warlord_Lore/ASH68: The Night Spinner's doomweaver spins deadly monofilament wire into a lethal web launched into the air, ensuring a horrific fate to any foe caught in its descent.
夜旋者的毁灭编织炮将致命的单丝线编织成一个致命的网，发射到空中，确保任何被其降落捕获的敌人都会遭受可怕的命运。
Warlord_Lore/ASH69: Speed, grace and overwhelming force are the hallmarks of the Howling Banshees. Their Exarchs exhibit the greatest ability of all, enhancing the deadly prowess of their followers.
速度、优雅和压倒性的力量是狂嚎女妖的标志。他们的主教展示了最大的能力，提高了他们追随者的致命威力。
Warlord_Lore/ASH70: The Aeldari believe that the spirit of someone murdered passes into a hawk. Swooping Hawks take their name from these wild hunting birds, for they are synonymous with vengeance.
艾达灵族相信被谋杀者的灵魂会进入一只鹰。翔鹰从这些野生猎鸟中得名，因为他们与复仇星同义。
Warlord_Lore/ASH71: Inhabited by those known as the Asuryani, the craftworlds are continentsized interstellar fortresses, each one representing a small preserved fragment of Aeldari civilisation
被称为Asuryani的人居住的方舟世界是大陆大小的星际堡垒，每一个都代表了艾达灵文明的一小部分保存的碎片。
Warlord_Lore/ASH72: Those who try to match blades with a Howling Banshee find their deadliest blows meeting nothing but air, as their foe dances around them before delivering the fatal strike.
那些试图与狂嚎女妖交剑的人会发现他们最致命的打击只是击中了空气，因为他们的敌人在他们周围跳舞，然后发动致命的攻击。
Warlord_Lore/ASH73: The Triskele's unique design lets Howling Banshee Exarchs use this deadly power weapon in close quarters or as a thrown weapon, slicing enemies before returning to their grasp.
三螺旋的独特设计使狂嚎女妖神官能在近战或作为投掷武器使用这种致命的能量武器，切割敌人后再返回他们的掌握。
Warlord_Lore/ASH74: Jain Zar has led hundreds of Howling Banshees to war. Furthermore, no other Phoenix Lord has championed the growing cause of the Ynnari more than her.
詹·扎尔已经带领数百名狂嚎女妖参战。此外，没有其他凤凰领主比她更支持死神军的增长事业。
Warlord_Lore/ASH75: Having perfected the deadly arts of the aspect shrine of the Howling Banshee for centuries, Autarch Yrlla now brings swift death to the foes who barely blink in her presence.
司战Yrlla经过数世纪的时间，已经将咆哮时代狂嚎女妖的支派神殿的致命艺术修炼得炉火纯青，现在她能在敌人几乎未曾眨眼的瞬间，给他们带来迅速的死亡。
Warlord_Lore/851f73daf747eb642934a16429b: It was Jain Zar, the devoted matriarch, who perfected and taught the Scream that Steals. Her own psychosonic barrage is so powerful it can liquefy the brains of her victims.
正是詹·扎尔，这位忠诚的修女长，完善并教授了窃取的尖叫。她自己的心灵音波弹幕如此强大，可以液化她的受害者的大脑。
Warlord_Lore/9c3562ffa183ede41b1626d9c9d: The Autarchs who tread the Path of Command have already completed other Asuryani paths, and aim to develop higher military skills to eliminate any threat with minimal losses.
走在指挥官之道的司战已经完成了其他艾达灵族的道路，他们的目标是提高军事技能，以最小的损失消除任何威胁。
Warlord_Lore/09bcb1b3b8794c4429d82d4b2e6: Considered the longest and most treacherous path, the Path of the Seer is only trodden by those determined enough to develop their psychic talents for the good of the Craftworld.
被认为是最长且最危险的道路，只有那些决心为方舟世界的利益发展他们的心灵才能的人才会走上先知之道。
Warlord_Lore/1bfe0893592c9dd40bed8d68d5d: Most Aeldari follow the call to war voluntarily at some point in their lives. Those who believe they can rebuild their lost empire with fire and blade traverse the Path of the Warrior.
大多数艾达灵族在生活中的某个时刻自愿响应战争的召唤。那些认为他们可以用火焰和剑重建失落帝国的人走上了战士之道。
Warlord_Lore/d3e99cb18b8cbba4081486f57f5: Destruction made manifest, the most warlike Aeldari who walk the Path of the Seer can bring devastation to their foes using nothing but their minds.
毁灭的化身，最好战的艾达灵族走在先知之道上，他们可以仅用心灵给敌人带来毁灭。
Warlord_Lore/33eabec155f628440a426a4ba48: Once awakened from his smouldering throne, the Avatar of Khaine will lead the armies of the Aeldari into battle, inciting its merciless rage into their hearts.
一旦凯恩化身从他燃烧的王座中醒来，他将带领艾达灵族的军队进入战斗，将他无情的愤怒激发到他们的心中。
Warlord_Lore/e59ac9e46f4ea804784e954c3b8: While the enemy attempts to take down their swift, devastating vehicles, the Saim-Hann deploy their forces on land to further pressure the enemy into a difficult position.
当敌人试图摧毁他们迅速且毁灭性的车辆时，萨姆-罕在陆地上部署他们的力量，进一步将敌人逼入困境。
Warlord_Lore/TL35: Amongst the billions of creatures created by the Hive Mind, the Swarmlord stands above all others, as the conduit through which the Hive Mind's implacable will is enforced.
在虫巢意志创造的数十亿生物中，虫群领主高高在上，是虫巢意志无情意愿的传导者。
Warlord_Lore/TL36: The highest advancement of the Zoanthrope bioform, these creatures drift through the battlefield using their psychic potential, leeching the very life force of their enemies.
这些生物是脑虫生物形态的最高进化，它们利用自己的精神潜能在战场上漂浮，吸取敌人的生命力。
Warlord_Lore/TL34: The Tervigon never enters the battlefield alone. This creature hosts a dormant swarm in its abdomen and it's been known to overwhelm its prey by spawning scores of lesser bioforms.
母虫从不单独进入战场。这种生物的腹部寄宿着一个休眠的虫群，它以产生大量次级生物形态来压倒猎物而闻名。
Warlord_Lore/TL10: These pack predators can lurk undetected for long periods of time. When they emerge from the shadows, their prey is quickly defeated with a flurry of eviscerating talons.
这些包猎者可以长时间潜伏不被发现。当他们从阴影中出现时，他们的猎物很快就被一阵撕裂的爪子击败。
Warlord_Lore/TL1: As the Tyranid ecosystem takes hold, Ripper swarms facilitate the speed at which Tyranids strip a planet of its natural resources.
当泰伦虫族的生态系统占据主导，撕裂虫群加速了泰伦虫族剥夺星球自然资源的速度。
Warlord_Lore/TL37: When these living, floating organisms detonate, they cloud the battlefield and cover enemies in acid, poison and pieces of chitin.
当这些活的，浮动的生物爆炸时，它们会在战场上形成云雾，将敌人覆盖在酸，毒和甲壳碎片中。
Warlord_Lore/TL2: When Hive Fleet Leviathan attacks, Hormagaunts act as shock troops. Numbered in the billions, these hunter-slayer organisms are left to rampage and wear down the prey's defences.
当利维坦虫巢舰队攻击时，刀虫作为突击军队。这些猎杀生物以十亿计，被放任去狂暴，磨损猎物的防御。
Warlord_Lore/TL3: Filled with poisonous gases, these rudimentary organisms are driven instinctively towards the enemy before detonating in a nauseating blast of filth and chitinous shrapnel.
这些原始的生物充满了有毒的气体，它们本能地向敌人驱动，然后在一场令人作呕的爆炸中爆炸，释放出污秽和甲壳碎片。
Warlord_Lore/TL4: The cunning and agile Termagant is one of the most common bioforms in any Hive Fleet. While not very strong individually, when fighting as a swarm, they can overwhelm nearly any enemy.
狡猾而敏捷的枪虫是任何虫巢舰队中最常见的生物形态。虽然单独作战时不是很强，但当作为一个虫群战斗时，他们几乎可以压倒任何敌人。
Warlord_Lore/TL5: Boasting the superior synaptic link of Hive Fleet Leviathan, the Tyranid Warrior is the backbone of many Tyranid invasions, serving as synaptic linchpins within a swarm.
拥有利维坦虫巢舰队优越的突触链接，泰伦武士是许多泰伦虫族入侵的骨干，作为虫群中的突触关键。
Warlord_Lore/TL6: Deep within the lumpen form of the Biovore lie a clutch of Spore Mines. This "living artillery" slowly thumps forward, clouding the battlefield with the mines it nurtures.
在吐菌虫的肥大形态深处，躺着一窝孢子雷。这种“生物炮兵”缓慢地向前蹒跚，用它孕育的雷云遮蔽战场。
Warlord_Lore/TL7: Sometimes called a "Hellbat" by Imperial soldiers who faced one in battle, the Gargoyle sows terror and confusion from the skies, wearing down enemy lines from unseen quarters.
石像鬼有时被在战场上遇到过它的帝国士兵称为“地狱蝙蝠”，它从天空中播下恐惧和混乱，从看不见的地方削弱敌人的阵线。
Warlord_Lore/TL8: Genestealers were the first Tyranid bioform discovered by the Imperium. They are vanguard organisms with a unique reproductive cycle that allows them to easily expand their numbers.
基因窃取者是帝国发现的第一种泰伦生物形态。他们是具有独特繁殖周期的先锋生物，这使他们能够轻易扩大他们的数量。
Warlord_Lore/TL9: The Pyrovore's whole purpose is to sate the Hive's hunger. It's common to see them feeding on the dead while the intelligent bio-weapon on its back fends off approaching enemies.
喷焰虫的全部目的就是满足虫巢的饥饿。看到它们在死者身上觅食，而它背上的智能生物武器抵挡接近的敌人是常见的。
Warlord_Lore/TL11: The whip-like tendrils of a Venomthrope drip with a multitude of alien poisons. The mix of these toxins is so potent that it's believed the touch of a Venomthrope means certain death.
毒烟虫的鞭状触须滴落着各种外星毒素。这些毒素的混合物如此强烈，以至于人们相信毒烟虫的触摸意味着必然的死亡。
Warlord_Lore/TL12: Well armoured and resilient, so extreme is the Tyrant Guard's bio-adaptation that they do not possess any weak spots such as eyes.
装备精良且坚韧，暴君护卫的生物适应如此极端，以至于他们没有任何弱点，如眼睛。
Warlord_Lore/TL13: Lictors are specialized in infiltration and assassination. Hidden by their chameleonic skin their assaults are clouded and brutal, picking off their enemies one by one.
刀斧蟲擅长潜入和暗杀。他们的变色皮肤隐藏了他们，他们的攻击是模糊而残酷的，一个接一个地挑选他们的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/TL14: A Sporocyst embeds itself into the ground like a tick in unprotected skin. From its chitinous shell sprout Spore Mines that pollute the atmosphere to make it ripe for digestion.
孢囊要塞将自己嵌入地面，如同蜱虫嵌入无保护的皮肤。从其几丁质壳中生出孢子雷，污染大气使其适合消化。
Warlord_Lore/TL15: Considered the apex of the Tyranid Warrior strain, the presence of a Prime alone can turn a group of Tyranid creatures into an effective and unified fighting force.
被认为是泰伦武士菌株的顶峰，一个主体的存在就能将一群泰伦虫族生物变成一个有效且统一的战斗力量。
Warlord_Lore/TL20: Rugged and adaptable organisms, the large frame of the Carnifex allows them to support a great range of weapon grafts, from scything talons to ranged bio-plasma weaponry.
坚固且适应性强的生物，刽子手的大框架使他们能够支持大范围的武器移植，从镰爪到远程生物电浆武器。
Warlord_Lore/TL17: This evolved strain of the Lictor appears to instinctively know how to spread fear through its preys, and uses stealth and assassination to sow dread before the hive attacks.
这种进化的刀斧蟲似乎本能地知道如何通过猎物传播恐惧，并使用隐身和暗杀在虫巢攻击前播下恐惧。
Warlord_Lore/TL38: Hive Guard are spawned to protect Tyranid bio-architecture and vital spore-seeding sites, laying down heavy hails of firepower with their monstrous arsenal of grafted bio-weapons.
虫巢护卫被孵化出来保护泰伦虫族的生物建筑和重要的孢子播种地点，用他们的怪物级生物武器库发射重炮火。
Warlord_Lore/TL16: Once these burrowing creatures have located prey, they surge upwards in an eruption of soil, talons and claws, swallowing everything above before plunging back under the surface.
一旦这些挖掘生物找到猎物，他们就会在土壤、爪子和爪子的爆发中向上涌动，吞噬上面的一切，然后再次潜入地表。
Warlord_Lore/TL18: Zoanthropes have evolved to harness the psychic might of the Hive Mind. These mobile synapse nodes draw upon the Hive's energies to unleash deadly psychic blasts.
脑虫已经进化出利用虫巢意志的精神力量的能力。这些移动的突触节点利用虫巢的能量释放致命的精神爆炸。
Warlord_Lore/TL19: Especially adept in infiltration, Broodlords lead Genestealers from the shadows thanks to their superior synaptic link, which allows them to function independently from the Hive Mind.
巢群领主特别擅长渗透，由于他们优越的突触链接，他们能够引导基因窃取者从阴影中行动，使他们能够独立于虫巢意志运作。
Warlord_Lore/TL21: The terrifying shriek this creature emits is only surpassed by the deadly blasts of bio-plasma that follow. They are often seen wreaking havoc at the forefront of a Tyranid assault.
这种生物发出的恐怖尖叫只有随之而来的生物电浆的致命爆炸才能超越。他们经常被看到在泰伦虫族攻击的前线制造浩劫。
Warlord_Lore/TL22: Whether by tearing its quarry with its bladed spurs or by shooting its drool cannons with unerring accuracy, the Hive Crone is an aerial menace even to the most skilled pilots.
无论是用其刀锋般的刺撕裂猎物，还是准确无误地射击其口水炮，虫巢天妪都是对最熟练的飞行员的空中威胁。
Warlord_Lore/TL23: Tyrannocytes are ejected from orbit, carrying smaller Tyranid bioforms. The impact of planetfall disgorges the creatures that dwell inside, deploying the brooding hosts into battle.
孢子舱从轨道上弹射出来，携带着较小的泰伦虫族生物形态。星球落地的冲击力使居住在内部的生物涌出，将孵化的主体部署到战场上。
Warlord_Lore/TL24: During Tyranid invasions, Harpies can be seen conquering the skies and dropping salvos of organic munitions such as Spore Mines onto the panicked enemy lines.
在泰伦虫族入侵期间，可以看到鹰獾征服天空，并向恐慌的敌人线投下有机弹药，如孢子雷。
Warlord_Lore/TL25: Possessing great strategic cunning, these evolved bioforms command the swarm on the Hive Mind's behalf. Where the Hive Tyrants bestride the battlefield, death comes for prey.
这些进化的生物形态具有极高的战略智谋，代表虫巢意志指挥虫群。在虫巢暴君跨越战场的地方，死亡来到猎物身边。
Warlord_Lore/TL26: This living vessel of the Hive Mind wields colossal synaptic power. Its unbridled psychic potential is such that this creature inadvertently creates a protective field around itself.
这个虫巢意志的生物舰只有巨大的神经力量。它无尽的心灵潜力如此之大，以至于这个生物无意中在自己周围创建了一个保护场。
Warlord_Lore/TL27: The Exocrine's only task is to carry its dorsal cannon into optimal firing position. The cannon is an independent organism, capable of reducing tanks with searing blasts of bio-plasma.
离子炮兽的唯一任务是将其背部的炮塔带入最佳射击位置。这门炮是一个独立的生物，能够用生物电浆的灼热爆炸减少坦克。
Warlord_Lore/TL28: Afflicted by an infinite hunger, the Haruspex is a ferocious beast created to consume biomass at a sickening pace. With its lashing tongue, it can devour entire platoons in moments.
巨噬兽被无尽的饥饿所困扰，是一种为了以惊人的速度消耗生物质而创造的凶猛的野兽。它用鞭舌，可以在瞬间吞噬整个排。
Warlord_Lore/TL29: Spawned to enact the Hive Mind's will from the skies, the Winged Hive Tyrant is not only a mighty beast in its own right, but also acts as a mobile synaptic nexus for the Tyranid swarm.
为了从天空中实现虫巢意志的意愿，翼暴君不仅是一种强大的野兽，而且还充当泰伦虫族虫群的移动神经节点。
Warlord_Lore/TL30: Unyielding in battle as any war engine and carrying the pinnacle of Tyranid bio-weaponry, the massive Tyrannofex exists purely to spread destruction to Leviathan's foes.
暴虐兽在战斗中坚不可摧，如同任何战争机器，并携带着泰伦虫族生物武器的顶峰，这个巨大的生物存在的唯一目的就是向利维坦虫的敌人传播破坏。
Warlord_Lore/TL39: Tyranids are not mindless beasts. Their synaptic link and instincts allow these cunning creatures to plan complex ambushes to take out any foe.
泰伦虫族并非无脑的野兽。他们的突触链接和本能使这些狡猾的生物能够策划复杂的伏击，消灭任何敌人。
Warlord_Lore/TL32: Whether soaring through the skies or swarming the battlefield, it is no hardship for Tyranids to apparently fade from the battle to stalk their prey before striking again.
无论是在天空中翱翔还是在战场上蜂拥，泰伦虫族都能轻易地从战斗中消失，然后悄悄跟踪猎物，再次发动攻击。
Warlord_Lore/TL48: The instinctive hunter-slayer behaviour of the Tyranid swarm only adds to the dangers of facing them in battle, making them terrifying and unpredictable foes.
泰伦虫族虫群的本能猎杀行为只会增加在战斗中面对他们的危险，使他们成为恐怖且不可预测的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/TL33: When the savage instincts of the Hive Mind take over, a surge of adrenaline spreads through the swarm, prompting an innate, primal urge to destroy and consume all in its path.
当虫巢意志的野性本能接管时，一股肾上腺素在虫群中蔓延，激发出一种本能的、原始的毁灭和消耗一切的冲动。
Warlord_Lore/TL31: In an attempt not to waste any precious biomass, most Tyranid organisms have been designed by the Hive Mind to be impervious to damage.
为了不浪费任何宝贵的生物质，大多数泰伦虫族生物都被虫巢意志设计成对伤害无动于衷。
Warlord_Lore/TL49: Tyranid strains are highly adaptive. The rapid evolutionary cycle of the Tyranids allows them to continually develop defences against new dangers, sometimes even in the midst of battle.
泰伦虫族的菌株具有高度的适应性。泰伦虫族的快速进化周期使他们能够不断开发出对新危险的防御，有时甚至在战斗中也能做到。
Warlord_Lore/TL40: A Hive Fleet infests planets before an invasion to wear down its defences from the inside. The swarm establishes hidden colonies that reveal themselves once the invasion begins.
虫巢舰队在入侵前会感染行星，从内部削弱其防御。虫群在行星上建立隐藏的殖民地，一旦入侵开始，这些殖民地就会显露出来。
Warlord_Lore/TL41: The swarms of bio-engineered creatures of Hive Fleet Leviathan are seemingly unending. As long as there is biomass available, the Hive Mind will spawn new warriors to fight and consume.
利维坦虫巢舰队的生物工程生物虫群似乎无穷无尽。只要有生物质可用，虫巢意志就会孵化新的战士去战斗和消耗。
Warlord_Lore/TL42: Usually the first amongst the swarm to assail the prey, flying organisms pick at their foes with a combination of deadly dives and airborne fire.
飞行生物通常是虫群中首先攻击猎物的，它们用致命的俯冲和空中火力攻击敌人。
Warlord_Lore/TL43: Most Tyranids are hunters by nature. Their biomorphologies are adapted to seeking and consuming all matter in their paths to sate the Hive Mind's endless hunger.
大多数泰伦虫族都是天生的猎人。他们的生物形态适应于寻找和消耗他们路径上的所有物质，以满足虫巢意志无尽的饥饿。
Warlord_Lore/TL44: An impenetrable carapace protects the swarm from danger. Its chitinous material is designed to absorb even the heaviest of impacts, turning Tyranids into unstoppable biohorrors.
坚不可摧的甲壳保护着虫群免受危险。其甲壳材料设计用来吸收最重的冲击，使泰伦虫族变成无法阻挡的生物恐怖。
Warlord_Lore/TL50: The Hive Mind is always learning. Tyranids change and evolve continuously, adapting to new foes and environments, ready to take on the most dangerous foes and consume the direst of clusters.
虫巢意志始终在学习。泰伦虫族不断变化和进化，适应新的敌人和环境，准备面对最危险的敌人和消耗最恶劣的集群。
Warlord_Lore/TL51: All matter in a planet must be consumed, even its atmosphere. The noxious vapours exuded by the swarm not only makes the air digestible, but also hinders the enemy ability to fight back.
一个星球中的所有物质都必须被消耗，甚至包括其大气。虫群排放的有毒蒸气不仅使空气可消化，而且还妨碍敌人的反击能力。
Warlord_Lore/TL52: The Leviathan cannot be stopped. When it seems the swarm has been defeated, Hive Ships send new biohorrors straight into battle from orbit.
利维坦虫无法被阻止。当虫群似乎已经被击败时，虫巢舰只会从轨道上直接送入新的生物恐怖进入战斗。
Warlord_Lore/TL53: Hive Fleet Leviathan's superior synaptic link allows the many strands of Tyranids to work together like an organized fighting group and eliminate enemies with synergistic assaults.
利维坦虫巢舰队的优越突触链接使泰伦虫族的许多菌株能像有组织的战斗团队一样协同工作，用协同攻击消灭敌人。
Warlord_Lore/TL45: Tyranids have no natural predator. Created specifically for the devouring of all matter, they pose one of the greatest threats to all life in the Galaxy.
泰伦虫族没有天敌。他们是专门为消耗所有物质而创建的，他们对银河系中所有生命构成了最大的威胁。
Warlord_Lore/TL46: Tyranids do not invade for territorial gain, pride or vengeance. Rather, their purpose is to harvest valuable biomass and feed their insatiable hunger.
泰伦虫族并不是为了领土、荣誉或复仇而入侵。相反，他们的目的是收集有价值的生物质，满足他们无尽的饥饿。
Warlord_Lore/TL47: The largest and most widespread hive fleet to date, Leviathan shows clear signs of having learnt from the fates of other fleets, and remains a threat to life in the galaxy.
到目前为止最大且最广泛的虫巢舰队，利维坦显示出明显的学习其他舰队命运的迹象，并仍然对银河系中的生命构成威胁。
Warlord_Lore/TL60: Neurogaunts are specialized bioforms that act as mobile and armed relays for the Synapse network. They are hosts to parasitic Neurocytes, that extend the range of Synaptic creatures.
神经虫是专门的生物形态，作为移动和武装的突触节点网络中继。它们是寄生神经细胞的宿主，可以扩大突触生物的范围。
Warlord_Lore/TL61: Even when a planet has been saved from the Leviathan tide, there is no opportunity for respite. Any remnant of the Hive Fleet will be enough to bring a world to its doom if left unchecked.
即使一个星球已经从利维坦虫潮汐中被拯救出来，也没有休息的机会。任何虫巢舰队的残余都足以将一个世界带入毁灭，如果不加以检查的话。
Warlord_Lore/TL62: Designed for shock assault and swift pursuit, Raveners track their prey over massive distances, detecting the slightest movement as they pursue them with terrifying speed.
蛇虫被设计用于冲击突击和快速追击，它们可以在大距离上追踪猎物，以恐怖的速度追逐它们，检测到最微小的动作。
Warlord_Lore/TL63: Tyranids can close terrifyingly long distances in a single leap thanks to their specialized anatomy, jumping from one prey to another before they have a chance to react.
泰伦虫族可以利用他们专门的解剖结构在一次跳跃中关闭恐怖的长距离，从一个猎物跳到另一个猎物，而他们没有机会反应。
Warlord_Lore/TL64: Though Tyranid bioforms are often specialized in a task, they all share the same instinct for the hunt. Hive Fleet Leviathan hungers, and none will stop it from devouring all.
虽然泰伦虫族的生物形态通常在任务中有专门的专长，但他们都有同样的狩猎本能。利维坦虫巢舰队饥饿，没有人能阻止它吞噬一切。
Warlord_Lore/a58e05916eb5e994daa0349cbe2: Overriding the instinctive behaviour of the swarm, synaptic creatures lead the numberless hordes of Tyranids against their foes with great tactical acuity.
突触生物领导着无数的泰伦虫族大军，以极高的战术敏锐性对抗他们的敌人，从而覆盖了虫群的本能行为。
Warlord_Lore/c0ddba6cc45944f46a65f4fd93b: Tyrannocytes are the backbone of large-scale invasions, serving as one of the main means of Hive Ship-to-surface transportation for the swarm.
孢子舱是大规模入侵的支柱，作为虫巢舰到地面运输虫群的主要手段之一。
Warlord_Lore/5b5425f6e2848b449807bd1643d: The Swarmlord is the herald of the Hive Mind and may be as old as the Tyranid race itself. This creature preys on empires, and has overseen the extinction of entire civilisations.
蟲群領主是虫巢意志的使者，可能与泰伦虫族的历史一样悠久。这种生物以帝国为食，监督了整个文明的灭绝。
Warlord_Lore/760bd3afde513774d96d6492f99: Neurothropes can harness the energies syphoned from their foes to both bolster nearby Tyranids and unleash searing psychic blast attacks.
强化脑虫可以利用从敌人身上吸取的能量来增强附近的泰伦虫族，并释放灼热的心灵爆炸攻击。
Warlord_Lore/cbc9d98e39cc7fb4fa6f94c7e69: Acting as a living incubator, the Tervigon spawns its dormant broods at will. The new spawn instinctively protect the broodmother, their numbers growing until they overwhelm the enemy.
作为一个活的孵化器，母虫随意产生其休眠的巢穴。新的孵化物本能地保护巢穴母亲，他们的数量增长，直到压倒敌人。
Warlord_Lore/ASH55: The Path of the Warrior has many branches, known as Warrior Aspects. Each one reflects a facet of the god Khaine, and boasts its own unique fighting techniques and battlefield role.
战士之道有许多分支，被称为战士面相。每一个都反映了凯恩神的一面，并拥有其独特的战斗技巧和战场角色。
Warlord_Lore/ASH57: The mastery of Webway travel was integral to the survival of the Aeldari. Many of their sanctuaries were saved by reinforcements arriving through this Labyrinthine Dimension.
掌握网道旅行对艾达灵族的生存至关重要。他们的许多圣地得以幸存，都是因为援军通过这个迷宫般的维度抵达。
Warlord_Lore/ASH59: The Infinity Circuit threaded throughout every Aeldari craftworld can act as a seemingly unlimited vault of ancestral knowledge accrued by the Aeldari through the millennia.
穿越每一个艾达灵族方舟世界的永恒回路可以作为一个看似无限的祖先知识库，这些知识是艾达灵族经过千年积累的。
Warlord_Lore/ASH60: Following the pathways between dimensions is a risk even to the Aeldari. The intricate threads of the Labyrinth Dimension may unveil advantageous secrets, or swallow platoons in its roiling tides.
即使对艾达灵族来说，沿着维度之间的路径前进也是一种风险。迷宫维度的复杂线索可能揭示有利的秘密，或者在其翻滚的潮汐中吞噬整个排。
Warlord_Lore/ASH56: Aeldari strive to match and surpass the deeds of their ancestry, honing their skills across centuries for the good of the Craftworld and the survival of their kin.
艾达灵族努力匹配并超越他们祖先的事迹，磨练他们的技能，跨越世纪，为了方舟世界的利益和他们亲族的生存。
Warlord_Lore/BL56: Seeking vengeance on the Imperium, the warriors of the Legions that betrayed the Emperor during the Horus Heresy gathered under Abaddon's banner, bringing the Black Legion into existence.
为了向帝国复仇，那些在荷鲁斯之乱期间背叛帝皇的军团的战士们聚集在阿巴顿的旗帜下，使黑色军团诞生。
Warlord_Lore/BL57: The heretical symbols found within the Black Legion battleships are far from mere ornaments. Imbued with daemonic energies, they can serve as a bridge between the Dark Gods and their devout servants.
黑色军团战舰内发现的异端符号远非仅仅是装饰品。它们充满了恶魔的能量，可以作为黑暗诸神和他们虔诚的仆人之间的桥梁。
Warlord_Lore/BL58: The moods of the Ruinous Powers are fickle and unpredictable. But when wielded correctly, the powers they bestow can be used reliably to bring a gruesome end to invading forces.
毁灭之力的情绪是反复无常且不可预测的。但是，如果正确地使用，他们赋予的力量可以可靠地用来结束入侵的力量。
Warlord_Lore/BL59: The chaotic energies that power the Black Legion's fleets and structures act on the whims of the Ruinous Powers, punishing interlopers and unworthy champions alike.
驱动黑色军团舰队和建筑的混乱能量受毁灭之力的任性驱使，惩罚侵入者和不配的冠军。
Warlord_Lore/BL61: Warp storms cause unbridled, nightmarish energies to pour into realspace, empowering those capable of manipulating the psychic energies of the Immaterium.
亚空间风暴使无法控制的，恶梦般的能量涌入现实空间，增强那些能够操纵非物质领域的心灵能量的人。
Warlord_Lore/BL60: The manifest emotion of battle feeds the Warp, attracting the attention of fearsome daemonic beings who gladly form dark pacts so that the gruesome spectacle may continue.
战斗的显现情绪滋养了亚空间，吸引了恐怖的恶魔生物的注意，他们愿意形成黑暗契约，以便这场骇人的表演可以继续。
Warlord_Lore/GOF49: Gretchin mobs compensate for their lack of warring quality with their sheer quantity. Although feeble-limbed by nature, their bites and stabs can add up to bring down larger opponents.
地精暴群以他们的数量来弥补他们缺乏战斗的质量。尽管他们天生四肢虚弱，但他们的咬和刺可以累积起来击败更大的对手。
Warlord_Lore/GOF53: The orks have showcased time and time again an ability to quickly build a functioning vehicle out of ramshackle parts that would put tech-priests to shame.
欧克蛮人一次又一次展示出他们的能力，能迅速地从破烂不堪的零件中制造出一个功能完备的载具，这让技术祭司都感到羞愧。
Warlord_Lore/GOF52: Often lit up just for the amusement of seeing things burn, Orks have found ingenious ways to use burning barrels in battle.
往往只是为了看到事物燃烧的乐趣而点燃，欧克蛮人已经找到了在战斗中使用燃烧桶的巧妙方法。
Warlord_Lore/GOF51: Attacking by night is a tried and tested tactic to secure the element of surprise. Beware though, a cunnin' enemy might turn the situation in their favor.
夜间攻击是一种经过验证的策略，可以确保取得突然的元素。但是要小心，一个狡猾的敌人可能会把情况转变为他们的有利。
Warlord_Lore/GOF50: Planning an attack during a dust storm is not an easy task. Even with advanced targeting systems, this ever-changing landscape can hinder a squad's capacity to locate their prey.
在尘暴中计划攻击并不是一件容易的事。即使有高级瞄准系统，这个不断变化的景观也可能妨碍一个小队找到他们的猎物。
Warlord_Lore/GOF54: The undetermined nature of unexplored alien planets often includes exotic substances in its atmosphere, which have unexpected consequences such as intensified beligerence.
未探索的外星球的不确定性往往包括大气中的异国物质，这些物质可能会产生意想不到的后果，比如加剧敌对行为。
Warlord_Lore/SAU59: Dormant Necron Obelisks rise when they detect an enemy presence in the skies above a Necron Tomb World. Pulsating with energy, it will seek out the enemy to destroy it with its Tesla Spheres.
当太空死灵墓穴世界的上空出现敌人时，沉睡的太空死灵方尖碑会升起。它充满能量，会寻找敌人并用其特斯拉球将其摧毁。
Warlord_Lore/SAU61: There is no respite when fighting the Necrons. With a surge of exotic energies, a recently felled warrior could reappear to exact their revenge on their aggressors.
与太空死灵战斗时，没有片刻的喘息。一名刚倒下的战士可能会在异能的激增下重新出现，向他们的侵略者复仇。
Warlord_Lore/SAU60: Millennia of battle have increased the tactical accuity of the Sautekh Dynasty, and taught them how to turn even the most damning of omens to their advantage.
千年的战斗提高了索泰克王朝的战术敏锐度，并教会了他们如何将最糟糕的预兆转化为他们的优势。
Warlord_Lore/SAU62: To fight in treacherous geological conditions is a challenge even to the most veteran and agile of warriors, making every step a fight against an unpredictable enemy.
在险恶的地质条件下战斗，即使对最老练、最敏捷的战士也是一种挑战，每一步都是与不可预测的敌人的战斗。
Warlord_Lore/SAU64: Assaulting during a Solar Storm is a risky endeavour, as they can have unexpected effects, overcharging machinery and filling the air with exotic energies.
在太阳风暴期间进行突击是一项冒险的尝试，因为它们可能会产生意想不到的效果，过度充电的机械和充满异域能量的空气。
Warlord_Lore/SAU63: Shaping and powering the mysterious living metal requires enormous amounts of power for the Necrons, emanating from their structures and filling the air.
对太空死灵来说，塑造和驱动神秘的活金属需要大量的能量，这些能量从他们的建筑中散发出来，充满了空气。
Warlord_Lore/TL54: After a Tyranid invasion, all matter on a planet is slowly broken down and digested in pools of biomatter. These are highly valued by the Hive Mind, and will be guarded zealously.
在泰伦虫族入侵后，星球上的所有物质都会慢慢分解并在生物质池中消化。这些对虫巢意志来说极其珍贵，会被狂热地保护。
Warlord_Lore/TL55: Once the invasion of a planet reaches an advanced state, gruesome structures emerge that protect the precious biomatter until it is entirely consumed by the Hive Fleet.
一旦星球的入侵进入高级阶段，保护珍贵生物质的恐怖建筑会出现，直到它被虫巢舰队完全消耗。
Warlord_Lore/TL56: When Tyranids start consuming a planet, they fill the atmosphere with harmful microscopic spores that allow the hive to eventually consume even the air.
当泰伦虫族开始消耗星球时，他们会用有害的微观孢子填充大气，使虫巢最终甚至能消耗空气。
Warlord_Lore/TL59: Setting the pools of biomass ablaze before an invasion will send the hive into disarray, but fighting in an active inferno is always a perilous endeavour.
在入侵前将生物质池点燃会使虫巢陷入混乱，但在活跃的火海中战斗总是一项危险的尝试。
Warlord_Lore/TL57: Provoked by the Hive's efforts to consume the atmosphere, this chemical downpour makes even the heaviest armour and chitinous structure unreliable.
虫巢努力消耗大气的行为激起了这场化学暴雨，使得即使是最重的盔甲和甲壳结构也变得不可靠。
Warlord_Lore/TL58: The Hive's objective is to consume, and it will resort to any measure to claim the biomatter that it has conquered, even if it means consuming its own spawn.
虫巢的目标是消耗，它将采取任何措施来获取已经征服的生物物质，即使这意味着消耗自己的后代。
Warlord_Lore/UM53: The vast Imperium is besieged on all corners. To always be ready to defend it, many Imperial Worlds are fully dedicated to stocking up the imperial arsenal with weapons and munitions.
广袤的帝国在所有角落都受到围攻。为了始终做好防御准备，许多帝国世界全力以赴地为帝国军火库储备武器和弹药。
Warlord_Lore/UM52: A common sight atop the walls of Ultramarine bases of operations, the Firestrike turret is a flexible defensive weapon ideal for defending the flanks of important structures.
火力打击炮塔是极限战士基地上常见的景象，这是一种灵活的防御武器，非常适合保卫重要建筑的侧翼。
Warlord_Lore/UM54: Situational awareness is a key skill in Ultramarine training exercises, leading to good strategical positioning in any terrain, and increased survivability in battle.
情境意识是极限战士训练中的关键技能，能在任何地形中带来良好的战略定位，并在战斗中增加生存率。
Warlord_Lore/UM50: Fighting in the midst an Orbital Strike is an hazardous undertaking, though it could well turn the tides of battle in a fortuitous moment.
在轨道攻击中战斗是一项危险的任务，尽管在适当的时刻可能会改变战斗的潮汐。
Warlord_Lore/UM51: Battles during a thunderstorm can strain even the most veteran warriors, as the elements impede movement and communication, and interfere with scanning equipment.
在雷暴中的战斗甚至可以使最老练的战士感到压力，因为元素阻碍了移动和通信，并干扰了监视设备。
Warlord_Lore/ASH58: The secrecy of a pitch-black environment can prove to be a massive advantage against an unaware enemy, but an incautious assailant might find the dark can hold secrets of its own.
黑暗环境的秘密性可以成为对抗毫无警觉的敌人的巨大优势。但是，一个不谨慎的攻击者可能会发现黑暗本身也保持着自己的秘密。
Warlord_Lore/UM49: The raging theatres of war intersect with one another in every battle, making them highly unpredictable. Being able to adapt to sudden changes is a key skill to secure victory.
各种冲突领域在每场战斗中交织，使其变得极其难以预测。能够适应突然的变化是确保胜利的关键技能。
Warlord_Lore/UM49_FleetSupport: Securing regular support from the orbiting fleet is key to the success of most ground assaults, with the steady influx of troops overwhelming most defensive forces.
从轨道舰队获得定期支援是大多数地面攻击成功的关键，稳定的军队涌入使得大多数防御力量不堪重负。
Warlord_Lore/TL65: A small, psychic Tyranid organism. Neuroloids are most commonly seen beside a Neurotyrant, enhancing its abilities and acting as relays of the creature's synaptic network.
一个小型的，具有心灵力量的泰伦虫族生物。神经虫最常见的是在神经暴君旁边，增强其能力并作为生物突触网络的中继。
Warlord_Lore/TL66: Neurogaunts fulfil a double role on the battlefield. This creature is a relay for the Synapse network and acts as a wall of flesh and claws to protect those who would focus it.
神经爪兽在战场上扮演双重角色。这种生物是突触网络的中继，并作为肉体和爪子的墙壁保护那些会集中攻击它的人。
Warlord_Lore/TL67: The Barbgaunt has little mind of its own. It's bonded to a cerebral parasite that controls its weapon, using the Barbgaunt as a beast of burden.
刺爪兽几乎没有自己的思维。它与控制其武器的脑寄生虫结合，将刺爪兽用作负重的野兽。
Warlord_Lore/TL68: Preying on psychic lifeforms, a Psychophage's digestive tract is able to metabolise metaphysical matter into psychocorrosive ash, which it projects in blistering torrents.
猎食心灵生物的心灵食肉虫，其消化道能够将超物质转化为心灵腐蚀灰烬，然后以水泡般的洪流喷射出来。
Warlord_Lore/TL69: The Neurotyrant's giant brain focuses the mental powers of the hive, relaying the synapse network to the horde and orchestrating Tyranids to victory.
神经暴君的巨大大脑集中了巢都的精神力量，将突触网络中继到虫群，并指挥泰伦虫族取得胜利。
Warlord_Lore/TL70: The expressed will of a Norn Queen made flesh. These towering organisms evolved for the purpose of preying on gifted enemy commanders and abducting prey from defended strongholds.
诺恩女王的意志具象化为肉体。这些高大的生物演化出来的目的是猎食有天赋的敌方指挥官并从防守坚固的堡垒中绑架猎物。
Warlord_Lore/TL71: The Toxicrene’s mass of tendrils whip and coil about its victim, ensnaring them and drawing them into its lethal embrace.
毒素克雷尼的触手群像鞭子一样抽打并缠绕其受害者，将他们困住并将他们拉入其致命的拥抱。
Warlord_Lore/TL72: When the Hive Fleet invades, the skies darken with the descending shapes of hundreds of thousands of Tyrannocytes containing brood upon brood of Tyranids.
当虫巢舰队入侵时，天空会因数十万个装满泰伦虫族巢穴的孢子舱而变暗。
Warlord_Lore/TL73: Overcome with biochemical adrenaline and predatory aggression, warrior organisms seek constantly to hurl themselves upon the nearest possible prey and tear them to pieces.
充满生化肾上腺素和掠食者侵略性的战士生物，总是寻求将自己扔向最近可能的猎物并将其撕成碎片。
Warlord_Lore/TL74: This Winged Tyranid Prime was the alpha warrior at the head of the Vardenghast Swarm, which reaped a bloody toll of human prey in a series of battles along the Vardenghast Line.
这只翼型泰伦精兵是瓦登加斯特虫群的首领战士，它在瓦登加斯特防线的一系列战斗中，对人类猎物收取了血腥的代价。
Warlord_Lore/TL75: Scuttling predators that attack in huge swarms, Termagants harry their prey with a hail of firepower, seeking to outflank and envelop their victims as they erode their numbers.
如同掠食者战车般匆匆忙忙地攻击的是大量的枪虫虫群，他们以密集的火力骚扰猎物，试图在削减敌人数量的同时，对他们进行包围和侧翼攻击。
Warlord_Lore/468db99b4b10d0745bab346df37: Psychophages stampede into battle with frightening speed, devouring any prey organism in their paths, and using the assimilated energy to bio-stimulate the swarm.
心灵食肉虫以惊人的速度冲入战场，吞噬他们路径中的任何猎物生物，并使用吸收的能量来生物刺激虫群。
Warlord_Lore/8f2da557fe484ee4bbf427c13ec: There is no escape from an alpha predator. The Winged Tyranid Prime will use the lesser biocreatures as a distraction to leap onto its prey from above.
从顶级掠食者那里无法逃脱。翼型泰伦精兵会使用较小的生物作为干扰，从上方跳向猎物。
Warlord_Lore/GOF65: What Gordrang lacks in subtlety is more than made up for by the brute savagery and resilience of his horde, who live to rampage and hurl themselves into every fight they can find.
戈德朗虽然缺乏微妙的策略，但他的部落的野蛮和韧性足以弥补这一点，他们生活的目的就是狂暴和投身于他们能找到的每一场战斗。
Warlord_Lore/GOF66: The deafeningly loud noise, scattering of debris over a wide area and atomisation of anyone too close make explosives an irresistible lure to many Orks.
震耳欲聋的噪音，广泛散布的碎片和过于接近的人的原子化使爆炸对许多欧克蛮人具有无法抗拒的吸引力。
Warlord_Lore/GOF67: The foul-tempered Boss Nobz are in charge of leading Ork Boyz into battle in huge, unruly mobs that stampede towards the enemy lines.
脾气暴躁的强蛮人老大负责带领蛮人小子们在巨大的，混乱的暴群中冲向敌人的阵线。
Warlord_Lore/GOF68: Some Nobz prefer to fight wielding jaw-droppingly large choppas, ferociously swinging them into battle inflicting mayhem and terror on their foes.
一些强蛮人更喜欢挥舞着令人瞠目结舌的大砍刀，疯狂地将它们挥入战斗，给他们的敌人带来混乱和恐惧。
Warlord_Lore/GOF69: The lunatic Deffkopta pilots hurl ahead of their warband to spy out enemy forces, a process that often finishes with a hazardous blast.
疯狂的死亡直升机飞行员在他们的战队前面飞行，以侦查敌人的力量，这个过程通常以危险的爆炸结束。
Warlord_Lore/GOF70: This saw-fisted, bipedal, mechanical abomination is as proficient at terrorizing its foes as it is at dismembering them in a nightmarish scene of carnage.
这个带有锯子拳头的，双足行走的，机械怪物在恐吓敌人和在一场噩梦般的屠杀场景中肢解他们方面同样熟练。
Warlord_Lore/GOF71: While Orks delight in the deafening blasts and ferocious recoil of a good firefight, they despise foes that shoot them before they can get stuck into a proper hand-to-hand brawl.
欧克蛮人喜欢在好的火战中享受震耳欲聋的爆炸和猛烈的后座力，他们讨厌在他们能参与到适当的肉搏战之前就射击他们的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/GOF72: Orks rejoice in aproaching battle in simple and direct ways, and if that approach happens to be while wielding huge, piston-driven, mechanical klaws, even better.
欧克蛮人喜欢以简单直接的方式接近战斗，如果这种方式恰好是挥舞着巨大的，活塞驱动的，机械爪子，那就更好了。
Warlord_Lore/GOF73: Ork battle strategy rarely stretches far beyond singling out their victims, piling onto them with choppas swinging, and engaging in a spectacle of gratuitous violence.
欧克蛮人的战斗策略很少超越挑选出他们的受害者，用砍刀挥舞着堆积在他们身上，并参与到一场过度暴力的表演。
Warlord_Lore/GOF74: The more fights an Ork survives, the bigger, meaner, and more covered in scars he becomes. Many Warbosses boast a gnarled green hide as tough as any body armour.
欧克蛮人经历的战斗越多，他就变得越大，越凶狠，身上的伤疤也越多。许多战争老大都有一张坚硬如同任何身体盔甲的绿色皮肤。
Warlord_Lore/GOF75: Donning a piston-driven suit of incredibly durable mega armour, Gordrang makes a mockery of his foes' tactics and terrorizes their ranks.
戈德朗穿着一套由活塞驱动的超级耐用的大型盔甲，让他的敌人的战术成为笑柄，并恐吓他们的队伍。
Warlord_Lore/6899b199f5e36144ebbdd7ed9d9: These enormous weapons serve as the mark of a true paragon of brutality amongst orks. Few gits would be able to resist a strike from these massively weighted choppas.
这些巨大的武器是欧克蛮人中真正的暴力楷模的标志。很少有家伙能抵挡住这些重量巨大的砍刀的攻击。
Warlord_Lore/TAU1: Clad in her highly advanced XV22 Stalker Battlesuit, Commander O’Shaserra employs her strategic genius to orchestrate elaborate plans, destroying the enemy’s most valuable assets.
身穿高度先进的XV22潜行者战斗服，指挥官欧·夏萨拉运用她的战略天才，精心策划复杂的计划，摧毁敌人最有价值的资产。
Warlord_Lore/TAU2: Aun’Va is the oldest and highest-ranking of the Ethereal Council. His voice is law across the entire T’au Empire. His hand is visible in many of his people’s greatest achievements.
昂’瓦是以太理事会中年龄最大、级别最高的人。他的话在整个钛帝国帝国中就是法律。他的手在他的人民的许多伟大成就中都有所体现。
Warlord_Lore/TAU3: An exemplar among the Fire Warriors of the Vior'la Sept, this hot-blooded commander hurls herself into battle inside her XV86 Coldstar Battlesuit.
作为维奥拉家门火战士中的典范，这位血气方刚的指挥官驾驶她的XV86 冷星战斗服投身于战斗之中。
Warlord_Lore/TAU4: Drones feature an armoured shell protecting an AI core, loaded with saviour protocols that compel them to sacrifice themselves for the Greater Good in the place of their masters.
无人机具有保护AI核心的装甲外壳，装载着救世协议，这些协议迫使它们为了上上善道代替主人牺牲自己。
Warlord_Lore/TAU5: The Fire Caste constitutes the warriors of T’au society. It is their duty to protect the other castes, and to eliminate any foe who opposes the will of the T’au Empire.
火氏构成了塔乌社会的战士。他们的职责是保护其他氏族，并消灭任何反对塔乌帝国意志的敌人。
Warlord_Lore/TAU6: MV1 Gun Drones are equipped with pulse carbines that allow them to lay down withering hails of fire.
MV1火炮无人机装备了脉冲卡宾枪，使它们能够发射破坏性的火力。
Warlord_Lore/TAU7: MV7 Marker Drones are able to ‘paint’ enemy targets for other T’au units to fire upon, while benefiting from increased, networked processing power when present in large numbers.
MV7标记者无人机能够为其他钛帝国单位“标记”敌人目标，同时在大量存在时，从增强的网络处理能力中受益。
Warlord_Lore/TAU8: Missile Drones are a variant of the standard Gun Drone that forgoes the latter’s twin-linked Pulse Carbines armament in favour of a heavier weapon – the Missile Pod.
导弹无人机是标准机枪无人机的一种变体，它放弃了后者的双联脉冲卡宾枪武器，选择了更重的武器 - 导弹舱。
Warlord_Lore/TAU9: Pathfinders wreak havoc sniping with potent rifles. Yet their deadliest ability is painting priority targets with massed markerlights for heavier T’au units to annihilate.
探路者用强大的步枪制造浩劫，狙击敌人。然而，他们最致命的能力是用集束标记灯标记优先目标，让钛帝国的重型单位进行消灭。
Warlord_Lore/TAU10: The MV5 Stealth Drone is a model that incorporates stealth field generators that can conceal their allies rendering them virtually invisible in open terrain.
MV5隐形无人机是一种模型，融入了隐身场发生器，可以隐藏他们的盟友，使他们在开阔地形中几乎无法被看见。
Warlord_Lore/TAU11: Enduring as the most iconic battlesuit, the XV8 Crisis Battlesuit boasts multiple hard points for weaponry and support systems, along with a powerful jet pack.
作为最具标志性的战斗服，XV8 危机战斗服拥有多个武器和支援系统的硬点，以及强大的喷气背包。
Warlord_Lore/TAU12: As much a maverick as he is a master of covert operations, Sub-commander El’Myamoto is a formidable leader of stealth and sabotage missions.
他既是个特立独行的人，又是隐秘行动的大师，副指挥官暗行是隐身和破坏布道所的强大领导者。
Warlord_Lore/TAU13: This small but deadly device is deployed by Strike Teams to secure and protect tactical objectives, shooting salvos of smart missiles that leave no hiding place for their foes.
这个小而致命的设备由打击小队部署，以保护和保护战术目标，发射智能导弹齐射，让敌人无处藏身。
Warlord_Lore/TAU14: Breacher Teams' pulse blasters are short ranged but deadly, and when coupled with their tough armour and tactical discipline, they become lethal at close quarters.
破袭小队的脉冲爆能枪射程短，但威力巨大，配合他们坚固的盔甲和战术纪律，他们在近距离战斗中变得致命。
Warlord_Lore/TAU15: MV71 Sniper Drones utilize fire-prioritisation routines transmitted by Firesight Marksmen, rendering them smarter, more cunning and even more deadly to distant foes.
MV71狙击无人机利用火瞄标枪手传输的火力优先程序，使它们变得更聪明，更狡猾，对远方的敌人更加致命。
Warlord_Lore/TAU16: Thrumming into battle on membranous wings, this insectile species unleash radioactive salvoes from their neutron blasters while shrugging off damage thanks to their resilient biology.
这种昆虫类生物以膜翅膀振动进入战斗，从他们的中子爆破枪中释放放射性齐射，同时由于他们的强韧生物学，可以轻松抵挡伤害。
Warlord_Lore/TAU17: It is a great honour to be selected as a bodyguard for one of the Fire Caste’s Commanders. These warriors will protect their charge at their own peril without a second thought.
被选为火氏的指挥官的护卫是一种极大的荣誉。这些战士会毫不犹豫地以自己的生命保护他们的主人。
Warlord_Lore/TAU18: Pulse firearms employ induction fields to propel particles that break down and create focused plasma blasts that can be projected over extremely long ranges.
脉冲火器利用感应场来推动粒子，这些粒子会分解并产生聚焦的等离子爆炸，可以在极远的距离上投射。
Warlord_Lore/TAU19: T’au Ethereals sit at the crossroads of their society’s castes, guiding Fire, Water, Air, and Earth with boundless wisdom and force of will.
钛帝国以太坐落在他们社会阶级的十字路口，以无尽的智慧和意志力引导火、水、气和地。
Warlord_Lore/TAU20: These light combat skimmers strike ahead of the main T’au forces, detaching independent weapon drones to sow mayhem behind enemy lines.
这些轻型战斗滑翔机在主要的钛帝国力量前面进行攻击，分离出独立的武器无人机在敌人的阵线后面制造混乱。
Warlord_Lore/TAU21: Benefiting from jet-assisted speed Stealth Battlesuits make excellent forward operatives who can deploy homing beacons to guide entire insertion forces into battle from low orbit.
隐形战斗服利用喷气辅助速度，成为出色的前线操作员，他们可以部署追踪信标，引导整个插入部队从低轨道进入战斗。
Warlord_Lore/TAU22: Fire Warrior Strike Teams are the mainstay of many Hunter Cadres, unleashing storms of potent anti-personnel firepower that few foes can long endure.
火战士打击小队是许多猎核的主力，他们释放的强大的反人员火力风暴，很少有敌人能长时间承受。
Warlord_Lore/TAU23: The T’au Empire is a meritocracy in which excellence is recognised with progress. In the Fire Caste this takes the form of advancement through the ranks.
塔乌帝国是一个以功绩论英雄的社会，优秀者将得到提升。在火氏中，这种提升表现为军衔的提升。
Warlord_Lore/TAU24: An armoured transport, the Devilfish is an iconic symbol of T’au military expansion. Tough and surprisingly agile, it bears Fire Warriors safely into battle with impressive speed.
作为一种装甲运输工具，魔鬼鱼是 钛帝国 军事扩张的标志性象征。它坚固且出奇地灵活，能以惊人的速度将火战士安全地带入战斗。
Warlord_Lore/TAU25: Hidden behind shimmering stealth fields, the Firesight Marksmen play their targeting instruments over the foe and transmit data to the MV71 Sniper Drones in their thrall.
隐藏在闪烁的隐身领域后面，火瞄标枪手用他们的瞄准器具瞄准敌人，并将数据传输到他们控制的MV71狙击无人机。
Warlord_Lore/TAU26: A comparatively lightweight and specialist mark of battlesuit, the XV25 Battlesuit conceals its pilot behind fields of lightspectrum and sensor-baffling stealth technology.
XV25 战斗服是一种相对轻型且专业的战斗服，它将其驾驶员隐藏在光谱和传感器干扰的隐形技术的场中。
Warlord_Lore/TAU27: The XV88 battlesuit is an indomitable slab of high-tech armour. Its iconic heavy rail rifle and other long-range weaponry can make short work of even the toughest enemy targets.
XV88 战斗服是一块不可战胜的高科技盔甲。它标志性的重型磁轨步枪和其他远程武器可以轻松解决甚至是最强大的敌人目标。
Warlord_Lore/TAU28: Those Commanders who exhibit the most aggressive temperaments often choose to take to the field piloting an XV85 Enforcer Battlesuit, based off the enduringly popular XV8 Crisis.
那些表现出最具侵略性的指挥官通常选择驾驶 XV85 镇压者战斗服上场，这种战斗服是基于一直受欢迎的 XV8 危机。
Warlord_Lore/TAU29: Specialists in infantry-based battlefield tactics, Cadre Fireblades' veteran wisdom is of great benefit to the warriors alongside whom they fight.
专精于步兵战术的火刃队长，他们的老兵智慧对并肩作战的战士们有着巨大的帮助。
Warlord_Lore/TAU30: This hover tank relies upon other units to use markerlights to highlight targets for its seeker missiles. Once this is done, however, the Sky Ray’s salvoes are nigh inescapable.
这款悬浮坦克依赖其他单位使用标记灯来照亮其寻找者导弹的目标。然而，一旦完成，天光射线的齐射几乎无法逃脱。
Warlord_Lore/TAU31: The Hammerhead Gunship epitomises the T’au way of war. Resilient and possessing truly ferocious firepower, it also showcases impressive swiftness and manoeuvrability.
锤头鲨炮艇是塔族战争方式的典型代表。它既坚韧，又拥有真正的猛烈火力，同时还展示了令人印象深刻的迅捷和机动性。
Warlord_Lore/TAU32: A hero to his people, Aun’Shi's presence inspires the T’au of the Fire Caste as surely as a blazing beacon, leading the way to victory with his honour blade flashing and slicing.
对他的人民来说，他是一个英雄，昂’史的存在就像燃烧的信标一样，肯定地激励着火氏的钛帝国，他的荣誉之刃闪烁着，引领着他们走向胜利。
Warlord_Lore/TAU33: The Razorshark is an air superiority fighter with enough resilience and potent firepower to double as an alarmingly effective ground-attack craft at need.
剃刀鲨是一种空中优势战斗机，具有足够的韧性和强大的火力，必要时可以惊人地有效地作为地面攻击飞机。
Warlord_Lore/TAU34: Favoured by Commanders who seek to be everywhere at once, the XV86 battlesuit is capable of soaring at high speed over the battlefield, or even operating in the cold void of space.
XV86战斗服受到寻求在战场上高速飞翔，甚至在寒冷的太空中操作的指挥官的青睐。
Warlord_Lore/TAU35: Renowned as a tank ace, Longstrike possesses a sublime talent for armoured warfare. His XV02 Pilot Battlesuit allows him to integrate seamlessly with his chosen gunship.
作为一名著名的坦克王牌，远击拥有卓越的装甲战争才能。他的XV02驾驶员战斗服使他能够与他的神选者炮舰无缝集成。
Warlord_Lore/TAU36: Powered by a thrumming nova reactor, the Riptide battlesuit can overcharge its formidable systems at need, and eradicate entire formations of enemy warriors or armoured vehicles.
由嗡嗡作响的新星反应堆驱动，激流战斗服可以在需要时超载其强大的系统，并消灭整个敌人的战士或装甲车辆的阵型。
Warlord_Lore/TAU37: Able to micro-manufacture its own energy-munitions in the heat of battle, the Sun Shark drops thrumming pulse bombs onto the foe and obliterates them with ferocious blasts.
太阳鲨能在战斗中微制造自己的能量弹药，将嗡嗡作响的脉冲炸弹投掷到敌人身上，用猛烈的爆炸将他们消灭。
Warlord_Lore/TAU38: These vast ballistic suits are ponderous by T’au standards. A walking gun-tower equal to the mightiest fortress, it anchors the T’au lines while unleashing apocalyptic firestorms.
按照塔族的标准，这些巨大的炮击服是沉重的。它们等同于最强大的要塞，锚定了塔族的阵线，同时释放出毁灭性的火风暴。
Warlord_Lore/TAU39: Roughly translated as ‘the patient hunter’, Kauyon combat tactics rely upon lures to draw the enemy in, before closing the jaws of the trap upon overcommited foes.
粗略翻译为“耐心的猎手”，空育战术依赖于诱饵来吸引敌人，然后在过度投入的敌人身上关闭陷阱的大门。
Warlord_Lore/TAU40: The Earth Caste comprises the artisans and engineers of the T’au. It is they who construct machines and ensure the peak performance of the battlesuits for the battles to come.
土氏包括塔族的工匠师和工程师。他们负责构造机器，并确保战斗服在即将到来的战斗中达到最佳性能。
Warlord_Lore/TAU41: As a breath of air slips unseen and unheard through blades of grass in a night-time forest, so do the T’au filter swift and silent across the battlefield.
就像夜晚森林中的草叶间无声无息地滑过一口气，塔族也在战场上迅速而沉默地过滤。
Warlord_Lore/TAU42: Ethereals control access to numerous classified new technological developments of the Earth Caste, and look for the optimal time to reveal them.
以太控制着对土氏的许多新技术发展的访问，并寻找适当的时机来揭示它们。
Warlord_Lore/TAU43: Unification echoes through the ranks, embodying the belief that the life of any given individual of the T’au Empire is of less importance than the needs of the empire itself.
统一在队伍中回响，体现了塔族帝国任何个体的生命都不如帝国本身的需要重要的信念。
Warlord_Lore/TAU44: Rather than charge into hand-to-hand combat, T’au soldiery instead intensify their fire patterns and systematically lay waste to the foe.
塔族兵士并非冲入近战，而是强化他们的火力模式，系统性地摧毁敌人。
Warlord_Lore/TAU45: Some Fire Caste soldiers deploy as elite Pathfinders who scout the foe and mark targets for long-ranged elimination.
一些火氏士兵作为精英探路者部署，他们侦查敌人并标记远程消除的目标。
Warlord_Lore/TAU46: As stone resists the onslaught of the other elements in their endless quest to wear it away, so do the T’au exhibit that same unbending resilience.
就像石头抵抗其他元素无尽的侵蚀，塔族也表现出同样的坚韧不屈。
Warlord_Lore/TAU47: Engaging all systems, skilled battlesuit pilots can surge into battle in a blaze of deadly-accurate firepower.
启动所有系统，熟练的战斗服飞行员可以在一片致命精确的火力中冲入战斗。
Warlord_Lore/TAU48: The Ethereals perform a unifying role. They take counsel from senior members of each caste, but ultimately all decisions are theirs to make and responsibilities theirs to be borne.
以太在统一中起到作用。他们从每个氏族的高级成员那里寻求建议，但最终所有的决定都是他们做出的，所有的责任也是他们承担的。
Warlord_Lore/TAU49: The mere presence of an Ethereal reminds the warriors of the Fire Caste of their place within the Greater Good, and inspires them to even greater efforts.
一个以太的存在就能让火氏的战士们想起他们在上上善道中的位置，并激励他们做出更大的努力。
Warlord_Lore/TAU50: Pathfinders can infiltrate deep behind enemy lines, to scout the foe and identify the highest priority targets for long-ranged elimination.
探路者可以深入敌人的后方，侦查敌人并确定长距离消除的最高优先级目标。
Warlord_Lore/TAU51: Built-in saviour protocols compel the machine intelligence of T'au drones to sacrifice itself for the Greater Good in the place of its masters.
内置的救世主协议强迫钛帝国无人机的机器智能为了上上善道而牺牲自己，代替它的主人。
Warlord_Lore/TAU52: The steady gaze of the Ethereal reminds those of the Fire Caste that there lies within the heart of every storm a zone of silence that remains serene even as fury rages around it.
以太的坚定目光提醒火氏的人们，每场风暴的心脏都有一个寂灭区，即使周围的怒火如何狂暴，它仍然宁静。
Warlord_Lore/TAU58: T’au combined arms groups are called Hunter Cadres for good reason. Working in close coordination, they hunt and destroy the most dangerous enemy targets.
钛帝国的联合武器组被称为猎核，有充分的理由。他们密切协调，猎杀并摧毁最危险的敌人目标。
Warlord_Lore/TAU53: To make best use of their available arsenal, the Fire Caste place heavy emphasis on skilled marksmanship and fighting from a position of advantage.
为了最好地利用他们可用的武器库，火氏重视熟练的射击技巧和从有利位置进行战斗。
Warlord_Lore/TAU54: Swift and lethal, Razorsharks soar over enemy lines raining destruction upon enemy formations as a testament to T'au air superiority and precision tactics.
敏捷而致命，剃刀鲨在敌人阵线上空翱翔，对敌人阵型进行破坏，这是钛帝国空中优势和精确战术的最好证明。
Warlord_Lore/TAU55: With mechanical efficiency instilled by endless drills, the T’au maintain a punishing fire rate even when engaging the enemy at long range.
通过无尽的训练，钛帝国保持了惩罚性的火力，即使在远距离与敌人交战时也是如此。
Warlord_Lore/TAU56: Drones will dive into the path of incoming fire without a second thought if it means protecting T’au lives.
如果这意味着保护钛帝国的生命，无人机会在没有第二次思考的情况下冲入即将到来的火力之路。
Warlord_Lore/TAU57: The Greater Good demands the tireless expansion of the T’au Empire. Through diplomacy or strength of arms, new worlds and civilisations are brought into the light of the T’au’va.
上上善道要求钛帝国不断扩张。通过外交或武力，新的世界和文明被带入钛帝国的光明中。
Warlord_Lore/TAU59: The resulting darkness of a solar eclipse allows the usage of low-flying drop ships to deploy entire squads directly into the enemy lines.
